izzyondroid:com.boxlabs.hexdroid.name: HexDroid IRC
izzyondroid:com.boxlabs.hexdroid.summary: A lightweight, modern IRC client for Android
izzyondroid:com.boxlabs.hexdroid.description:
HexDroid is a clean, fast, open-source IRC client for modern Android. Connect to your favourite networks, chat with friends and communities, and never miss a mention—all from a Material Design interface built for mobile.
 Connect anywhere - Always Connected for persistent sessions and automatic reconnection - Multiple network profiles with independent settings - Auto-connect, auto-join and optional post-connect commands - ZNC and soju bouncer support
 Security - TLS by default with Trust On First Use (TOFU) pinning for self-signed certificates - SASL authentication: PLAIN, EXTERNAL (client certificates) and SCRAM-SHA-256 - Credentials encrypted with the Android Keystore - Secure Chat with AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption, Authenticated Group Exchange, FiSH for backwards compatibility. - Tor and SOCKS proxy support
 Chat experience - Mention notifications with quick reply, swipe-to-reply and inline quote previews - IRCv3 features including typing indicators, chat history, reactions, read markers and account tags - /command and @nick autocomplete, colour-coded nicknames, mIRC/ANSI formatting and inline media previews - Search, jump to unread, operator tools, ignore lists and notification muting
 DCC file transfers - Send and receive files, DCC Chat, passive/reverse DCC, Secure DCC (SSEND/SCHAT), RESUME and IPv6 support
 Customisation - Multiple languages and .hex scripting - Per-network character encoding - Custom nick colours and drag-and-drop network ordering - Backup and restore settings as JSON - Optional on-device chat logging
 Privacy No ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your messages and credentials are sent only to the IRC servers you choose.
 IRCv3 features depend on server support. Background connectivity may vary depending on your device's battery settings.
 Free and open source software, licensed under GPLv3.
 Support: irc.afternet.org #HexDroid Privacy policy: https://hexdroid.boxlabs.uk/privacy

fdroid:au.how2vote.app.name: How2Vote
fdroid:au.how2vote.app.summary: See how parties' real parliamentary voting records compare with your views.
fdroid:au.how2vote.app.description:
How2Vote is an independent, non-partisan comparison tool for Australian federal elections.
NOT A GOVERNMENT APP
How2Vote is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or authorised by the Australian Electoral Commission, the Parliament of Australia or any other government entity, and it does not provide or facilitate government services.
Answer propositions that parliament has actually voted on. The app shows how closely each party's recorded parliamentary votes match your positions — against the candidates on your ballot, in official ballot order. Then build your own voting plan: nothing is ranked for you and no preference is recommended. You author your own preference order.
WORKS FULLY OFFLINE
The complete dataset ships inside the app — questions, scoring and your card all work with no connection, including at a polling place with no signal. The app goes online only for what you ask it to: sending the contact form, contributing to the anonymous research if you opt in, or opening a link out to the AEC or They Vote For You.
BUILT FROM THE PARLIAMENTARY RECORD
Comparisons are built from recorded parliamentary votes (public Hansard data via They Vote For You), not campaign statements. Every proposition links to the parliamentary divisions behind it, so everything you are shown can be checked at the source.
OFFICIAL SOURCES
Every piece of electoral and parliamentary information in the app comes from these public sources, and can be checked against them. This is the complete list:
- Candidates, ballot paper order, electoral divisions and election dates — Australian Electoral Commission, 2025 federal election downloads: https://www.aec.gov.au/election/fe25/downloads-statistics.htm
- Electoral division boundaries used for the maps — Australian Electoral Commission, electoral boundaries GIS downloads: https://www.aec.gov.au/Electorates/gis/gis_datadownload.htm
- The parliamentary record the vote comparisons are drawn from (Hansard divisions) — Parliament of Australia: https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Hansard
- The compiled division-by-division voting records the app actually reads — They Vote For You, by the OpenAustralia Foundation: https://theyvoteforyou.org.au
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. Your answers and weights stay on your device.
NEUTRAL BY CONSTRUCTION
The interface is strictly two-tone, so match quality is never encoded as party colour. The scoring method is public, deterministic and reproducible, and the app is open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later. https://github.com/National-Digital/how2vote.au
Authorised by General Consulting Services Pty Ltd as trustee for the Australian Business Trust, trading as National Digital, Gold Coast, Queensland.

fdroid:com.exner.tools.jkbikemechanicald.name: J-K Bike - Mechanical Disaster Prevention Pro
fdroid:com.exner.tools.jkbikemechanicald.summary: App that helps build positive bike maintenance behaviours, for rides quick, big
fdroid:com.exner.tools.jkbikemechanicald.description:
We have all experienced those rides where something mechanical happens that really was preventable. As the authors, even though we take a certain pride in our own efforts in maintaining smooth running MTBs, and a disdain for our riding buddies who never give a passing thought until something goes 'CRUNCH!' in a ride-ending manner, there are still innumerate situations where something that should have been checked, or usually never needs checked after proper installation, has not been.
 'Where is that vibration coming from?', 'why is the rear end creaking?', 'What is that terrible knocking?' are so often result of something relatively simple being overlooked or forgotten. Recent favourites have been disc rotor bolts backing out, rear thru axles not done up properly, and headsets improperly tensioned.
 So, to prevent mechanical disasters happening on your rides, use this app to build better, new, habits and ensure your rides are (mechanically) glorious.
 The app can connect ot Strava and update mileages/distances as well as last ride dates.
 This app uses INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions to download template activities from a github repository at https://github.com/janexner/JKBikeTemplateActivities , and to retrieve data from 3rd-party integrations, currently with Intervals.icu only. No internet access beyond that.

fdroid:com.greenaddress.abcore.name: ABCore
fdroid:com.greenaddress.abcore.description:
ABCore is a wrapper for Bitcoin Core for Android.
Bitcoin Core (formerly Bitcoin-Qt) is the bitcoin daemon software based on
the original reference code by Satoshi Nakamoto. It is programmed to decide
which block chain contains valid transactions. The users of Bitcoin Core
only accept transactions for that block chain, making it the Bitcoin block
chain that everyone else wants to use.
It is these users who keep Bitcoin decentralized. They individually run
their own Bitcoin Core full nodes, and each of those full nodes separately
follows the exact same rules to decide which block chain is valid.
There's no voting or other corruptible process involved: there's just
individual software following identical rules—"math"—to evaluate identical
blocks and coming to identical conclusions about which block chain is
valid.

fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.cameradatefolde.name: Camera Date Folders
fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.cameradatefolde.summary: Sort photos from camera folder into a date specific subfolder structure
fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.cameradatefolde.description:
Sorts all photos, located in the device's camera folder, into a date specific subfolder structure. This makes it easier to transfer specific photos to a computer, e.g. via USB cable (MTP protocol).
Either keep photos inside the camera folder tree or move or copy them to a separate directory. This can also be used as a simple backup method.
Up to three levels are supported: year, month and day. The sorting can be reverted, i.e. all photos can be moved back to the base directory (but not back to the camera directory in case a destination directory is specified).
On the demand a file name prefix like "IMG_" or "PXL_" can be appended instead or completely removed. Note that this operation is not revertible.
The program does not read metadata (EXIF) from the photo files, instead it uses the data information encoded in the filenames.
To meet Google's restrictive policy, the Play Store variant of the program must use Google's proprietary Storage Access Framework when running on Android 11 or newer. As a consequence, file operations are extremely slow. This restriction partially exists also for older Android versions and not at all for the F-Droid version of the program. In this case standard file access calls can be activated alternatively, which accelerate the file operations with a factor of approximately 90 (!).

fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.name: osm2gmaps
fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.summary: Convert coordinates and map links between formats, services and apps
fdroid:net.retiolus.osm2gmaps.description:
osm2gmaps finds a place from whatever you have: coordinates, a grid reference, a plus code, a map link, a photo or an address. It gives you that place in every useful form: coordinates in the format you need, or the place in the map app you use.
 Every way to write a position 
* Decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, degrees and decimal minutes, UTM, MGRS, plus codes, geohash and Maidenhead locators.
* National grids, shown only where they are used: British National Grid, Irish Grid, Swiss LV95, Dutch RD, French Lambert 93 and DFCI, Swedish SWEREF 99 TM.
* Pick a format with one tap and copy it with another. Hide the ones you never use.
* Reads coordinates however they are written: N/S/E/W or signs, symbols or spaces, GeoJSON and WKT, longitude first when it is obvious. Also reads Irish ITM and Swiss LV03.
* When a code can be read several ways (a locator or a geohash, two grids), shows the other readings.
* Completes local plus codes ("V75V+8Q Paris") with OpenStreetMap.
 From any map, to any map 
* Reads places from Google Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap, Organic Maps, CoMaps, OsmAnd, Waze, HERE WeGo, Bing, Yandex, 2GIS, Magic Earth, Mapy.com, Baidu, Amap, Tencent, Kagi Maps, Yahoo! Japan, cartes.app, Min karta, Wikipedia and more.
* Opens the place or starts navigation in your map app, gives it as a link for more than 20 services, or as a QR code for another phone.
* Corrects the offset of Chinese map coordinates (GCJ-02, BD-09).
* Moves your bookmarks from one map app to another, with their lists, notes, tracks and routes: from a Google Takeout archive or a list from Organic Maps, CoMaps, OsmAnd or HERE WeGo, to Organic Maps, CoMaps, OsmAnd, Cartes IGN, Magic Earth, or a KMZ, GPX, KML, GeoJSON or Google My Maps file.
* Shows the places of a shared Google Maps list, and saves them all.
 Quick to use 
* Paste, share text or a photo, select text in any app, search an address, or use your current position.
* Shows the place on OpenStreetMap's map when you ask.
* Choose what happens when you open a map link: show the place, open it in your map app, or copy or share it.
* Keeps a history of your places, with favourites, exported to GPX, KML or JSON.
 Private by design 
* No ads, no trackers, no account. Coordinates are converted on your phone.
* The app never contacts Google, Apple or other proprietary services, except what3words with your own key. Short links go through an open-source resolver that you turn on, and can host yourself.
* Asks before contacting OpenStreetMap or Wikipedia directly, unless you allow it in the settings.
* Reproducible builds: F-Droid checks that the app is built from this source code.

fdroid:space.nish.stlviewer.description:
A fast, lightweight, open-source 3D model viewer for Android. Zero trackers, no ads, and no internet permissions required.
Key Features:
* Binary & ASCII STL: opens complex 3D meshes smoothly, including CAD exports with custom headers or truncated files.
* Wavefront OBJ: streams geometric vertices and faces, supporting triangles, quads, and convex n-gons.

fdroid:webtor.app.name: Torrent Player
fdroid:webtor.app.summary: Stream and download torrents directly on Android with external media players.
fdroid:webtor.app.description:
Torrent Player is a lightweight, high-performance torrent downloader and streaming engine designed specifically for Android.
 Download torrents directly to your local storage or stream growing video files on-the-fly using your favorite external media players.
 Core Features: 
 Direct Local Storage: Single-contract download directly to local public storage ( Downloads/Webtor ) for straightforward file management.
 Built-in Video Player: Seek bar that shows downloaded parts, seek prefetch, brightness and volume swipes, hold-and-slide playback speed, audio and subtitle tracks, and picture-in-picture.
 In-Progress Video Streaming: Stream growing video files directly to external players such as VLC, Nova Video Player, MPV, or Just Player without waiting for downloads to finish.
 Selective File Downloading: Choose specific files to prioritize or download in multi-file swarms.
 Bitfield Piece Visualizer: Interactive real-time visualizer showing piece distribution and swarm availability.
 Optimized Resource & Battery Usage: Adaptive polling back-off and a native Rust engine with bounded preparation storage.
 Modern Material 3 Interface: Intuitive UI with dynamic colors, dark theme support, and animated video preview cards.
 Direct Play: Stream a video from RAM without saving the whole file. Only each video's start and end are kept (up to 1 GB) so episodes reopen fast.
 Continue Watching and Play Next: Resume where you left off and move on to the next episode, with its start fetched in advance.
 Fast Seeking: A seek fetches the new play position first and moves late blocks to faster peers. For MP4 and MKV files, nearby keyframes are fetched ahead.
 Peer Map: Shows peer countries using an offline database bundled with the app (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0). No lookup requests are made.
 Privacy & Freedom: 
 100% Free and Open Source Software (MIT License; the engine is MPL-2.0; the built-in player uses mpv and FFmpeg under the LGPL).
 No advertising trackers, analytics, or telemetry.
 Zero advertisements.
 Direct peer-to-peer swarm connectivity (DHT, UDP trackers, TCP, uTP, WebSockets, and WebRTC).
 Network connections: 
 When the app starts, the engine automatically refreshes a cached public tracker list from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ngosang/trackerslist/master/trackers_best.txt. Successful refreshes are scheduled once per day; failed requests may be retried. This request downloads a shared list and does not send torrent hashes or user-supplied tracker URLs.
 Up to 24 additional public BitTorrent trackers are automatically added to each non-private torrent to help discover peers. Cached and built-in fallback trackers are used when the list is unavailable. Private torrents are excluded. Torrent announces share your IP address and torrent info hash with the trackers contacted.
 WebRTC peer connections use STUN servers operated by Google, Twilio, and Cloudflare to discover a public network address for connectivity. These providers can see the source IP address of STUN requests.
 Seeding is on by default: after a download completes, its verified pieces are uploaded to other peers until a share ratio of 1.0 or 60 minutes of seeding, at up to 256 KiB/s and only on Wi-Fi. Seeding pauses during playback. Turn it off or change the limits in Settings, Seeding.
 The app does not provide settings to disable public tracker-list refresh, extra public trackers, or WebRTC. This build supports arm64-v8a devices.

fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.name: Zoysii - Logic game
fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.summary: A simple logic game: find the best path to delete every number in a square space
fdroid:xyz.deepdaikon.zoysii.description:
Zoysii is a simple logic game. You are the red tile on a square board and the aim is to delete almost every tile while trying to make the most points.
It's so easy !
 Modes: 
‣ Single player: play a random match and try to get the most points.
‣ Multiplayer: play against your opponents and defeat them.
‣ Levels: use your mind to solve each level by deleting all the tiles.
 Main features: 
★ Multiplayer mode for up to 4 players on the same device
★ 70+ unique levels
★ 10+ numeral systems
★ Completely free
★ No Ads
★ Multiple languages
★ Minimalist design and dark mode
 Rules: 
The rules may seem difficult at first glance but they are not.
Anyhow, the best way to learn is by playing! Levels mode is a good place to start.
1. You are the red tile on a square board.
2. Swipe horizontally or vertically to move.
3. When you move you reduce tiles value in the direction you are going.
 - The amount of this reduction is equal to your starting point tile value.
 - But if the value of a tile would be equal to 1 or 2, there will be an increase instead of a decrease.
 - Negative numbers become positive.
 - If the value of a tile becomes equal to zero, starting tile value becomes zero too. Tiles have been "Deleted".
4. You earn as many points as the value of the deleted tiles.
5. The aim is to delete almost every tile while trying to make the most points.
6. In multiplayer matches a player can win by deleting opponent's tile.

apple-macos:1464477788.name: Hacker News HN Reader - HACK
apple-macos:1464477788.description:
HACK for YC's Hacker News (HN) is the most beautiful & easy way to read about the latest tech, startup, coding, developer, & STEM news. 
- No Ads. No subscriptions.
- Login or Register your Hacker News account
- PUSH NOTIFICATIONS for HN replies to comment or post
- Supported on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Setting to block AI posts on HN.
- Comments are presented in nested threads
- Tap a comment to collapse that thread
- Swipe left or right on stories and comments to upvote and favorite
- Ability to submit new posts including drafts
- Long press a story, link or comment to share
- iPad supports split view 
- On iPads, you can drag a story / comment / story's image (link) to open it in safari in split view. This is useful for when you are viewing the app in split view / multitasking and like opening the link / story / comment in a browser side by side.
- Landscape and Portrait support
- 3D touch for peek, pop support
- Home screen 3D touch shortcuts
- Hide posts from the feed
- Tap the bottom button to scroll to the next root comment in the thread. Long press it to go to the previous one
- All known hacker news endpoints - News, front page, Ask HN, Show HN, Show HN Newest, classic, active, best stories, best comments, new stories, new comments, noob stories, noob comments, jobs, over 100-500 points
- Submit posts, reply, comment using your HN account
- Browse top 100 leader accounts
- Browse stories from a specific site, user or date
- Search in comments and usernames! Search is case and diacritic insensitive and ignores punctuations. Search uses an CONTAINS, OR operation if multiple words are typed.
- Can select / highlight the comment/post title text for lookup/copy/translate etc iOS native operations.
- Powerful search (powered by Algolia API) - use @date to sort by date, #story to filter for stories, #comments to filter for comments, #author_username to filter by user etc. These tags can be separated by commas. Refer to https://hn.algolia.com/api for more tags.
- Dark mode - both pure black and gray mode
- Low contrast text mode to make the text not be pure white
- Many color choices & color picker for customization
- App icons in variety of colours for light and dark mode
- Font choices
- Ability to change font sizes, padding etc to make the layout as compact as you like!
- Threaded comments with color bar to maintain visual orientation
- Articles open in Safari view with setting to automatically open in "readability" mode
- Tap the domain in a story to see all stories from that site
- Tap the username in a story or comment to go to the user profile
- Browse your submitted stories and comments, favorited stories and comments, upvoted stories and comments
- Archive: View an archive of the post website. archive.is, archive.org & google cache.
- Share comment as image
- Articles can be opened in built in safari or 3rd party browsers. Supports Brave, Firefox, Firefox Focus, Orion, Opera Touch, Dolphin, DuckDuckGo, iCab Mobile, Microsoft Edge and Chrome. Go to settings > Disable the "Use in-app Safari" setting > tap that row to change the default browser.
All stories and comments are via Algolia API and Hacker News API:
https://news.ycombinator.com/ 
https://hn.algolia.com/api
https://github.com/HackerNews/API
Profile picture robots lovingly delivered by Robohash.org
There are ongoing costs of developing and maintaining HACK. I am a small indie developer and need your help keep the lights on. I offer a beautiful app for the absolute best user-experience. I don't use intrusive ads, trackers, third-party analytics, subscriptions, or other nonsense. I need to run my own server for caching high quality favicons shown in the app plus for push notifications for replies to hacker news posts. If you can afford it, please support me by purchasing the one-time-only in-app-purchase or giving me a tip. No subscriptions. It's a small and fair amount which helps cover development costs of future updates.
Contact me at:
pran@pranapps.com

apple-macos:6786014573.name: WeatherBlend
apple-macos:6786014573.description:
WeatherBlend helps you make better weather decisions by combining forecasts from more than 50 trusted weather models and open weather services into one intelligent forecast.
Instead of relying on a single weather provider, WeatherBlend compares multiple forecasts, calculates a blended result and shows how confident the prediction is based on how closely the models agree.
Whether you’re planning your day, travelling, exercising, gardening, sailing, fishing or simply deciding what to wear, WeatherBlend gives you a more complete picture of the weather, your environment and outdoor conditions.
Key features
• Intelligent WeatherBlend forecast based on 50+ weather models
• Forecast confidence showing how closely weather models agree
• Current weather, hourly forecasts and detailed 10-day forecast
• Temperature, precipitation, wind, cloud cover and weather conditions
• Air Quality Index (AQI)
• UV Index
• Sea and bathing water temperatures
• Pollen forecasts
• WeatherBlend Migraine Index (WMI)
• Personalized weather recommendations
• Outdoor ratings for running, cycling, hiking, golf, gardening, fishing, sailing, surfing, beach days and much more
• Nature insights including jellyfish, mosquitoes, ticks, wasps and thrips, adapted to your region
• Health insights including asthma, heat stress, cold stress, dehydration and sunburn risk
• Home & Energy insights including solar production, wind production, cooling demand and more
• Unlimited favourite locations
• Fast worldwide city search
Why WeatherBlend?
No weather forecast is perfect. Every weather model has strengths and weaknesses.
WeatherBlend combines more than 50 weather models into a single intelligent forecast while showing how much confidence you can place in each prediction.
When the models agree, you can plan with greater confidence. When they disagree, you’ll know before the weather surprises you.
Whether you’re checking today’s forecast, planning a hike, monitoring pollen, tracking air quality or deciding if it’s safe to swim, WeatherBlend helps you make better decisions every day.
Download WeatherBlend today.

flathub:io.github.mukonqi.nottodbox.name: Nottodbox
flathub:io.github.mukonqi.nottodbox.description:
Nottodbox allows you to create and organize notes, to-dos, and diaries with rich text support in popular formats.
 In today's fast-paced world, we often have multiple tasks to handle simultaneously. That's why you can open multiple documents at once in the desired row x column layout.
 You can change the style and color scheme of the application to make it feel more like home.
 All customization options for documents/notebooks:
 You can mark a to-do as completed or uncompleted.
 You can add a content lock to a document to turn it into a diary. This prevents the backup from being changed.
 Documents are automatically saved unless you are editing a outdated diary and have disabled this feature. Additionally, a backup of the old content is always retained. Furthermore, auto-saves do not overwrite backups, meaning your manual changes remain intact.
 Documents can be in three formats: Markdown, HTML, and plain-text.
 Documents can be exported in multiple formats to your 'Documents' or 'Desktop' folder if you enable this feature. This allows you to edit them in other applications as well.
 You can pin your favorite documents/notebooks to the sidebar for easy access.
 You can change the background, text, and border colors of the document/notebook in three different states: normal, hover, and click
 And here's the most important part! All documents are associated with a notebook, and all options can follow it. All documents/notebooks can use the default settings or follow the global settings. With them, you can to customize so many things with ease.

flathub:io.github.totoshko88.RustConn.name: RustConn
flathub:io.github.totoshko88.RustConn.description:
RustConn is a modern connection manager for Linux. Manage SSH, RDP, VNC, SPICE, MOSH, Telnet,
 Serial, WinRM, Web, Kubernetes, and Zero Trust connections from a single application. Terminals,
 RDP and VNC sessions and web pages open inside the window; SPICE sessions open in an external viewer
 (remote-viewer). Some features use other command-line tools, such as a cloud provider's CLI for
 Zero Trust connections or a password manager's client.
 Organize connections into groups and tags, split terminals side by side, automate tasks with
 expect scripts and command snippets, and synchronize configurations across devices via Cloud Sync.
 Import from Remmina, Asbru-CM, MobaXterm, Royal TS, SSH config, Ansible inventory, CSV, RDP files,
 or libvirt.
 SSH, MOSH, Telnet, Serial, and Kubernetes terminals with scrollbar and font zoom
 Embedded RDP and VNC sessions with external client fallback, and SPICE through remote-viewer
 Zero Trust tunnels: AWS SSM, GCP IAP, Azure Bastion, Cloudflare, Teleport, Tailscale, and
 more
 Cloud Sync via shared directories (Google Drive, Syncthing, Nextcloud, Dropbox)
 Tab Overview, Tab Pinning, Split View, and cluster commands for managing many sessions
 Credential storage via KeePassXC, GNOME Keyring, Bitwarden, 1Password, Passbolt, or Pass
 SFTP file browser with split-panel navigation and remote host monitoring
 Embedded web browser connections, with an optional SOCKS5 proxy or SSH tunnel
 WinRM sessions, and Run Local Script to run a script from your computer on a remote host
 Session recording, text highlighting, Wake-on-LAN, and custom terminal themes

flathub:org.ghidra_sre.Ghidra.name: Ghidra
flathub:org.ghidra_sre.Ghidra.description:
Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework. This framework includes
 a suite of full-featured, high-end software analysis tools that enable users to
 analyze compiled code.
 Capabilities include disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting,
 along with hundreds of other features. Ghidra supports a wide variety of processor
 instruction sets and executable formats and can be run in both user-interactive and
 automated modes. Users may also develop their own Ghidra plug-in components and/or
 scripts using Java or Python.

flathub:org.kde.digikam.name: digiKam
flathub:org.kde.digikam.description:
digiKam is an advanced open-source digital photo management application that runs on Linux,
 Windows, and MacOS. The application provides a comprehensive set of tools for importing, managing,
 editing, and sharing photos and raw files. You can use digiKam’s import capabilities to easily
 transfer photos, raw files, and videos directly from your camera and external storage devices (SD
 cards, USB disks, etc.). The application allows you to configure import settings and rules that
 process and organize imported items on-the-fly.
 digiKam organizes photos, raw files, and videos into albums. But the application also features
 powerful tagging tools that allow you to assign tags, ratings, and labels to photos and raw files.
 You can then use filtering functionality to quickly find items that match specific criteria.
 In addition to filtering functionality, digiKam features powerful searching capabilities that
 let you search the photo library by a wide range of criteria. You can search photos by tags, labels,
 rating, data, location, and even specific EXIF, IPTC, or XMP metadata. You can also combine several
 criteria for more advanced searches. digiKam rely on Exiv2 library and ExifTool to handle metadata
 tag contents from files to populate the photo library.
 digiKam can handle raw files, and the application uses the excellent LibRaw library for decoding
 raw files. The library is actively maintained and regularly updated to include support for the
 latest camera models. digiKam can also manage video files for cataloging purpose, and the application
 uses the FFmpeg backends to extract metadata and play media.
 The application provides a comprehensive set of editing tools. This includes basic tools for
 adjusting colors, cropping, and sharpening as well as advanced tools for, curves adjustment, panorama
 stitching, and much more. A special tool based on Lensfun library permit to apply lens corrections
 automatically on images. The famous Gmic-Qt plugin is also available with more than 600 filters
 to extend your creativity. All editing operations in digiKam are versioned.
 Extended functionality in digiKam is implemented via a set of tools based of plugins mechanism
 (named DPlugins for digiKam Plugins). Plugins can be written to import and export contents to remote
 web-services, add new features to edit image, and batch process photo.
 Features:
 Organization of photos in albums and sub-albums (with tags and comments support)
 Support for Exif, Iptc, Xmp, Makernotes
 SQLite or Mysql powered storage for the album contents and its metadata with advanced search
 tools
 Support for filtering and sorting albums
 Import from more than 1100 digital camera devices
 Support for more than 900 RAW format pictures
 Light Table to compare photo side by side
 Extended features using extra tools
 Share your photos using HTML or publishing them to remote web services
 Image editor included with advanced tools to fix photo quickly

flathub:work.worklog.worklog.name: Work Log
flathub:work.worklog.worklog.summary: Track your work sessions with hierarchical time organization
flathub:work.worklog.worklog.description:
Work Log is a native KDE application designed to help you track and organize your work sessions with a focus on simplicity and local data control. Whether you're a freelancer tracking billable hours, a developer logging coding sessions, or anyone who wants to maintain a detailed record of their work, Work Log provides an intuitive interface for capturing what you've accomplished.
 The application organizes your work sessions in a hierarchical tree structure (Year → Month → Week → Day), making it easy to browse your work history and see patterns over time. Each session can include the time spent (in half-hour increments), a description of what you worked on, detailed notes in Markdown format, and what you plan to do next.
 All data is stored locally in a SQLite database on your computer, giving you complete control and privacy. The application is built with Qt and KDE Frameworks, providing a responsive and native experience on Linux desktops.
 Features:
 Hierarchical navigation by year, month, week, and day for easy browsing
 Record work sessions with time (0.5 hour increments), description, notes, and next planned stage
 Organize sessions with custom tags for categorization
 View statistics including total hours per day, week, and month
 Calendar popup for easy date selection
 SQLite database for reliable local storage with no cloud dependencies

fedora-packages:blis/blis-serial64.name: blis-serial64
fedora-packages:blis/blis-serial64.description: BLIS is a portable software framework for instantiating high-performance BLAS-like dense linear algebra libraries. While BLIS exports a new BLAS-like API, it also includes a BLAS compatibility layer which gives application developers access to BLIS implementations via traditional BLAS routine calls. This packaging contains automatically-dispatched architecture-optimized kernels for some targets, notably recent x86_64. This is the serial version with a 64-bit integer interface.

fedora-packages:boost/boost-b2.name: boost-b2
fedora-packages:boost/boost-b2.description: B2 (formerly Boost.Jam) is the low-level build engine tool for Boost.Build. Historically, B2 was based on on FTJam and on Perforce Jam but has grown a number of significant features and is now developed independently.

It includes library management, format conversion, news feeds to ebook conversion as well as e-book reader sync features. Calibre is primarily a ebook cataloging program. It manages your ebook collection for you. It is designed around the concept of the logical book, i.e. a single entry in the database that may correspond to ebooks in several formats. It also supports conversion to and from a dozen different ebook formats. Supported input formats are: MOBI, LIT, PRC, EPUB, CHM, ODT, HTML, CBR, CBZ, RTF, TXT, PDF and LRS.

This package contains the library for tools that use HEALPix C bindings.

firefox-addons:3114647.name: PrivacyNotes
firefox-addons:3114647.summary: Save web pages as encrypted notes or bookmarks, and copy your logins, cards and SSH keys from your PrivacyNotes vault.
firefox-addons:3114647.description:
PrivacyNotes in your browser. Save the page you are reading to your PrivacyNotes account, and copy or fill your PrivacyNotes logins for the site you are on.
SAVE PAGES
- Save the page as a note, with its main text and pictures, or as a bookmark.
- Save only the text you selected.
- It reads the tab you have open, so it also saves pages behind a login.
- Use the right-click menu, or the keyboard: Alt+Shift+P saves the page as a note, Alt+Shift+G makes a password and copies it, Alt+Shift+K locks the vault.
YOUR VAULT IN THE BROWSER
- See the logins, cards, SSH keys and bookmarks from your PrivacyNotes vault, with the ones for this site first.
- Copy a username, password or 2FA code with one click. The clipboard is cleared after 30 seconds if it still holds what you copied.
- Choose Fill, or press Alt+Shift+L, and it types the login for the site you are on into the page.
- Make a strong password with the same generator as the app.
- It never fills forms by itself.
- Unlock with a PIN, or with your fingerprint or face where your browser supports it. It locks again after the time you choose.
HOW IT KEEPS YOUR NOTES SAFE
The extension never holds the key that opens your notes. It locks each clip before it leaves your browser, with a key only your apps can open, and one of your apps turns it into a note at its next sync. Your logins reach the extension as a second encrypted copy under a separate key that opens nothing else.
GET STARTED
Open Settings > Extension in PrivacyNotes, pick what the extension may do, then choose Make a code. Paste the one-time code into the extension. It needs a PrivacyNotes account: https://privacynotes.app/

firefox-addons:520576.name: AdGuard AdBlocker
firefox-addons:520576.summary: Unmatched adblock extension against advertising and pop-ups. Blocks ads on Facebook, Youtube and all other websites.
firefox-addons:520576.description:
AdGuard ad blocker effectively blocks all types of ads on all web pages, even on Facebook, YouTube, and others!
 What AdGuard ad blocker does: 
 Blocks all ads: video ads (including YouTube video ads), rich media advertising, unwanted pop-ups, banners and text ads (including Facebook advertisements);
 Speeds up page loading and saves bandwidth, thanks to the missing ads and pop up windows;
 Blocks many spyware, adware, and dialer installers;
 Protects your privacy by blocking common third-party tracking systems;
 Protects you from malware and phishing.
 How can AdGuard ad blocker protect your privacy? 
Just enable Tracking Protection filter in AdGuard settings. It completely removes all forms of tracking from the Internet. AdGuard has one of the largest tracker filters containing more than 5,000 rules.
 How to remove social media with AdGuard? 
Tired of all the «Like» buttons and similar widgets infesting all of your frequented web pages? Just enable AdGuard "Social media filter" and forget about them.
 How can AdGuard ad blocker protect you from online threats? 
At the moment we’ve got more than 2,000,000 harmful websites on record. AdGuard can block domains known to spread malware, protecting your computer against viruses, Trojan horses, worms, spyware, and adware. AdGuard really lowers the risk of virus infections and prohibits access to harmful websites to prevent potential attacks.
 Why does AdGuard require permissions? 
 Access your data for all websites and Access browser tabs : both permissions are necessary for AdGuard to apply all kinds of cosmetic processing to the pages content. Naive ad blocking would simply block ad servers, and leave broken elements and first-party ads on the pages. AdGuard applies special cosmetic rules to make pages look clean and tidy.
 Access browser activity during navigation : this permission is necessary to keep track of navigation events in order to apply rules when the time is right.
Release notes:
 https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardBrowserExtension/releases 
Free and Open Source:
 https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardBrowserExtension 
Found a bug? Have a problem and need help? Please report it:

firefox-addons:2977115.description:

Inspection of recommended HTTP security headers (such as Content Security Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and others)
Verification of HTTPS usage and detection of potential mixed content
Heuristic detection of common JavaScript libraries and their versions based on loaded resources
Simple security score to help identify areas that may require attention

Designed to provide a simplified inspection experience, the extension helps users analyze React component structures, review interface hierarchies, and explore frontend rendering behavior directly within the browser without the complexity of large debugging suites.

It is especially useful for frontend learners, UI developers, and testers who want a fast and minimal environment for studying React application layouts, debugging interface structures, or reviewing component relationships during development.
Optimized for lightweight performance, React Developer Tools Lite focuses on delivering essential inspection workflows while minimizing browser resource usage. The streamlined design makes it suitable for educational use, prototype testing, quick debugging sessions, and frontend experimentation within Mozilla Firefox environments.
Features:
• Lightweight React component inspection tool
• View React component hierarchies and structures
• Simplified interface for frontend debugging workflows
• Inspect basic props and state information
• Useful for learning React application architecture
• Helps analyze UI rendering and component relationships
• Minimal browser resource consumption during use
• Streamlined workflow for rapid frontend inspection
• Beginner-friendly interface for React developers
• Supports debugging and educational development tasks
• Compatible with modern React-based web applications
• Designed for Mozilla Firefox development environments
This extension is intended for development, testing, and educational purposes only. It provides simplified inspection utilities and may not include the full functionality of advanced React debugging platforms.

bluejetty:00023621:ios.description:
Paris Match, l’app de toutes les histoires vraies.
Plongez dans l’actualité autrement avec la nouvelle application Paris Match. Retrouvez les grands reportages, les célébrités, les faits de société, la culture, l’international et les images qui marquent leur époque.
Nos rubriques et contenus :
• Actualités : Politique, société, environnement, international, économie, sport, santé, sciences… découvrez toute l’actualité en continu.
• People : Suivez toute l’actu people, nos interviews de stars et les actualités des têtes couronnées.
• Royal Blog : Retrouvez toute l’actu royauté en Espagne, au Royaume-Uni, à Monaco, en Belgique, en Suède, en Norvège…
• Culture : Cinéma, séries, musique, spectacles, livres, art… Profitez de critiques de films, de bandes-annonces et de reportages sur les grands événements comme le Festival de Cannes.
• Lifestyle : Notre rubrique lifestyle regroupe de nombreux articles mode, voyage, art de vivre et gastronomie.
• Photos : Retrouvez l’actualité en images, les photos de vos personnalités préférées ainsi que les grands reportages photos qui font le succès de la marque.
• Rétro : Avec Rétro Match, explorez les archives du magazine depuis le 25 mars 1949. Une plongée dans la mémoire des Français à travers nos grands reportages, nos rencontres historiques et nos plus célèbres couvertures.
Les fonctionnalités de l’application :
• Un fil photo et vidéo immersif
Faites défiler les histoires, explorez les coulisses et passez d’un sujet à l’autre dans une expérience pensée pour le mobile.
• 77 ans d’archives
Retrouvez en un instant un nom, un événement, une photo ou un souvenir parmi toutes les histoires racontées par Paris Match.
• Des alertes personnalisées
Suivez l’actualité du monde, vos personnalités préférées et les sujets qui vous passionnent pour ne rien manquer.
• Votre historique de lecture
Retrouvez facilement tous vos articles, reportages et diaporamas consultés pour reprendre votre lecture à tout moment.
• Le magazine en intégralité
Accédez au magazine hebdomadaire en avant-première dès 20h le mercredi et retrouvez également les anciens numéros dans la même application (contenus réservés aux abonnés).
Depuis 77 ans, Paris Match raconte les grandes et les petites histoires de notre époque avec une signature unique : le poids des mots, le choc des photos.
Téléchargez la nouvelle application Paris Match et emportez toutes les histoires vraies dans votre poche.

• profitez de Paris Match sans publicité dans l’application
• accédez à tous les contenus de l’application et de http://parismatch.com 
• consultez le magazine en format numérique dès le mercredi à 20h
• recevez nos newsletters thématiques hebdomadaires, Match Politique et Royal Mail

Votre abonnement est automatiquement reconduit, sauf si cette option est désactivée au moins vingt-quatre heures avant la fin de la période en cours. * Google, Outlook, iCal, Yahoo, iCloud - Fast Sync.
* Create Events using Natural Language.
* Universal app: iPhone, iPad, iPad mini, iPad Pro.
* Events & Reminders. 
* List, Day, Week, Agenda, Year and Month views.

* Apple Watch
* Notification Center Widget

* Intuitive gestures to change display.
* FaceID & TouchID Protection. 
* Create image of month view to use as your phones wallpaper.

* Personalize the colors, fonts and pictures of your display.
* Send Email of your events.
* Send .ics iCalendar files of your events.
 -- LIVE YOUR BEST LIFE --
_______________________________________
PLEASE NOTE: 
- To Stop Old Events Being Removed: 
You need to go into the Calendars section in the main device Settings app and then set 'Sync' to 'All Events'.
- THIS IS NOT A FREE APP. DOWNLOAD THE LITE VERSION FOR FREE TO SEE IF YOU LIKE IT BEFORE YOU DECIDE TO PURCHASE. THE LITE VERSION IS FULLY FUNCTIONAL EXCEPT THAT IT CONTAINS ADVERTS AND RESTRICTS THE NUMBER OF EVENTS THAT CAN BE CREATED AND ADDED TO YOUR CALENDARS. A SMALL IN-APP UPGRADE CAN BE PURCHASED TO REMOVE THE RESTRICTIONS AND ADVERTS. THE COMPLETE CURRENT AND NEXT YEAR'S CALENDARS ARE THEN INCLUDED WITH THE INITIAL FULL VERSION UPGRADE PURCHASE. SUBSEQUENT CALENDAR YEARS ARE AVAILABLE AS A SMALL IN-APP PURCHASE. YOU WILL ALWAYS BE DISPLAYED THE COST IN YOUR LOCAL CURRENCY, BEFORE BEING ASKED TO CONFIRM ANY IN-APP PURCHASE.
To allow our users to further customise their app to meet their specific needs and interests, there is also a separate Add-on available called the ‘Calendar Store’ provided by SchedJoules. It contains a large selection of great holiday, sport fixtures, weather & lifestyle calendars. These calendars can be set up so they are displayed alongside your other personal calendar events. You can purchase access to the ’Calendar Store’ Add-on for 1 year with a yearly auto-renewable subscription. You get full and ongoing access to the ‘Calendar Store’, including live updates. The 1 year subscription to the ‘Calendar Store’ Add-on starts at $1.99 (Prices may vary by location) and begins with a one-month free trial, so you can try before you buy. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase after the 1 month free trial. Subscriptions to the Add-on automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed. You can manage your subscription and turn off the auto-renew for the 'Calendar Store' Add-on at any time from your iTunes Account Settings. Full Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy are available at www.ovalkey.com/terms-of-service and www.ovalkey.com/privacy-policy respectively.

bluejetty:00097009:ios.description:
One wrong tap and your slots are full! Are you smart enough to untangle the ultimate 3D screw jam?
Welcome to Nuts & Bolts: Screw Master 3D, a deeply satisfying mechanical puzzle game that blends relaxing ASMR physics with sharp logic challenges. Forget boring flat blocks—rotate, inspect, and unscrew intricate 3D models ranging from cozy houses and classic cars to delicious food and plants!
HOW TO PLAY
• Inspect & Twist: Rotate the 3D object freely to spot hidden pins and bolts.
• Unscrew in Order: Tap to remove nuts and bolts in the exact sequence to make the plates drop.
• Match & Sort: Group screws by color into matching toolboxes to clear the board.
• Watch Your Dock: Keep your holding slots open! If all slots fill up, the board locks and it's game over.
KEY FEATURES
• Thousands of Handcrafted Levels: Progress from relaxing warm-up stages to hardcore brain-teasing boss puzzles.
• Diverse 3D Models: Enjoy colorful, creative 3D objects instead of repetitive geometric shapes.
• Build & Decorate: Unlock unique decor buildings and upgrade them with stars to multiply your rewards.
• Satisfying ASMR Experience: Crisp metallic clicks, smooth animations, and tactile feedback with every turn.

bluejetty:00175510:ios.description:
Welcome to Decor Match! A free home design game that lets you design, decorate and personalize your dream home! All kinds of rooms are waiting for you to decorate, express your creativity and allow you to improve your design skills! Solve a variety of match-3 levels with some quick thinking and smart move choices to unlock your dream rooms! 
If you love home decoration, you will love Decor Match!
GAME FEATURES:
Decorate and Design
- We provide a range of personalized color and style choices! Decorate and design your home as an interior designer, using your unique decor skills to style your dream home!
- Choose every object’s color and style in a room. Design and decorate both the interior and exterior of your home! From floor to ceiling and wall to wall!
- We have many different rooms in Decor Match for you to design and decorate, such as a bedroom, living room, kitchen, and more! What you do with them is up to you!
- Fashionable furniture with various color schemes and styles, from the most classical to the modernist!
- Take a photo of your room, save your designs, and collect them all! It will bring you unlimited home design ideas! 
Swipe and Match
- Match and solve addictive and colorful Match 3 puzzle levels! Hundreds of challenging match-3 levels with fun obstacles so you'll never get bored!
- Test your wits and matching skills! Plan your moves by matching 3 or more in a row, and unlock more rooms by beating more match 3 levels!
- Collect coins in Bonus Levels! Match 4 or more to get powerful boosters and create explosive combos to wipe the board!
Discover and Explore
- Many different room styles with both indoor and outdoor locations, decorate your dream home as a professional interior designer!
- Each room has its own story and name, learn about different interior design styles in Decor Match!
Other Features
- Share your designs with others on any social networking or messaging app such as Facebook, Instagram, Discord, and Twitter. Let more people see your inspired designs!
- Come up with creative home design ideas and make them a reality!
Calling on all designers! Decor Match is free to play now! Whether you want to decorate, design, or create the home of your dreams, Decor Match is the perfect way to spend your free time! 
Want to learn more about the game? Join our community! Get inspiration from seeing others’ rooms and discussions!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Decor-Match-110865144808363
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/decor_match/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/JpTtTU4XXW
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DecorMatch
Need some help? Contact our support via in-game settings or send us an email at decormatch.support@zentertain.net.

bluejetty:00180156:ios.description:
Discover what to see, plan a day around your interests, and explore on foot with walking itineraries and an interactive city map. Less time planning. More time enjoying the trip.
- Personalized day plans based on your interests and available time.

EXPLORE ONE STOP AT A TIME
Pick a walking itinerary, preview its stops and walking times, and see how it fits into your day. Use the map to put each place in context and find your next stop as you explore.
KNOW MORE BEFORE YOU GO
Find out what makes each place worth a visit, check practical details and estimated visit times, and decide where to spend your time.
Download your travel companion and make your next day out your own.

- Multiple Modes:
Tackle time trials, drift challenges, and unlock new levels as your skills improve. Practice or push your limits, your way.
- Immersive Sound & Visuals:
Engage with immersive 3D visuals, engine roars, and drifting soundscapes for a truly authentic racing experience.

bluejetty:00125529:ios.summary:
The world's first drone Remote ID scanner made by Dronetag.
_____
READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING!
Limited access to features on some phones is caused by manufacturers’ restrictions. All iOS phones, for example, prohibit app access to Wi-Fi, so o
bluejetty:00125529:ios.description:
The world's first drone Remote ID scanner made by Dronetag.
_____
READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING!
Limited access to features on some phones is caused by manufacturers’ restrictions. All iOS phones, for example, prohibit app access to Wi-Fi, so only Bluetooth data transmission will work (if and only the drone has an active Remote ID over Bluetooth). It is not a flaw of our app; we cannot fix this, and we don’t deserve negative reviews for these issues.
_____
Transform your phone or tablet into a drone scanner and track all the nearby flights over Direct / Broadcast Remote ID standards. Browse real-time data about drones on a detailed map highlighting specific flying space zones. Download Drone Scanner for free and discover what drones fly above your head.
Favourite features:
- Discover more about drones flying nearby in real-time
- Examine detailed information broadcasted by drones via Bluetooth 4, Bluetooth 5, Wi-Fi Beacon, and Wi-Fi NAN
- Browse a detailed map with your location and all nearby aircraft
- Check available data about drones, including real-time height, direction, pilot identification, pilot position, operation description, and location history
- Various flying zones marked and highlighted on the map
- Easy export of collected data
- Continuously updated to reflect the latest EU & US regulations
All these features you find in Drone Scanner – a free app for tracking drones. The app is developed by Dronetag, manufacturing devices for remote drone identification.
How it works:
Anyone can quickly identify what drones are flying in the sky nearby. Direct Remote ID is a feature that transmits live flight data via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi to the surrounding area. Drone manufacturers use various technologies to build an identification feature in new drones. Older drone pilots use add-on devices, enabling them to become digitally visible. With hardware on your smartphone, Drone Scanner can receive and read broadcasted data.

bluejetty:00069854:ios.summary: Multiplayer spin-off of hit – Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight – which has been downloaded by over million players across the globe. Warplanes: Online Combat brings back intuitive controls, beautiful graphics and over 80 planes from World War II and
bluejetty:00069854:ios.description:
Multiplayer spin-off of hit – Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight – which has been downloaded by over million players across the globe. Warplanes: Online Combat brings back intuitive controls, beautiful graphics and over 80 planes from World War II and beyond. Collect, customize and unlock planes from major nations involved in WW2. Fly cult classics like Spitfire, Il-2 “Sturmovik”, P-40, Ju 87 or “Stuka” and P-38. Game also features post-war and prototype machines like MiG-15, F-86 Sabre and flying saucer “Haunebu II”. All planes are available in various competitive and cooperation modes.
● Deathmatch – a classic PvP mode, everyone is your enemy, time is of the essence.
● Team Deathmatch – gather your squadron and defeat the enemy team.
● Last Man Standing – a Battle Royale mode variation, most challenging with respawns set to none.
● Community Co-Op – play missions created by community with players across the globe.
Gather experience and military ranks, unlock medals, climb on the leaderboards to become ultimate pilot.
No loot-boxes or premium ammunition makes the rules plain and simple, your skill and determination is key to your success.
FIGHT ONLINE, BE THE BEST PILOT
● Awaited multiplayer spin-off of hit Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight.
● Popular modes like Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch and Battle Royale.
● Over 80 historical planes from RAF, Luftwaffe, American, Japanese and Soviet Air Forces, with various customization, paint and upgrade options.
● Dozens of maps with different climate, layout, weather and time of day.
● Create your own missions and campaigns within an easy to learn editor.
● Detailed 3D graphics optimized for older devices.

bluejetty:00070471:ios.description:
iOSHO – Revolutionary Meditation Approach for Contemporary People
iOsho represents a revolution in making meditation, mindfulness, awareness and consciousness available as a daily life experience for contemporary people.
It has tools to help you dissolve whatever is blocking your meditation with active meditations that allow you to express and release your accumulated stress and tensions – and then discover the silent center within.
You can learn the “knack” of being a witness to the body and then the mind, with its thoughts and feelings while listening to OSHO Talks.
And if you need support with a personal issue, you can use two transformative tarot card games to gain clarity and understanding.
What Your Subscription Includes:
OSHO Radio
Silence Shared in Words – 24/7
OSHO Radio plays Osho Talks continuously. A new series is uploaded every week. Your subscription includes English and Hindi talks.
OSHO iMeditate
Enjoy 17 Key OSHO Meditations – plus the daily OSHO Evening Meeting
You have tried just sitting, and it drives you nuts. Those sitting meditations were not created for contemporary people, but for people who lived a long time ago, in a very different world. That is why these OSHO Active Meditations were created. You release whatever emotions are rumbling inside, you dance, you hum, you just let go and feel the delight of then being able to be silent.
OSHOPlay
OSHO Audio Series, Curated Playlist and Music from the World of OSHO
Discover the true essence of Tantra, Yoga, Zen or the Eastern or Western Mystics with hundreds of Osho Talks in English and Hindi. Delve into meditation, learn what it means to understand love, ego, life and death from 17 playlist of most searched topics, create your own playlists – including music from the World of OSHO.
OSHO TV
OSHO Talks on Video
On OSHO TV you can access fifty different OSHO videos at any one time. Answers to questions from seekers, his replies to the press and some very intimate biographical talks. A new video is added each week.
OSHO Zen Tarot
Award Winning Game of Zen
The world’s most popular Zen-based, Tarot Deck.
OSHO Transformation Tarot
60 Illustrated Parables for Everyday Life
OSHO No-Thought for the Day 
Start your day from your center – where your life really happens!
A nudge from Osho on audio & text
ABOUT OSHO
Osho defies categorization. His thousands of talks cover everything from the individual quest for meaning to the most urgent social and political issues facing society today.
Osho has been described by the Sunday Times in London as one of the “1000 Makers of the 20th Century” and by American author Tom Robbins as “the most dangerous man since Jesus Christ.” Sunday Mid-Day (India) has selected Osho as one of ten people – along with Gandhi, Nehru and Buddha – who have changed the destiny of India.
About his own work Osho has said that he is helping to create the conditions for the birth of a new kind of human being..
Osho is known for his revolutionary contribution to the science of inner transformation, with an approach to meditation that acknowledges the accelerated pace of contemporary life. His unique OSHO Active Meditations are designed to first release the accumulated stresses of body and mind.

bluejetty:00071031:ios.description:
The Compass app will allow you to uncover previously undiscovered directions thanks to its convenient GPS location and MGRS coordinates, catering especially to true professionals. 
Harness the power of GPS readings to determine your position across 16 main directions, pinpointing your exact latitude and longitude. The Compass app easily gauges your phone's altitude, introducing what might be the best compass that also operates offline. 
Perfect for camping and campers, this Compass app gives accurate GPS, altitude, and offline navigation. Camping and campers can use azimuth, flashlight, and weather forecasts to navigate. Camping and campers love its minimal mode and reliable readings anywhere, anytime.
Utilize offline guidance to ascertain your location even without your phone! Easily access weather info and air quality, and view moon phases, even in the free version. 
Discover the premium version, ad-free, with access to a 7-day weather forecast, more air quality stations, and all premium wallpapers. 
Navigate your way home effortlessly in the dark with the flashlight feature. Plan the perfect trip using the weather features, and the new azimuth function helps you move efficiently in your planned direction. 
The Compass app utilizes actual GPS positioning, gyroscope, and magnetic field sensor, ensuring precise location pinpointing and the creation of a favorites list. 
These genuine location, altitude, and direction readings also comfortably allow you to pray and find the Qibla direction for free! 
If you appreciate minimalism, you'll delight in our simplified mode, which displays only essential compass views. Weather functionality helps schedule ideal travel times, ensuring you reach home while it's still light. 
What is the Compass app useful for? 
- Weather readings assist in planning attire for the day's activities. 
- Real altitude readings enhance the appreciation of mountain adventures. 
- MGRS coordinates using the magnetic sensor and GPS readings are handy for field games. 
- The Qibla mode helps you find the right direction to stay close to what matters. 
- Personalize the app's themes based on your color preferences. 
- The simplified compass mode ensures easy reading. 
- Azimuth mode is vital for hiking. 
- Customize the main screen's background. 
With this app, exploring new locations has never been so user-friendly.

bluejetty:00063001:ios.description:
Edit photos. Design beautiful collages. Create stunning design layouts.
With BeFunky, you can do it all! Our AI-powered one-tap photo editing tools, intelligent auto-collage features, and professionally made design templates take the complexity out of your creative process.
With BeFunky, there’s NO ADS or registration necessary!
TURN YOUR PHOTOS INTO PAINTINGS, CARTOONS, SKETCHES, AND MORE
BeFunky’s Artsy effects are the most unique feature of our Photo Editor. With one tap, your photos will take on stunning, artistic characteristics. With realistic textures & natural-looking brush strokes, these effects will instantly turn your photo into a work of art!
ENHANCE IMAGES IN A SINGLE TAP
With a single tap, the Image Enhancer intelligently intensify colors, balance exposure, and correct contrast to make your photos stand out. Our Portrait Enhancer does all that AND softens blemishes, whitens teeth, and more.
REMOVE BACKGROUNDS AND ERASE UNWANTED OBJECTS
Easily remove distracting backgrounds, turn a dreary sky into sunshine, and erase unwanted objects. Our AI-powered tools give you the control to make seamless edits.
RETOUCH AND RELIGHT YOUR PORTRAITS
With an entire suite of Touch Up tools, you can make subtle edits to your portrait to bring out their natural beauty. If the lighting isn’t very inspiring, you can re-imagine your scene with the Portrait Relight tool. Go from professional studio lighting to neon glow in a tap.
A FULL SUITE OF PHOTO EDITING TOOLS
While it’s our effects that make headlines, BeFunky is also a full-service photo editor. Crop, Upscale, adjust levels, dodge and burn, and so much more. Everything you need from a photo editor in an easy-to-use package.
ADJUST YOUR PHOTOS WITHOUT LOSING A SINGLE PIXEL
Is your photo slightly crooked or not the right size? Or maybe your subject just needs to be moved a bit to the right. With BeFunky’s Expand, Straighten, and Detach Subject tools, our AI technology fills in the surrounding area, allowing you to keep the entire image intact and make edits with ease.
APPLY EFFECTS AND FILTERS
Find new ways to get creative! You’ll find everything from Vintage and Chromatic effects to B&W and Pop Art filters to transform your photo in seconds.
CREATE PHOTO COLLAGES WITH A SINGLE TAP
Our Collage Wizard generates optimal collage layouts in high resolution without cropping or losing image details. It’s collage technology like no other!
REMOVE BLUR AND IMPROVE SHARPNESS
BeFunky has all the tools to get your photo looking sharp. Deblur to reduce blurriness. Denoise low-light photos to bring out details. Get clear, sharp images in a single tap!
ACCESS HUNDREDS OF FREE FONTS
Our Text Editor has many fonts and customization options to add text to photos, designs, and collages. Choose from our collection of hand-selected fonts by our graphic designers, or upload your own fonts!
FREE TEMPLATES FOR QUICK AND EASY GRAPHIC DESIGN
Our design templates are the perfect starting point for any project, offering thousands of professional templates for birthdays, weddings, social media posts, and more.
BEFUNKY ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Access your stored projects and images across our mobile and desktop apps by logging in to your BeFunky account.
ACCESS HUNDREDS OF ADDITIONAL PREMIUM FEATURES WITH BEFUNKY PLUS
Subscribe to BeFunky Plus monthly or yearly to access premium photo editing, collage-making, and graphic design tools. Access our Plus features across our mobile and desktop apps by logging into your BeFunky account. Start your Plus membership with a free trial! Limited to one free trial per Apple ID. When you start a trial, select a monthly or yearly subscription term. Once the trial ends, you’ll be charged a subscription fee for your Plus subscription that is charged to your App Store account. Your Plus subscription will auto-renew until auto-renew is turned off. You can manage your BeFunky Plus subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://befunky.com/terms

bluejetty:00136523:ios.description:
Sound Oasis® is the world leader in sound therapy systems. We take tinnitus therapy seriously and it is our hope that this application will provide relief for your tinnitus symptoms. This app was designed to complement our BST-400 Stereo Sound Therapy System to provide our military service men and women with even greater tinnitus relief at home or while traveling.
This app provides the following features:
- 25 free “made for tinnitus therapy” sounds, with 10 of them being stereo sounds for greater sound realism.
- A 12-band audio equalizer which allows you to tune the frequency of each sound on this app. This will allow you to customize the sound to better suit your particular tinnitus frequency with the goal of greater hearing comfort as you sleep and relax.
- A white noise overlay sound that you can add to any sound track on this APP.
- Information on how Sound Oasis and other resources can help you manage tinnitus more effectively.
How Does This APP Work?
The sounds in this app can be an effective tool to manage your tinnitus using sound therapy and sound masking to make tinnitus symptoms less noticeable. This masking effect can be particularly effective at night when the surrounding environment is quieter. By listening to pleasant sounds, particularly sounds close to the frequency level of your tinnitus symptoms, your brain will predominantly hear the pleasant sound instead of the annoying tinnitus noise.
25 INCLUDED THERAPEUTIC SOUNDS
- Brown Noise
- Cooling Fan
- Cricket Buffer (Stereo) Forest Rain
- Full Spectrum White Noise Gray Noise
- Hawaii Falls (Stereo)
- Jet Interior
- Natural White Noise
- Niagara Falls (Stereo) Ocean Night (Stereo)
- Ocean Rain
- Ocean Surf with White Noise Ocean and Crickets (Stereo) Pink Noise
- Rain with White Noise
- Song Birds
- Stormy Surf (Stereo)
- Stream with White Noise Summer Night
- Surf in Rain (Stereo) Thunderstorm (Stereo) Violet Noise
- Green Noise (Stereo) Hawaii Surf (Stereo)
SESSION TIMER
- 5 to 120 minute session timer with continuous therapy option.
12 BAND GRAPHIC EQUALIZER WITH INDIVIDUAL SOUND MEMORY
- Control precise frequency levels of sound playback with exclusive 12 band graphic equalizer.
- Tune each sound to your personal frequency levels.
- Automatically save up to 2 of your favorite equalizer settings for each sound.
WHITE NOISE OVERLAY
Allows you to add an adjustable level of white noise to each sound track for even greater tinnitus therapy.
SOFT-OFF VOLUME MANAGEMENT
- Full volume control with soft-off volume management.
FREE ACCESS TO ALL NEW SOUNDS
- Free access to new sounds and features with regular application updates offered through the AppStore.
Disclaimer: this application is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. We assume no liability for any personal harm or injury sustained as a result of using this application.

This app was designed to complement our BST-400 Stereo Sound Therapy System to provide our military service men and women with even greater tinnitus relief at home or while traveling.

This app provides the following features:
- 25 free “made for tinnitus therapy” sounds, with 10 of them being stereo sounds for greater sound realism.
- A 12-band audio equalizer which allows you to tune the frequency of each sound on this app. This will allow you to customize the sound to better suit your particular tinnitus frequency with the goal of greater hearing comfort as you sleep and relax.
- A white noise overlay sound that you can add to any sound track on this APP.
- Information on how Sound Oasis and other resources can help you manage tinnitus more effectively.

How Does This APP Work?
The sounds in this app can be an effective tool to manage your tinnitus using sound therapy and sound masking to make tinnitus symptoms less noticeable. This masking effect can be particularly effective at night when the surrounding environment is quieter. By listening to pleasant sounds, particularly sounds close to the frequency level of your tinnitus symptoms, your brain will predominantly hear the pleasant sound instead of the annoying tinnitus noise.

25 INCLUDED THERAPEUTIC SOUNDS
- Brown Noise
- Cooling Fan
- Cricket Buffer (Stereo) Forest Rain
- Full Spectrum White Noise Gray Noise
- Hawaii Falls (Stereo)
- Jet Interior
- Natural White Noise
- Niagara Falls (Stereo) Ocean Night (Stereo)
- Ocean Rain
- Ocean Surf with White Noise Ocean and Crickets (Stereo) Pink Noise
- Rain with White Noise
- Song Birds
- Stormy Surf (Stereo)
- Stream with White Noise Summer Night
- Surf in Rain (Stereo) Thunderstorm (Stereo) Violet Noise
- Green Noise (Stereo) Hawaii Surf (Stereo)

SESSION TIMER
- 5 to 120 minute session timer with continuous therapy option.

12 BAND GRAPHIC EQUALIZER WITH INDIVIDUAL SOUND MEMORY
- Control precise frequency levels of sound playback with exclusive 12 band graphic equalizer.
- Tune each sound to your personal frequency levels.
- Automatically save up to 2 of your favorite equalizer settings for each sound.

WHITE NOISE OVERLAY
Allows you to add an adjustable level of white noise to each sound track for even greater tinnitus therapy.

SOFT-OFF VOLUME MANAGEMENT
- Full volume control with soft-off volume management.

FREE ACCESS TO ALL NEW SOUNDS
- Free access to new sounds and features with regular application updates offered through the AppStore.

Disclaimer: this application is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. We assume no liability for any personal harm or injury sustained as a result of using this application.

bluejetty:00142750:ios.description:
Readle is a language learning app with real-world news & stories. It is the world's first CEFR-graded reader to help you learn French. Easily read & listen to news & stories anytime, anywhere – Take 5 minutes a day to learn French.
Why Readle? 
• Our language experts turn real-world news & stories into fun & bite-sized A1 – B2 French learning courses tailored to your level.
• Your best companion for reading, listening, comprehension & flashcard vocabulary training with thousands of story courses.
Download Readle for FREE and start to learn French the new way!
==============
Learn languages with stories and be a part of the revolution: 
► EFFECTIVE FRENCH LEARNING THROUGH IMMERSION
Use our scientifically proven immersion method to learn French effectively. Real-world stories & news curated by our language experts and turned into French classes ranging from A1 A2 B1 B2 levels. 
► BITE-SIZED STORY LANGUAGE LEARNING COURSES
+1000 interesting stories & news for you to learn French. Readle allows you to learn them effectively in context, including grammar tips and vocabulary flashcard training.
► PERFECT PRONUNCIATION
Listen to the story audio sentence by sentence. It will help you practice pronunciation and improve your listening skills.
► INSTANT DICTIONARY
Quickly look up a word translation in every article with a tap on the word – the easiest way to learn vocabulary, phrases, verbs, and conjugation. Save your time switching between, Reverso, Leo, Duden, or other French dictionaries.
► GRAMMAR HELPER 
French grammar helpers in each language learning course bring your grammar into action. Learn French grammar quickly from the story context with real examples.
► VOCABULARY LIST & FLASHCARDS
Learn French vocabulary or verb conjugation in the story courses. Use spaced repetition to study a word – a scientifically proven learning method to review and recall vocabulary at an optimal time.
► QUIZ FOR COMPREHENSION
Test your reading comprehension and practice French grammar, vocabulary, and articles (el & la) with quizzes in each story – a great way to challenge your French language skills and prepare yourself for Pipplet, TFI, DELF, DALF or other French language learning exams. 
► STORY LIBRARY & DAILY NEW STORIES 
1000+ news & stories courses for you to learn French in a wide range of topics that are available for language learning: 
- Travel
- Culture
- Food
- Latest News
- Transportation
- Entertainment
- Science and Medical
- Technology
- People
- Parties
Plus many more – add on a daily basis!
Readle is a must-have language learning app for living and traveling in French-speaking countries. Download Readle now and start to learn French!
Questions or comments about learning with Readle? Please email us at support@readle-app.org

bluejetty:00065198:ios.description:
Paytient gives people the power to pay — whenever life happens.
Paytient is a sponsored line of credit for out-of-pocket healthcare costs for the whole family. Our members pay for care over time, always without interest or fees. 
If you’ve been offered a Paytient card at work or through your health plan, your employer or health insurer is paying to give you an interest-free line of credit for healthcare expenses. You read that right — no fees and no interest!
Paytient offers members flexible repayment terms on every transaction. Your Paytient card can cover copays or coinsurance at the time of treatment as well as any costs not covered by insurance. It also works for bills that you receive after your visit.
The benefits of using the Paytient app:
Simple account creation
• Create an account in less than five minutes.
• Activate your Paytient virtual Visa card immediately after account creation. 
• We never check your credit or pull your credit score.
Help when you need it
• In-app chat support is available if you ever have a quick question, concern, or need to make a change.
Account info at your fingertips
• Quickly track your spending and manage active transactions. Your account summary page offers a bird’s-eye view of your Paytient activity, and monthly e-statements provide greater insight.
• Easily access and copy your card info to pay for care with Paytient at home or on the go.
Plenty of payment options
• Choose the source of funds that is best for your needs — automated payments can come directly from your bank account or via payroll deduction.
• If you have a Health Savings Account or Flexible Spending Account, you can also make payments using these tax-advantaged accounts.
• After each transaction with your Paytient card, you set a repayment plan that meets your budget.

Losing a pet is every owner’s worst nightmare, and Crumb is designed to make sure no pet stays lost for long. Whether you're preparing just in case or actively searching, Crumb puts the tools in your pocket to act fast, stay informed, and rally your community.

Easily manage your pet's profile – Store essential details and photos of your pets so you're ready if they ever go missing.
Mark your pet as missing – Send out a local alert with one tap, instantly notifying nearby users, vets and shelters to keep an eye out.

Support local animal charities for free – Refer friends and other pet owners to Crumb and unlock donations to nearby rescues at no cost to you.
Crumb is more than an app... it’s a growing network of pet lovers committed to helping each other. Together, we can make a difference.
Download Crumb today and help bring lost pets home.

bluejetty:00039663:ios.name: Epicentr – Online Shopping
bluejetty:00039663:ios.description:
Home improvement and renovation products, electronics, footwear, clothing, and pet supplies — Epicentr has it all.
The official Epicentr app offers:
– over 3,000,000 in-stock items;
– 24/7/365 access to online shopping;
– pickup readiness in up to 4 hours for online orders (when the item is available at the warehouse of your chosen pickup location);
– free pickup from 80+ order pickup points across Ukraine.
For your convenience, we’ve created a clear and user-friendly Epicentr mobile app with the following features:
ONLINE SHOPPING
With the EpicentrK app, you can shop 24/7 from anywhere — at home, in the office, in your car, or on public transport. Browse the catalogue, use filters and sorting to find what you need, and place an order in seconds. The app saves your contact details, so you won’t need to re-enter them every time — just choose your preferred payment and delivery method. You can pay on receipt, by card online, or via Apple Pay.
VYHODA DIGITAL LOYALTY CARD
Check your points balance in just a few taps. To scan your card at the checkout in an Epicentr shopping center, simply open the app on your smartphone and select VYHODA on the home screen.
PROMOTIONS
The app helps you stay on top of current deals and sales. Just pick an offer you like and save when you buy discounted items.
PURCHASE HISTORY
With a detailed digital receipt showing purchased items and points earned, you can track your spending and monitor bonus point accruals.
MY EPICENTR
Find the address, opening hours, contact details, and directions to your selected shopping center or pickup point — by public transport or by car.
PRODUCT SCANNING
Scan a product barcode in-store (or enter the code manually) to see the current price, get detailed information and specifications, and read reviews.
The Epicentr app is convenient, secure, and useful. After logging in with your phone number, you can find answers to frequently asked questions about the VYHODA card, paying with points, special offers, cashback, and the Safe feature. The app helps you use your time more efficiently and save money. When shopping online, you can choose free pickup and multiple delivery options across Ukraine.
We’ll be happy to receive your feedback, suggestions, and ideas!

bluejetty:00183445:ios.description:
O Appétit Delivery é uma plataforma de Delivery de comida online.
Além de conectar usuários a restaurantes conectamos também restaurantes com entregadores, facilitando o acerto financeiro no final do expediente. Dessa forma você não perde mais tempo conferindo comandas de papel, molhadas em dias de chuva, rasgadas ou até perdidas pelos motoboys.
Use o Appétit Delivery para pedir aquela pizza de quarta-feira, aquele hambúrguer artesanal, ou ainda uma comida mais leve como um Sushi ou aquela vegetariana. Também tem chinesa, árabe, bebidas, doces, sobremesas, pastéis, churros e muito mais, confira!
Seja qual for sua comida preferida, o Appétit Delivery tem!
Além disso, você pode acompanhar o entregador em tempo real!!!! Isso mesmo, assim que o entregador iniciar a sua entrega você poderá acompanhar ele em seu trajeto. Comece agora mesmo:
