bluejetty:00088655:ios.description:
Want to put a little bit more magic into Christmas this year? 
In this fun Christmas app for kids, your child can chat to elves and write a letter or draw a picture and send it to Santa. 
First, your child can choose which of Santa’s favourite elves they would like to chat to. They can choose from:
Sparky: Head of Toy Making
Minty: Head Reindeer Trainer
Ribbon: Head of Santa’s post office
Bubbles: Head Party Planner
Once your child has chosen their elf, they can then start chatting to them.
But what happens if my child wants to change the elf they are speaking to? Not to worry - they can change their elf in the Settings page.
After chatting with the elf, kids can then choose whether they want to send a nice letter or a Christmassy drawing to Santa.
If they choose a drawing, your kids can get creative by changing the background of the picture, add stickers of Christmas characters and draw in lots of different colours.
Once you send to Santa, he will write a response based on the answers to the questions the elf asked your child while they were chatting. Santa's reply will appear in your letterbox immediately, so you don't have to wait! It's magic! 
A maximum of 5 children can send a letter or drawing to Santa.
We are looking forward to bringing Santa closer to home for you and your family!

bluejetty:00134632:ios.description:
Mdagsh is an online social card game with their native mdagsh game, integrated multiple game modes such as baloot, champion session, and voice room.
Mdagsh:
Mdagsh is the biggest highlight of this game app. In the game, the banker need to choose question other players or not according to their own cards, while other players can choose to accept or increase the price. They compare the cards to decide which one is the winner, it’s depends on luck and their choices.
Rewards and Chests:
We provide a lot of free rewards and chests. The users will get rewards after finishing the game task or try different game mode.
Voice chat:
In Mdagsh, our users can chat with others during game time, send gifts to each other and get on the Charm List with their friends.
Baloot:
Brand new team gameplay, divided into two game modes: Domination and Masterless. It is easier to win the game when you cooperate with your teammates.
Dress up:
Our customer can choose different costumes with the localized design.
The game is simple, fun and easy to play, with a variety of methods to play that showcase the player's intelligence, skill and proficiency in the game, ensuring that players will quickly get familiar with this brilliant game and get in love with it.
Mdagsh and baloot are 2 methods of play that give players an unique and realistic multiplayer game experience, with creating an exciting, challenging and competitive atmosphere for players and their friends to enjoy in it.
At the same time, players can experience a wide range of game modes, such as Gold Wheel, Gold and Projects, and Aladdin Lamp and so on guessing games,there are also casual games such as ladders and snakes, and other challenges and competitions.
In mdagsh, players will not only feel relaxed and fun, but also make many sincere and friendly friends. Players can chat in the game via voice or text and send gifts with each other in the game.
So many interesting games and a variety of dress-ups with Gulf Area cultural characteristics are waiting for you to explore, join the game now!
Support@mdagsh.com

bluejetty:00180446:ios.summary:
KUER Public Radio App:

bluejetty:00180446:ios.description:
KUER Public Radio App: 
The KUER Public Radio App allows you to listen to KUER, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for KUER all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for late!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from KUER even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the KUER stream! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to KUER in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access KUER’s programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The KUER Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• Now supports CarPlay!
The KUER Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at KUER and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support KUER Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.kuer.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00017186:ios.description:
Speak brings typed words and sentences to life using your iPhone, iPod or iPad!
Features
• Beautiful, modern and sleek user interface.
• Sliders to adjust the Volume, Pitch and Rate of the voice.
• Option to change the accent/language of the voice.
• Favourite Phrases and Phrase History.
• Repeat feature let's you specify how many times your would like your phrase repeated.
• Share Audio feature allows you to send an audio output recording to your friends and family.
• Loads of settings to allow you to tweak Speak to behave just how you like.
• Support for Slide Over and Split Screen (on appropriate devices).
• Background Audio so you can continue listening to your text whilst your device is locked or you're working on something else.
• VoiceOver support.
• Connect Speak to a Bluetooth speaker/headphones to broadcast your text even further.
If you enjoy using Speak, please consider supporting its development by removing remove ads (in-app purchase from the Settings screen).
Quick Tip: If a word doesn't sound quite right, try spelling it phonetically.
Many of Speak's users have lost their ability to speak (often after surgery) and Speak helps to give them a voice again.
Speak does not require an internet connection, and is always optimised for the latest and greatest devices and software.
Have fun! And feel free to drop me an email with any suggestions or comments: loic@loic.tech
If you find Speak useful or fun please take a moment to give it a quick review!

bluejetty:00187082:ios.summary:
Symantec VIP Access helps protect your online accounts and transactions by using a strong authentication process when you sign in to your VIP-enabled accounts.
• Strong authentication: Provides strong, two-factor authenticat
bluejetty:00187082:ios.description:
Symantec VIP Access helps protect your online accounts and transactions by using a strong authentication process when you sign in to your VIP-enabled accounts.
• Strong authentication: Provides strong, two-factor authentication when logging into your VIP-enabled accounts. 
• QR/App Code: Scan a QR Code to generate site-specific security codes for strong two-factor authentication to your favorite websites.
Use VIP Access at participating organizations such as eBay, PayPal, E*TRADE, Facebook, Google, or any one of the hundreds of sites within the VIP Network: : 
https://vip.symantec.com
Features 
Strong Authentication
VIP Access adds strong authentication to your normal login in one of the following ways: 
• Dynamically generate a one-time use security code on your mobile device. Use that code along with your username and password.
• Receive a push notification on your mobile device that you approve as authentication. If your organization requires you to define an additional device authentication mechanism to meet the security requirements, you will be prompted for the additional local authentication such as passphrases or biometrics.
• Use Touch ID, Face ID, or Passcode in a push notification to authenticate yourself on your mobile device.
Note: Touch ID or Face ID authentication requires that your mobile device is Touch ID or Face ID capable and that you have registered a fingerprint or facial recognition authentication on the device.
The strong authentication method you use depends on the method implemented by your participating organization.
You can generate a security code even if you do not have a network or mobile connection.
QR/App Codes
Scan a QR Code at participating organizations such as Google, Facebook, Amazon, and more to generate a security code every 30 seconds to securely sign in. Enter this security code along with your password to add strong authentication to your favorite websites.
Be sure to read the VIP End User Agreement after downloading VIP Access: https://docs.broadcom.com/doc/end-user-agreement-english

Exocus is a pixel-art, gamified focus timer app. Here, your focus is no longer boring, repetitive, or meaningless because every moment of your focus will transform your very own planet.
Do you struggle with staying motivated when you commit to doing something valuable in the long run, like learning new words, practicing an instrument, working out, or mastering a new language? Initially, you're full of enthusiasm, but soon, your passion wanes. Memorizing words becomes a chore, the instrument is neglected, workouts turn into a burden, and progress in the new language stalls...
You start doubting yourself: “Maybe I just don’t have what it takes to stick with long-term commitments.”
That’s not true! Let us explain the real reasons.
● Lack of Immediate Rewards:
You understand the long-term value of these tasks, but how much does this half-hour of focus matter right now?
● Repetition Leads to Boredom:
When the initial novelty wears off, the repetitive nature of the task can make you feel bored and tired.
● Overly Negative Focus: 
Focusing on what you haven't accomplished rather than acknowledging what you have done can lead to negative self-evaluation and loss of motivation.
Let Exocus Help You!
====== Exocus Solutions ======
Exocus is a gamified focus timer that visualizes your concentration as a planet's evolution, helping you achieve long-term, pain-free focus.
● Emotional Design and Sense of Meaning
After each focus session, you’ll see the story of what happened to your planet during that time. Even five minutes of focus equals 38.53 million years of evolution for your planet, so your focus is crucial. Want to raise the stakes? You can enable “Hardcore Mode,” where failing to focus might cause your planet to be destroyed!
● Stage-Based Incentives
Short-term Incentives: After each focus session, the planet’s landscape changes and tells you its story.
Medium-term Incentives: After several hours of focus, the planet undergoes more significant transformations, like forming magma, oceans, and land.
Long-term Incentives: After around ten hours of focus, the planet completes its evolution. You can then add it to your star system, with each project corresponding to a star system, showcasing your long-term accumulation in that project.
● Continuous Freshness
We offer hundreds of unique planet designs, satisfying your curiosity and desire to collect with constant surprises. See a planet's full appearance only after evolving it through focused efforts. Earn Stardust coins by focusing to unlock new planet seeds, motivating continuous concentration.
====== What Makes Exocus Special? ======
● Meticulously Crafted Design
Exocus uses a unique pixel art style, maintaining simplicity while incorporating delightful little Easter eggs for you to discover. We believe the beauty of Exocus can bring joy, which will ultimately translate into more focused time.
● Fun Game Elements
Exocus embraces gamified design in a bold yet restrained and professional manner. We hope the game elements help you enjoy focusing, and we also care deeply about your ability to truly focus. We’ve eliminated anything that could distract you because we genuinely want to focus on achieving long-term goals with you.
● Flexible Focus Modes
Exocus supports countdown timers, stopwatch mode, and the Pomodoro technique. In the Pomodoro technique, you can flexibly set focus and break durations and specify longer breaks after several focus cycles.
● Convenient Project Management
Each project corresponds to a planet. You can track different categories of focus time with projects and quickly switch between projects on the home screen by swiping left or right.
● Personalized Statistics
Based on your focus data, we provide personalized charts to help you understand your focus patterns and stay motivated to maintain consistent focus.

Forge your battle deck with leg
bluejetty:00096127:ios.description:
Welcome to Arcane Arena TD, a tactical, competitive tower defense PvP game where every choice shapes the TD battle. Build your tower defense strategy, defeat rivals in real-time PvP, and rise through arenas!
Forge your battle deck with legendary tower, skill, and heroes, place perfect paths, and win the TD battle with an epic defense strategy. Every PvP battle challenges your TD strategy. Defend your base from relentless enemy waves longer than your rivals, or crush them before they break through your defense.
BUILD YOUR STRATEGY
Create your battle deck from dozens of tower, skill, and heroes. A sharp defense strategy and the right synergy make every TD battle a victory!
• Towers: Build a tower mix with air and ground targets, stuns, slows, and area damage, so you’re prepared for every enemy type. Select 6 tower that best fit your defense strategy and upgrade each tower with tower cards you earn from PvP battles.
• Heroes: Choose class-matched heroes to support your tower. Upgrade heroes with hero shards from TD battles and amplify your defense strategy.
• Skills: Use powerful skills to defeat enemy waves and turn the battle in your favor at the perfect moment. Upgrade your skills with skill cards collected from TD battles for an even stronger tower defense strategy.
REAL-TIME PvP BATTLE
Face an opponent in a live and fair tower defense battle. Since both sides fight the same enemy waves, the match becomes a duel of strategy. Tactical tower placement, clever defense paths, epic skills, and trick cards form your TD strategy; that’s how you win the PvP tower-defense battle. Hold your defense longer than your rival does, or wipe out every enemy to claim victory.
STRATEGY MEETS LUCK
During each TD battle, choose one of three random tower drawn from your battle deck. Place the tower in the best position and adapt your defense. Smart picks and a flexible defense strategy keep your line of defense unbreakable.
SHAPE THE PATHS, SHAPE THE BATTLE
Control the enemy route with path units. Bend, extend, and shape the road to multiply tower damage and maximize defense uptime. Know your tower stats and ranges, then design a path that fits your TD strategy. Infinite path options mean infinite tower defense ideas.
TRICK CARDS FOR DOMINANCE
Use trick cards to disrupt your rival’s TD strategy. Create pressure, force mistakes, and prove your tower defense mastery. In tight PvP TD battles, a single trick play can secure the win.
LIVE EVENTS, QUESTS & REWARDS
• Explore new maps, arenas, and TD chapters as you level up. Climb the PvP leaderboard and face tougher enemy waves.
• Join events, challenges, and tournaments to earn rewards that upgrade tower, skill, heroes, and strengthen your overall defense strategy.
• Complete daily and weekly quests, gather medals across the season, and unlock even more power for your defense strategy.
CLANS & TEAM PLAY
Join a clan to complete clan quests together. Request donations to power up the tower faster and donate to teammates to earn gold. Coordinate TD strategy, share tower builds, and prepare for higher-tier PvP TD battles.
———
About auto-renewable subscriptions:
We offer two monthly subscriptions—Regular Monthly Letter and Royal Monthly Letter—that auto-renew each month.
• Regular Monthly Letter: 600 Gem Reward; Daily +150 Gem; Daily +1 Glory Drop; Daily +1 Quick Earnings; +20% Offline Earnings; 80% Downgrade Refund
• Royal Monthly Letter: 1200 Gem Reward; Daily +300 Gem; Daily +1 Glory Drop; Daily +3 Quick Earnings; 40% Offline Earnings;100% Downgrade Refund
Fees are charged to your account, vary by country, and are shown before purchase. To stop renewal, turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions at any time in your account settings.
———
Contact Support Team → support@panteon.games
Privacy Policy → https://www.panteon.games/en/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions → https://www.panteon.games/en/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00094743:ios.description:
Hole Eat Satisfying Games – The Ultimate Black Hole Puzzle Adventure!
Get ready for a wildly satisfying and addictive black hole game where your only mission is simple: eat the world. In Hole Eat Satisfying Games, you control a tiny black hole with endless hunger. Start by swallowing tiny objects like fruits, seeds, and small items. As your hole grows, your power increases — until you’re large enough to eat towns, cities, and the entire world.
This isn’t just a simple eating game — it’s a smart and fun puzzle adventure. Whether you’re guiding an adorable capybara, solving hole puzzle stages, or chasing high scores in a race eat format, you’ll need fast thinking, quick reflexes, and better strategy to master each level. It’s the perfect mix of fun, relaxing, and competitive gameplay packed with excitement.
 Start Tiny, Grow Huge
• Begin as a small adorable hole with limited power
• Swallow tiny objects like fruits, seeds, boxes, and more
• As time goes on, your hole grows — bigger and stronger
• Soon you’ll be eating people, houses, cities, and everything in sight
 Master the Puzzle Challenges
• Every level is designed as a clever hole puzzle
• Plan your route, move smart, and focus on target items
• Use your brain to guide tiny holes through obstacles and traps
• With every object you collect, your hole swallowing ability increases
• You’ll need to collect, swallow, and win before time runs out!
Adorable Capybara + Endless Power
• Unlock the ultimate capybara and explore a cute-meets-chaotic world
• Your adorable capybara hole is hungry — feed it fast!
• Enjoy the unique personality of this cute creature in an eating game like no other
• Experience the joy of hole swallowing tiny things, all with the help of your capybara friend
 Beat the Clock – Time Runs Fast
• Each stage is timed — your mission is to swallow all before the clock hits zero
• Think fast, act faster — it's a real eat challenge
• When time runs, only the best hole master will succeed
• Every second counts in this action eat puzzle game
 Super Eat Power & Puzzle Strategy
• Upgrade your hole to unlock super eat abilities
• Use holes power to speed up swallowing and gain size faster
• Outsmart obstacles with a better strategy and puzzle solving skill
• Solve tricky puzzles, gather all items, and become the eat

Gacha Machine

◆ Game features ◆
• FREE CHIPS — Play the game every day to get free chips!
• POKER AGAINST THE CASINO—You and the dealer get five cards each, then the dealer reveals one of their cards. In order to win a game of Caribbean Poker, your hand has to be better than the dealer's!
• NEW RULES, MORE PAYOUTS—Play the familiar five-card stud poker game with a Caribbean twist on your device! Place an ante bet before the cards are dealt and show you want to keep the game going with a Play bet. You can make up to 100x your initial bet if you win in Caribbean Poker!
• MAKE SIDE BETS FOR BIG WINNINGS—Want to win even more chips? With side bets, you can get additional payouts on your Caribbean Poker hands! If your five cards plus the dealer's revealed card make a three of a kind or better, you can get huge payouts of up to x1,000, no matter who wins the round!
• UPPER HAND BET—Did you win a round when the dealer had a pair or better? With an UPPER HAND side bet, you can get an additional x6 payout on your bet in five-card stud poker!
• PVE CASINO GAMES—Enter the oasis of PvE casino games: three-card poker, blackjack, Ultimate Hold'em, roulette, baccarat, slots, video poker, craps, Keno, Pai Gow, or Caribbean Poker, all in one app!
• VIP LEVELS — Get huge bonuses and exclusive access to the latest in-game features!
• FAIR PLAY GUARANTEED—All our games use a Random Number Generator (RNG) and are certified by independent experts. We guarantee the best and fairest Caribbean Poker experience!
• CHAT WITH OTHER PLAYERS—Have even more fun at the casino tables with our convenient in-game chat, instant messenger, and animated emojis. Discuss the hands played or share your emotions with your Caribbean Poker opponents and friends!
• REFERRAL SYSTEM—Invite your friends to play Caribbean Poker, and everyone will get a reward!
• BUILD YOUR PROFILE — Share your successes with friends. Show off how many games you've played, your biggest wins, level, card collections, achievements, property and trophies!
• UNIQUE AVATAR — Create a one-of-a-kind look in the avatar editor.
• QUESTS — Complete daily quests to get free chips!
• EASY TO LEARN—New to stud poker but always wanted to try it? Our simple-to-follow tutorial mode will help you take the first steps in Caribbean Poker!
• NO REGISTRATION—Choose guest mode to play stud poker against the casino immediately after installing the game!
• SINGLE ACCOUNT—Play on different devices. Choose the authorization method that works best for you and start playing Caribbean Poker right away for free!
Want more than Caribbean Poker?
Try our other games for an unforgettable 3D experience:
• TEXAS HOLD'EM POKER—The most popular casino game among professional players! Test your skills in amazing poker tournaments!
• BLACKJACK—A simple game of "21". An exciting 3D game that any blackjack fan is sure to enjoy.
• SLOTS—Explore our themed slots with lots of unique features!
• SET POKER—Play three-card poker against the dealer! Place combination bets and win tons of chips!
• OMAHA POKER—A more dynamic version of poker with 4 cards in a hand. Have more fun with amazing combinations!
• PAI GOW POKER—Get 7 cards and split them into two hands, one hand of 5 cards and one hand of 2 cards. To win Pai Gow Poker, both of your hands have to be better than the dealer's!

bluejetty:00149206:ios.description:
Are you ready to elevate your critical care expertise and ace the CCRN exam?
Archer Review’s CCRN program is designed to help you succeed with expert-led, ANCC-accredited on-demand lectures and interactive webinars. Put your knowledge to the test with our comprehensive QBank, featuring 1,000+ high-yield questions aligned with the AACN test plan. With Archer Review, you’re not just preparing for the exam—you’re building the confidence to provide exceptional care to your critically ill patients!
Over several years, Archer Review has provided affordable and successful courses for nursing students, medical students, nurses, advanced practice providers, and physicians. Archer applies a high-yield focused test preparation strategy to help you prepare SMART. Good test-prep courses need not be pricey, and Archer is moving forward with this single motto. Since 2020, about 200,000 nursing students and nurses have trusted Archer Review and have reported high pass rates.
Archer CCRN products include:
1. Access to 1000+ practice questions that cover concepts directly related to the CCRN exam
 1.1 The power of rationales: In-depth and detailed explanations (rationales). Additional information sections provide extra details, while the body of the rationale provides focused information. Multiple concepts are explained in a single question, so you understand why a specific option is incorrect.
 1.2 Challenging questions: The questions will challenge you, but that is the goal. Learning is enhanced under stress- we use this scientific concept so you study and retain the information better. Review your performance, weak or strong, under previous tests
 1.3 Tutor/ Test and Timed modes: Tutor mode allows you to see the rationale immediately, whereas timed mode simulates the actual testing atmosphere. Create comprehensive tests on the go or take only practice questions from your weak areas via system-based question review.
 1.4 Performance dashboards to analyze your weak and strong areas. System by system breakdown of performance.
2. 13+ hours of on-demand video lectures over 11 modules
 2.1 Video lecture material directly related to concepts from the AACN test plan for the CCRN exam.
 2.2 Each module is broken down into bite-sized, digestible pieces in order to fully customize the learning experience. Choose what you learn on any given study day, with videos broken down by concept area.
3. Free live webinars
 3.1 Webinars enable an interactive learning environment where you can test your knowledge alongside peers and the instructor.

bluejetty:00036545:ios.description:
Decibel Shield™ : Sound Level Meter
Discover the power of sound around you with Decibel Shield™ , the free and user-friendly app designed to make noise level measurement simple and insightful. Whether you're monitoring workplace noise, checking the volume at events, or just curious about everyday sound levels, Decibel Shield™ offers an easy-to-use solution right at your fingertips.
Key Features
Real-Time Decibel Monitoring: Instantly view the current sound levels in decibels (dB) with precise accuracy. Perfect for those needing an accurate dB meter.
Historical Data Tracking: Keep a log of all your measurements with date and time stamps for future reference.
Apple Health App Integration: Save sound levels to iOS health app to track historical levels.
White Noise Generator: Listen to different sounds including white,brown,blue noise and more. 
Trends View: Provides insights into your sound level measurements over different periods. Explore various statistics and trends to better understand your sound environment.
Location Tagging: Record the location of your measurements, ideal for comparing noise levels across different places.
Max and Average dB Readings: Alongside real-time data, view the highest and average decibel readings of each session.
Background Processing: Measure sound levels even when the app is running in the background.
VU Meter Visual Representation: A dynamic VU meter provides a visual understanding of current noise levels.
Important Notice
The sound level measurement provided by this app is for informational purposes only. While we strive to ensure the accuracy of the measurements, we cannot guarantee that the results are entirely precise due to various factors such as device calibration, microphone quality, and environmental conditions.
By using this app, you agree to the following:
No Guarantee of Accuracy: The measurements and results provided by this app are not guaranteed to be accurate and should not be relied upon for critical or professional purposes.
User Responsibility: Users are solely responsible for the interpretation and use of the data provided by this app. We strongly recommend using professional sound level meters and consulting with qualified professionals for accurate measurements and health-related concerns.
Limitation of Liability: The developers, owners, and affiliates of this app shall not be held liable for any damages, injuries, or adverse effects resulting from the use or misuse of the app or the reliance on the data provided. This includes, but is not limited to, direct, indirect, incidental, and consequential damages.
Health and Safety: If you have any concerns about noise levels and their impact on your health, please consult with a medical professional or an accredited specialist in sound measurement and acoustics. Visit NIOSH website for more. 
By downloading and using this app, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to this disclaimer.
Decibel Shield™ Premium Subscription Information:
Joining the Decibel Shield™ Premium Subscription may include a 7-day free trial, followed by a yearly membership fee.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00159486:ios.summary:
The Phillips Machinist is your personalized digital manufacturing assistant, with quick access to essential machine codes and calculators, direct contact with Phillips engineers, and practical resources designed to make your life easier.
S
bluejetty:00159486:ios.description:
The Phillips Machinist is your personalized digital manufacturing assistant, with quick access to essential machine codes and calculators, direct contact with Phillips engineers, and practical resources designed to make your life easier.
Spark your ingenuity with the Phillips Machinist, the only App you’ll need to succeed! The completely redesigned Phillips Machinist delivers a next level experience offering these key benefits:
EASY ACCESS TO CODES AND MANUALS
A few clicks and you can access Haas G & M reference codes, Error and Alarm Codes, Macro Variables, and functions – and find information on how to apply them to your machines. Right away. Right on the shop floor. Explore our additional libraries with items from Okamoto, Hermle, Kent, Universal Robots and Markforged. 
CALCULATOR LIBRARY
Enhanced everyday Calculators for the CNC Machinist in both Inch and Metric wherever applicable. Now featuring an information page that not only explains how to use the calculator but also the core concepts behind it! Some inputs have been configured to show suggested ranges for the optimal performance of a CNC program to keep you on the cutting edge. 
The Result section provides accurate outputs along with supportive images for better understanding of the concept and the results are further fortified with an abundance of videos and articles related to that particular calculator. For example: In the Material Library and Speeds & Feeds Calculator, we have added Haas “Tip of the Day” videos, specifically talking about how the spindle speed and feed-rates affect the surface finish of a machined part.
All of this is provided at your fingertips. You’ll have access to these calculators that help make your job easier on the shop floor. From Single Point Thread Turning to Speeds & Feeds we’ve got you covered. With 15 calculators and counting!
 • Single Point Thread Turning
 • Mat. Library-Speed & Feeds
 • Simple Speed & Feeds
 • Square Hex
 • Tap Drill - Cutting Tap
 • Tap Drill - Thread Forming
 • True Position
 • Bolt Circle
 • Countersink
 • Right Angle Triangle
 • Drill Tip Depth
 • Socket Head Cap Screw
 • Helicoil Tap Drill
 • Simple Bolt Clearance Chart
 • Simple Drill Chart
A PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE
Your machines and your interests are at the forefront. Keep tabs on your machines, and requests right on your homepage. Look at custom curated videos and manuals to take your knowledge to the next level. See what is trending by checking out our featured trending topics. Favorite your most used manuals to keep everything just the way you want it!
ASK THE EXPERTS
Running into problems on the shop floor? Ask “live” questions to some of the country’s premier applications engineers. The “Ask Joe” section gives you a direct link to the Phillips applications team. Our vast FAQ library has a wealth of knowledge from general machining, 5-axis, and more!
Any questions/or concerns, please reach out to us. We would love to hear from you through the app, or at tpm@phillipscorp.com

bluejetty:00161471:ios.description:
WELCOME! In today's world, it's easy to get distracted and forget that you are a spiritual being having a human experience. The Awakened Way™ app is designed to keep you connected to the Greater Reality and your higher self.
The Awakened Way™ App provides daily support and guidance for your spiritual journey. Find hope, comfort, and healing from the powerful words direct from the higher realms. Counter the negativity in the world by receiving daily messages that uplift and inspire. Stay connected to the higher dimensions and to other users who are on the spiritual journey just like you. Ask For Guidance Now, using the "inspire" oracle button for just the right message you need at any moment.
The app comes pre-loaded with thousands of daily messages and spiritual poetry. Push notifications let you know when a new message of the day arrives.
Search the entire treasury of messages by special dates or keywords and see how they speak to your soul. Click the heart to save your favorite daily messages. Click the call-out balloon to leave an uplifting comment and connect with your community of kindred spirits. Click the share arrow to spread the ripples across the globe.
Like all the work of its founder, Messenger of Hope Suzanne Giesemann, the energy, words, tools, and sense of connection will take you from an emptiness that can't be filled to a fullness that can't be contained.
FEATURES:
● Daily Messages from Higher Consciousness
● “Inspire!” oracle button
● Comments section to connect you with your spiritual community
● Notifications of new messages
● Your favorite messages in your own saved file
● The Awakened Way promise
● Tools for awakened living
● A year of poems from Spirit
● Channeled sessions with Sanaya, the guides who inform these Messages of Hope
● Popular videos about the greater reality
● Links to powerful resources for your spiritual growth
"This app is so unbelievably helpful, it should come pre-installed on every smartphone." J.M.
A Note from Suzanne:
I’m so glad you are here. I hope you enjoy the convenience of this app as a way to stay connected, both with Spirit and with the Awakened Way community. Know that you are a beautiful soul having a human experience. At the human level, you may feel broken or wounded, but at the soul level, you are whole and complete. May the words in the messages lead you to this awareness. As my guides tell us every day, you are so very loved. It can be no other way.
With much love, Suzanne

bluejetty:00155752:ios.summary: The Avi-on Home app enables customers of GE-branded Bluetooth devices to operate in-wall and plug-in switches using their smartphone. Avi-on no longer has a contractual relationship with the manufacturer, Jasco Products, or any duty to supp
bluejetty:00155752:ios.description:
The Avi-on Home app enables customers of GE-branded Bluetooth devices to operate in-wall and plug-in switches using their smartphone. Avi-on no longer has a contractual relationship with the manufacturer, Jasco Products, or any duty to support GE by Jasco Products, and these products are no longer being sold. Avi-on continues to support these devices solely as a courtesy to existing users.
Avi-on Home is a fully-secured system that requires both login and location services. Login ensures that no one else can operate your lights. Location enables you to use sunrise and sunset with your schedules. Once programmed locally, the schedules will operate without the Internet or your phone nearby.
To control GE-branded devices via wi-fi, an Avi-on Remote Access Bridge is required. All schedules and settings are saved on a Bluetooth chip inside each device. Avi-on enables many users to control many devices through a single account. Your account and settings are saved in the Avi-on cloud, providing instant back-up. If you want wi-fi access, 24/7 clock synchronization, and/or Alexa compatibility, install an optional Avi-on Remote Access Bridge (RAB). 
How do you get started?
· Power any Avi-on compatible device by wiring it or plugging it in (plug-in switch or dimmer, in-wall switch or dimmer, or outdoor switch)
· Use a current smartphone or tablet with current OS with Bluetooth and with strong wi-fi access
· Download the latest version of the Avi-on Home App. Register your account and password. Check spam folder for verification and password emails
· Stand near the powered device(s). Press the big + button to add your first device. FAQs are here: http://bit.ly/2F9KaAx
What are the products available for your Avi-on network?
· GE In-Wall Smart Switches and Dimmers
· GE Plug-In Smart Switches and Dimmers
· GE Outdoor Switch
· Avi-on Movable Switch: 3-way wireless switching
· Avi-on Remote Access Bridge (RAB): 24/7 network synchronization, Wi-fi remote control, and Alexa compatibility

bluejetty:00166181:ios.developer: MATEUS FREITAS SILVEIRA TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
bluejetty:00166181:ios.summary:
blocos is the ultimate daily planner & time blocking app built to make you productive and organized!

bluejetty:00166181:ios.description:
blocos is the ultimate daily planner & time blocking app built to make you productive and organized!
This app approaches time management and daily organization in an innovative way, inspired by a Wait But Why article. It's a perfect ADHD planner and calendar for ADHD people!
It has a daily schedule planner based on the 144 blocks daily calendar that will make it much easier to time block your habits.
THE 144 BLOCKS CALENDAR
It's hard to plan your day as just one big block of 24 hours. You overestimate how productive you can be.
This innovative calendar is simple: it breaks down this big 24-hour block into 10-minute pieces, so you can better visualize your time and properly timebox your habits, tasks, and activities, all with time blocking.
144 10-minute blocks equal 1440 minutes or 24 hours. If you sleep 7-8 hours a day, you'll have 100 small blocks to keep track of. If you work for 8 hours, well, you'll have 52 blocks left.
Using the app you'll see how little time you have. However, you'll also be able to track it much more efficiently, building a routine with daily habits that best fit your lifestyle.
How will you use the next block? Start habit tracking and stop procrastination with some great features:
- Track as many activities and habits as you need. You can journal everything!
- A blocks-based visualization of every single day: time block your way to your goals and end procrastination!
- Daily reminders in the day planner: after allocating an activity, you'll receive a notification 10 minutes before it starts!
- The perfect productive habit tracker: you can easily use it as a daily habit tracker to make sure you build good habits or stop bad habits
- Journal and Planner: It's a passion planner, so you can always have time for your passions, but it's also a school planner/work planner that'll help you focus on what you have to do
- Statistics and charts make this the ultimate goal tracker and activity tracker
- Ad-free: we hate ads and don’t want to bother our users
You can use this app in two ways:
1. A precise journal and time planner: strictly planning every day, keeping track of each block
2. A great weekly planner: pick a couple of activities to track. You can keep track of just some of them, and visualize the weekly calendar with the blocks filled
Both ways will help you live more productive and happier days! However, it's much more than a time-blocking app!
BEYOND TIME BLOCK: ONE OF THE BEST ORGANIZATION APPS
To build a daily routine, be productive and organized, just offering an innovative daily calendar isn't enough. 
This app goes beyond being a habit tracking app or one of the best goal tracker apps: we aim to be one of the top productivity apps, no matter your time management skills!
The activities are the basis of everything. Inside them, you have a bunch of features that make it one of the best life planner, daily planner free & organization apps:
◦ A full task manager: organize your to-do-list for each activity, create a daily checklist or daily reminders
◦ Focus timer: open the Pomodoro timer to apply the Pomodoro technique, set how long are the focus rounds, short breaks, and long breaks (the classic 25-10-30 technique or custom like 60 30 30)
◦ Keep a daily diary or save important notes: use the Notes widget inside the activity to create notes like a diary or just use it as a note block.
◦ You can keep a diary for each relevant activity or just focus on the deep work!
Very soon there'll be a Group Pomodoro feature that will allow you to track time with your team or just keep focus with other people that are working or studying! A team Pomodoro (or team time tracker, team timer) like you've never seen before!
Stop wasting time now!

bluejetty:00129202:ios.description:
Constant Therapy Clinician is an evidence-based cognitive, speech language therapy exercise program developed by neuroscientists and speech therapists from Boston University. Deliver science-based exercises in the clinic, and enable your clients' progress at home with an AI-driven customizable Home Exercise program. Provide comprehensive therapy for stroke, traumatic brain Injury (TBI), aphasia, apraxia, dementia & other neurological conditions, and join 800,000+ users who have completed 350 million+ speech therapy, language and cognitive exercises.
Standardize therapy and data reporting across your health system with our Enterprise license that supports HIPAA compliance, enterprise-grade security and access control.
BENEFITS
[Available in English dialects (US, UK, Australia, India) & US Spanish]
• Access the world’s most comprehensive evidence-based exercise library: 1 Million+ exercises across 91 domains of speech, language and cognitive therapy.
• Engage aphasia, stroke, TBI, apraxia, dementia clients in therapy sessions with unlimited activities in speaking, memory, attention, reading, writing, language, math, attention, comprehension, problem solving, visual processing, auditory memory, and daily-living skills.
• Save 15 mins per session on client prep, data reporting, and discharge summaries with detailed reporting features.
• Provide customized Home Exercise Programs and carryover exercises for stroke, brain injury and aphasia recovery with 1-click, saving time and effort.
• Improve outcomes with AI powered Home Exercise Programs that automatically progress with your clients' needs.
• Enable aphasia, brain injury, stroke and dementia clients to progress with speech therapy exercises at home, between clinic sessions, and after discharge.
• Review client performance and exercise compliance in speech language therapy and occupational therapy to inform clinical decisions.
• Get enterprise-grade documentation, security, centralized management & access control for HIPAA compliance with Constant Therapy's Enterprise license.
• Easily populate data into your EMR/EHR system.
Constant Therapy Clinician is free for personal use by clinicians, educators, and researchers. Clinicians at HIPAA-compliant institutions should utilize the app with an Enterprise subscription.
THE SCIENCE BEHIND CONSTANT THERAPY:
Constant Therapy was designed by clinicians and scientists at Boston University specifically to target the challenges of recovery after stroke, traumatic brain injury, aphasia, apraxia, dementia or other neurological disorders. It tracks user progress across functional domains such as: language, cognition, memory, speech, attention, comprehension and visual processing.
Constant Therapy sets the gold standard with the most comprehensive science-based exercise library that is based on 70+ published research studies. Studies show that users enabled with Constant Therapy are more engaged and practice 5x more speech, language and cognitive therapy exercises. Research shows Constant Therapy's effectiveness for aphasia, stroke, TBI, and dementia populations. See constanttherapyhealth.com/science/
Constant Therapy advances rehabilitation science through collaboration with researchers at University of Texas, Boston University, University of Washington and more. A multiple-award winner from Time Magazine, American Stroke Association, AARP and Hearst Health, Constant Therapy is recommended by tens of thousands of speech-language pathologists, neurologists, occupational therapists, and clinicians treating aphasia, stroke, TBI, dementia, and apraxia worldwide.
CONTACT US:
support@constanttherapy.com
constanttherapy.com
TERMS:
constanttherapy.com/privacy/
constanttherapy.com/eula/
Constant Therapy is a tool to help practice cognitive exercises. It does not provide medical advice, diagnoses, or rehabilitation services, and does not guarantee improvements in brain function. It is not a substitute for professional medical or clinical care.

bluejetty:00026217:ios.description:
Remember more of what you learn, in less study time. Turn notes, photos and PDFs into flashcards and review them with spaced repetition (FSRS).
Azri (formerly Simple Anki) uses FSRS, a modern spaced repetition algorithm, to estimate when you're about to forget each card and schedule the review just before. By default it aims for 90% recall, and you can adjust that target.
CARDS THAT MAKE THEMSELVES
Stop building decks by hand. Give Azri your material and it writes the cards for you.
Paste your notes or type a topic — Azri turns it into a deck in seconds.
Snap a photo, drop in a PDF, or record a lecture — Azri pulls out the text, you review and edit it, then it generates the cards.
Pick a card style or create your own, so every deck matches how you study.
Add AI pronunciation audio to the front of your cards, generated automatically when you save.
New: vocabulary cards. Type a word and Azri adds the translation, transcription, an example with its translation, and audio.
SMART FLASHCARDS
Azri goes beyond basic flashcards. It tracks the stability, difficulty, and retrievability of every card, then automatically adjusts your schedule based on how you actually perform. No manual intervals. No guessing.
Add images and audio to make concepts easier to remember.
Use a rich card editor with LaTeX for formulas, auto-translate (Pro), and multilingual keyboards.
Organize your learning with color-coded decks and folders.
Choose card layouts that fit your study style: front-to-back, back-to-front, or combined.
STUDY YOUR WAY
Study in a way that matches how you learn and what you need to retain.
Spaced repetition with science-backed scheduling that targets long-term memory.
Quiz mode for active recall with instant feedback.
Typing practice to lock in answers by typing them out — with character-by-character feedback that even catches missing accents.
Shuffle or sequential study order for maximum focus or consistency.
Track retention rates, streaks, and your review history to see progress over time.
NOW ON THE WEB
Azri isn't just on your phone anymore. Open any web browser on your computer, scan the code with your iPhone camera to sign in, and pick up exactly where you left off. Review your cards on a bigger screen and build or edit decks with a full keyboard — everything stays in sync across your devices. (Available with Azri Pro.)
IMPORT & SYNC
Already use Anki? Import .apkg deck packages directly and map fields exactly how you want. Or start fresh with new content.
Import Anki deck packages (.apkg).
Bring in CSV spreadsheets.
Export any deck to CSV whenever you want. Your cards stay yours.
Create your own cards from scratch.
Cloud sync (Pro) keeps everything backed up and available across your phone and the web.
BUILT FOR
Students who want to ace exams with efficient memorization.
Language learners building vocabulary that sticks beyond short-term cramming.
Medical students mastering anatomy, pharmacology, and more with repeatable review plans.
Professionals retaining certifications and learning new skills.
AZRI PRO
Upgrade to Azri Pro for unlimited AI card generation, custom styles, AI pronunciation audio, vocabulary cards, cloud sync, auto-translate and web access. Choose a weekly or yearly subscription.
POWERED BY FSRS
FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) is built on memory research and outperforms SM-2 in public benchmarks on real review data. Azri puts it in your pocket.
Download Azri and start building knowledge that lasts.

Win drag races.

Single Player Mode

Will they be able to share the syndrome to other cars or not? Who will stay un-infected? Who is the fastest? There is only one way to find out. Hurry up!!
Drag Race 
Gives you the opportunity to compete with your friends online, so you better prepare! Play single, win money, buy the fastest car and come to win against your competitor in the Drag Race Online.

bluejetty:00186777:ios.description:
The sky above you, the Earth beneath you, the solar system you move through space. Three perspectives no other app combines this way.
For thousands of years humans read the sky to measure time, navigate the Earth, and find meaning in their existence. Astronomy, astrology, and timekeeping were one science. Cosmic Watch reunites them.
Free for the first time in ten years.
FEATURES (core)
• Sky View — stars, planets, and constellations
• Earth View — day and night cycle, the cosmos around it
• Solar System — geocentric and heliocentric
• Celestial sphere — full 360° sky overview, unique to this app
• Astrology Mode — Western, Vedic and 3D
• Retrograde motion across all planets
• World clock and astronomical events
• Notifications for eclipses, solstices, and moon cycles
• Celestial navigation — orient yourself by the sky
Or just watch the Earth float in space and remember where you are.
Free to explore. The three views, sky guide, every layer, star names, world clock, and notifications are yours from the first open. Tools and Time Control unlock with a subscription — or forever with Cosmic Pro. Keep the project alive and growing. We read every message you send us.
TOOLS (in-app purchase)
• Moon Calendar
• Real-Time Clouds
• Meteor Showers
• Comets
• Planetary Aspects
• Retrograde Year
• Dreamspell Calendar
• Atmosphere Clockface
• Save Date / Time / Location
• Time Control — move forward and back, any moment
A full app. Not a widget or watch face, yet.
Runs on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac
Privacy committed: No account required. Analytics never shared.
Webby Award for Best Educational App 2018. New York Times. Wired. Space.com. 
By a Chi Gong master and an animation artist. Still looking up.
Time is the Cosmic Rhythm.
Terms of Use: https://cosmic-watch.com/termsOfService/
Privacy Policy: https://cosmic-watch.com/privacyPolicy/

bluejetty:00029367:ios.name: Strikeman
bluejetty:00029367:ios.summary: The Strikeman app allows users to practice their shooting skills without the need for real ammunition. Using our laser bullet, target and smart phone mount, the app records the target and records the users shot scores based on where the las
bluejetty:00029367:ios.description:
The Strikeman app allows users to practice their shooting skills without the need for real ammunition. Using our laser bullet, target and smart phone mount, the app records the target and records the users shot scores based on where the laser hit the target.
The app is composed of 3 sections:
Section 1 – Training
The training section is the initial area of the app where the user can practice their shooting skills. Upon beginning a session, a warning screen is shown to ensure that proper firearm safety is taking place before beginning a session. Once the user agrees, the target appears on the screen. The user calibrates the screen to the target by using two fingers to cover the circumference of the target. Then, the distance from the target is selected and they can begin shooting. Each shot from the firearm triggers a laser, which emits a laser strike on the target, and the app records the score. Shooting metrics appear on the screen to show the user how they are doing during the session. This is accompanied by audio. Once the session is complete, all shots will be shown on the target and saved into an archive.
Section 2 – History
The history section provides screenshots, shooting metrics, and graphs for the user to track their progress. This includes average score, average range, total shots and total sessions. The information is presented on a histogram and a pie chart. This information is saved in an archive. 
Section 3 – Settings
The settings section allows the user to turn on/off gun shot audio and voice feedback. Users can toggle the distance metric, selecting either feet or yards. They can also report an issue if the app isn’t working correctly. The App provides access to the initial tutorial to ensure that all safety precautions are being taken.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.strikeman.io/pages/ios-privacy-page
EULA:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Meet CastOn—the screen-mirroring app that puts your iPhone on the big screen with a single tap.
Still squinting at a tiny iPhone screen while everyone crowds around? CastOn wirelessly connects to your Smart TV over WiFi, so you can share TikTok, YouTube, photos, and more without passing your phone around. No cables, no setup headaches—just tap and go big.
Perfect for movie nights, family gatherings, or game nights, CastOn turns every moment into one worth sharing.
With CastOn, you can:
• Turn solo scrolling into something everyone can enjoy. Instantly stream TikTok, YouTube, and personal media on any Smart TV and share your favorite content on the big screen.
• Upgrade your game nights. Give board games a modern twist with an interactive Whiteboard that turns your television into a virtual playground for unforgettable fun with family and friends.
• Find movies you'll love faster. Let AI recommend and cast movies tailored to your interests, so movie night starts in seconds—no long searches required.
• Bring live events to your living room. Watch live streams and local events on your main screen and feel closer to the action as it unfolds.
• Enjoy lag-free mirroring, every time. Broadcast crisp HD video and audio straight to your TV in a single tap, with perfect synchronization and zero delays.
• Keep your data private. Local network streaming mirrors your screen directly to your TV, keeping your personal data on your devices—not on our servers.
SCREEN MIRRORING 
Mirror your entire iPhone to your TV in real time—TikTok feeds, YouTube videos, your browser, and more. Full HD, perfect sync, zero delays.
PHOTO & VIDEO CAST 
Send your camera roll straight to the TV without handing your phone around. Birthday moments, travel snaps, funny clips—right there for everyone to see. You can still check messages and use your phone while casting.
WHITEBOARD 
Draw on your iPhone and watch it appear on your TV instantly. Sketch out a party plan, brainstorm a project, or play tic-tac-toe with the kids. The bigger the canvas, the bolder the ideas.
LIVE STREAM 
Turn your iPhone into a live camera feed for your TV. Monitor another room, keep tabs on your pets, or stream local events and live happenings straight to your living room screen.
AI MOVIE PICKS
Not sure what to watch? CastOn's AI recommends movies based on your taste and casts them instantly—so movie night starts the moment you're ready.
Download CastOn now and turn every shared moment into a big-screen experience!
FAQ
Q: Do I need cables or special equipment?
A: No. Just connect your iPhone and TV to the same WiFi network—that's all it takes.
Q: Is the mirroring smooth and high-quality? 
A: Yes. CastOn streams crisp HD video and audio over your local network with no lag.
Q: Is my personal data safe?
A: Absolutely. All streaming happens locally between your devices, so your data never passes through our servers.

bluejetty:00157263:ios.description:
FIND TUTORS! HOMEWORK HELP! EXAM HELP! ESSAY HELP! STUDY HELP!
The Kadama App makes it easy for students and parents to instantly connect with expert tutors for in-person and online lessons. Finding a tutor has never been easier. You can select from a wide variety of subjects, set your own budget, and get tutored at the time and place of your choosing.
BUILDING TRUST
- Find your ideal tutor: Easily compare tutors by looking at their ratings/reviews, background check verification, and experience
- Give feedback: Add a review to your tutor’s profile after your lesson
- 100% Satisfaction Guarantee: 2-day money back guarantee if you are not satisfied 
EXPERT HELP IN MATH, ENGLISH, SCIENCE, HISTORY, TEST PREP, AND MUCH MORE
We have thousands of private tutors that range from college students to retired teachers. Whether you want your elementary school child to learn core skills or need help with college level or higher classes, we can help you find your ideal tutor.
Math Tutoring: From simple fractions to advanced calculus, Kadama has expert math tutors for every topic. We offer algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistics, calculus, accounting, economics, finance, and other advanced classes.
Science Tutoring: In addition to elementary school, middle school, and high school science, we have tutors that can help with chemistry, biology, physics, ochem, biochem, and more.
Programming Tutoring: Learn to code from computer science majors and software engineers, with coding languages such as Python, C, C#, C++, Java, HTML, iOS, Swift, Javascript, and more.
FIND AN EXPERT ANYTIME YOU NEED ONE AT THE LOCATION OF YOUR CHOOSING
With the Kadama App, you can quickly connect with subject experts—from chemistry to Spanish tutors—anytime, anywhere. If you have a last-minute assignment that is due, you can be instantly matched with an online tutor who would help you do your homework. Whether you need a tutor to help you write your essay or correct your homework, Kadama tutors are ready to assist. Plus, get homework help, prep for an exam, or answers to your questions quickly and easily.
HOW IT WORKS
Start learning with your ideal tutor today:
1. Select the subject, enter your budget and description, then submit your request
2. Directly message and confirm details with tutors that respond to your request
3. Easily add your payment information and pay through the app
4. See grades and confidence improve!
FOR TUTORS
Earn money by doing tasks on your own schedule—here’s how it works:
1. Add your subjects and go online
2. Start receiving and completing tasks
3. Anyone can be a tutor; student, teacher, or a professional
For more information visit www.kadama.com
Follow us on TikTok at www.tiktok.com/@kadama_app
Follow us on Instagram at www.instagram.com/kadama
Follow us on Twitter at www.twitter.com/kadama
Like us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/kadama
For questions or suggestions email: support@kadama.com

bluejetty:00016732:ios.description:
Marble Classic: Blast & Pop – The Ultimate Marble Shooting Adventure!
Dive into the world of marble-matching mania with Marble Classic: Blast & Pop! This thrilling game brings a fresh twist to the popular marble shooter genre, combining classic gameplay with exciting new levels, power-ups, and challenges. Are you ready to aim, shoot, and pop your way to victory?
Game Overview:
In Marble Classic: Blast & Pop, players embark on an exhilarating journey through beautifully designed levels, each filled with vibrant marbles and intricate paths. Your mission is simple: stop the marble chain from reaching the end of the path by matching three or more marbles of the same color. But beware—time is ticking, and every level brings new challenges!
How to Play:
 Aim and Shoot: Tap where you want to shoot your marble. Match 3 or more marbles of the same color to blast them away and slow down the chain’s progress.
 Master the Power-ups: Collect powerful boosts like bombs, color changers, and chain stoppers. Use them wisely to overcome challenging levels!
 Complete Levels and Earn Rewards: Finish each level with the highest score possible, and earn stars to unlock special levels and rewards.
 Progress Through Unique Worlds: Journey through various themed worlds, from lush jungles to mystical deserts. Each world brings unique challenges and surprises to keep you on your toes.
Game Features:
 Classic Marble Shooting Fun: Inspired by the best marble shooter games, this gameplay is both familiar and refreshingly new.
 Over 500 Exciting Levels: With levels ranging from easy to challenging, there’s something for everyone. Test your skills and work through progressively difficult stages!
 Colorful Graphics and Smooth Animation: Stunning visuals bring each world to life, making every game a visual treat.
 Power-ups and Boosts: Utilize a range of powerful items to clear the board, slow down the chain, and complete levels faster.
 Daily Rewards and Special Challenges: Return each day for exclusive bonuses, rewards, and time-limited challenges that keep gameplay exciting.
Why You’ll Love Marble Classic: Blast & Pop:
Marble Classic: Blast & Pop is more than just a game—it’s a fun, challenging, and addictive experience. Each level presents a new puzzle to solve, and the sense of achievement you’ll feel after completing a challenging stage is unmatched. Whether you’re looking for a quick, casual game to play in your free time or an in-depth challenge to master, Marble Classic: Blast & Pop has it all.
Join the Marble Classic Adventure Now!
Download Marble Classic: Blast & Pop today and start your journey through vibrant worlds filled with marble-blasting action. Can you conquer every level and become the ultimate marble shooter? Find out by joining the fun today!

bluejetty:00154083:ios.description:
Embark on an Endless Adventure in a Mythical Fantasy World!
In Elysia: The Astral Fall, you will step into a breathtaking universe where the delicate balance between light and darkness is threatened by the forces of The Void. Taking on the role of a young warrior, you will lead your team of heroes through countless challenges, uncover the forgotten secrets of Elysia, and fight to protect Solaria from utter destruction.
EXPLORE A MAGICAL WORLD
Travel across six distinct regions, each hiding untold mysteries waiting to be discovered. Search for treasures, complete quests to assist the locals, battle fearsome monsters, and defend Solaria against the devastating invasion of The Void. Every step you take unravels a vital piece of the puzzle in the fight to save the universe.
MASTER BATTLEFIELD STRATEGIES
Engage in real-time battles in an open-world environment, where you can freely select and arrange your team of heroes to face a variety of powerful monsters. Take direct control of your heroes during combat, issuing commands for attacks or activating their unique skills to craft dynamic strategies.
Each hero is equipped with two combat abilities and an ultimate skill, allowing for tailored strategies that can turn the tide of battle. Upgrade your heroes and collect new equipment to strengthen your team and expand your combat capabilities, ensuring Solaria’s survival against the invasion of The Void.
BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM
Heroes are divided into seven elemental factions: Fire, Ice, Wind, Lightning, Kinetic, Light, and Void, offering a diverse range of playstyles. Additionally, each hero possesses specialized combat roles such as Fighter, Preserver, Supporter, Nullifier, Executioner, and Striker, enabling endless strategic combinations.
With the ability to choose up to five heroes for your team, you can experiment with countless configurations, unlocking hundreds of synergistic combinations. Every battle is an opportunity to showcase your creativity and strategic thinking.
IDLE REWARDS & POWER UPS
Enjoy a stress-free experience with a unique system: earn continuous rewards by the hour and day—even when offline. Your team will automatically battle and gather resources while you relax, ensuring steady progression and growth.
SEASONAL EVENT & UPDATES
Participate in seasonal events, explore expanding storylines, and unlock exclusive heroes and items. Regular updates ensure your journey remains fresh, exciting, and full of surprises.
START YOUR JOURNEY NOW WITH ElYSIA : THE ASTRAL FALL

bluejetty:00091580:ios.description:
The ERGO NEXT mobile app lets you manage your business insurance from wherever you are. Create and send certificates of insurance instantly from your phone, view policy docs with a tap, and get fast notifications on claims, payments, and more. 
OUR APP EXPERIENCE
With our app, you have the power to manage your business insurance from anywhere, any time, so you can: 
Customize and share certificates of insurance 
Add unlimited third parties to your certs
Manage third party certificate followers 
Update your account information
Modify your coverage Instantly
File a claim in minutes
CUSTOMIZE AND SHARE CERTIFICATES 
Need proof of insurance? No problem. You can quickly and easily create a customized certificate of insurance and share it with a client, landlord, or anyone else who needs to know you’re insured.
ADD UNLIMITED THIRD PARTIES TO YOUR CERTIFICATE
Your certs need to keep up with your business as it changes and grows. Got a new client or vendor? Add them to your cert in seconds straight from the app.
MANAGE THIRD PARTY FOLLOWERS
Hey, you’re pretty popular! Manage who can see your live certificate in the app, so your followers are always up to date.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS 
When it comes to something as important as your insurance, you never want to miss a thing. Push notifications from our app help you stay up to date every step of the way. 
EDIT YOUR ACCOUNT AND COVERAGE AT NO CHARGE
We’re not into the whole “hidden fee” thing. It’s your account, and you should be able to update it without any hassles or extra charges.
FILE CLAIMS IN MINUTES
Filing a claim is never fun, but we’re here to help. Use the app to share the details of what happened and upload your photos or documentation, then we’ll take it from there. 
ADD COVERAGE
We make it fast and easy for you to add more coverage as your business changes and grows. Plus, we offer discounts for bundling.
*****
MORE ABOUT ERGO NEXT
We were founded by small business owners like you, and we’re 100% dedicated to small businesses and the self-employed. 
Licensed in all 50 states + Washington, D.C.
Serving 300,000+ customers
Rated “A- Excellent” by AM Best
Rated 4.8 out of 5 stars by customers 
Featured in Forbes, Wall Street Journal, CNN, CNBC, Reuters, Insurance Insider and many more

bluejetty:00033262:ios.name: January: AI Health Tracker
bluejetty:00033262:ios.summary: Welcome to January, your all-in-one glucose predictor, calorie tracker, macro tracker, on-demand nutritionist, and so much more. Whether you’re looking to lose weight, up your protein intake, manage your glucose, decode your recent blood wo
bluejetty:00033262:ios.description:
Welcome to January, your all-in-one glucose predictor, calorie tracker, macro tracker, on-demand nutritionist, and so much more. Whether you’re looking to lose weight, up your protein intake, manage your glucose, decode your recent blood work into actionable insights, or you're just ready to start understanding your nutrition, we’re here to help. 
Features
Glucose Monitoring: See the predicted glucose impact of foods before you eat them. Use any of the food logging options to instantly see if your blood sugar will spike. January is the only app on the market that can accurately predict your glucose with no sensor required. If you wear a CGM, you can connect it to January for even more precise predictions. Don't want to wear a CGM or don't have one? No worries, January can predict your blood sugar response to 54M+ foods without any hardware required. 
On-Demand Nutritionist: “Jan,” your personalized AI nutritionist, is now more intuitive than ever. After your initial consultation, where she gets to know your eating habits, goals and challenges, Jan will set your personalized weekly targets, and check in on you throughout the week to keep you motivated and on track. Jan is there when you need her, 24/7, and continuously learns about your habits, challenges, and objectives. Based on your health goals, she creates a personalized nutritional target each week, along with tips on how to achieve the goal. Jan will evolve with you, adapting your goals to optimize your results with regular weekly check-ins.
Calorie and Macro Tracker: Easily track your calories and macros with our intuitive food scanner and nutrition tracker. Simply snap a photo of your food, scan the barcode, use your voice or manually search, and January will instantly provide you with all of your nutritional information. January will even suggest healthier alternatives that are personalized to you. With a database of over 54M foods, along with all your favorite restaurant menus and more, January makes food logging easier than ever. Plus, our photo scan is the most accurate on the market. We've benchmarked it against all the competitors and consistently land in the #1 spot.
Decode your blood tests: Confused about what your blood test actually means? With January, you can upload your recent blood test and get an easy-to-understand report, highlighting what's working, what's not, and helpful nutritional recommendations. Chat to your AI nutrtionist, Jan, about the results and compare previous lab reports to see how you're improving over time.
Track Your Health Over Time: January helps you to track your patterns and improvements over time. We go beyond just calories — we monitor your protein, fiber, sugar intake, blood sugar spikes, sleep, weight, and so much more. Get personalized AI insights and trends that go far beyond just a basic graph. 
AI-Powered Insights and Food Swaps: Get personalized recommendations and insights with our cutting-edge AI technology. January will suggest better meal options for you to minimize glucose spikes and boost your nutrition. If you've uploaded a blood test, these recommendations will be further targeted towards your precise health needs.
Apple Health Integration – Connect sleep, activity, and metabolic health in one place by linking your Apple Health to the January App. 
Subscription Information: 
Users are offered a 7-day free trial when downloading the app and creating an account. This 7-day trial will give you unlimited access to all of the features that January has to offer. After one week, users will be given the option to continue their access with a paid subscription. 
Disclaimer: 
January AI is not designed or intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition. It is intended for general wellness purposes only. Users should consult their doctor for any medical decisions. 
Terms of Use: https://www.january.ai/legal/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.january.ai/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00127815:ios.name: Spyglass
bluejetty:00127815:ios.summary: Spyglass is an essential offline GPS app for outdoors and off-road navigation. Packed with tools it serves as binoculars, heads-up display, hi-tech compass with offline maps, gyrocompass, GPS receiver, waypoint tracker, speedometer, altimet
bluejetty:00127815:ios.description:
Spyglass is an essential offline GPS app for outdoors and off-road navigation. Packed with tools it serves as binoculars, heads-up display, hi-tech compass with offline maps, gyrocompass, GPS receiver, waypoint tracker, speedometer, altimeter, Sun, Moon and star finder, gyro horizon, rangefinder, coordinate converter, sextant, inclinometer, angular calculator and camera. It saves your custom places and waypoints, navigates precisely to them later, shows them on maps and using real-time augmented reality displays detailed GPS info, measures distances, sizes, angles, and does a lot more.
COMPASS & GYROCOMPASS
Accuracy improvement techniques, special compass modes and calibration methods available in Spyglass only make it a real instrument – the most advanced and accurate digital compass.
FINDER, TRACKER & AR NAVIGATION
Spyglass operates in 3D and uses augmented reality to show real-time object positions, info and directions to them overlaid over camera or maps.
Save current position, add points from maps, manually enter location coordinates and bearings, add stars by hand or use a built-in star catalogue.
Find saved places and objects later simply by following directional arrows.
Spyglass tracks multiple targets simultaneously and shows their info – distance, direction, azimuth, elevation and estimated time of arrival.
Copy, paste and share locations, coordinates and map links using many supported formats.
GPS, SPEEDOMETER & ALTIMETER
Find and track your location and get detailed real-time GPS data – coordinates in dozens of formats, altitude, course, current, maximum and vertical speed, using imperial, metric, nautical and surveying units.
OFFLINE MAPS
See your and targets’ positions on maps using different map styles and alternative map providers – plan waypoints and measure distances. Offline maps optimized for retina displays are available for download.
TRACK STARS, SUN AND MOON & NAVIGATE BY STARS
Track positions of stars, Sun and Moon with arc second precision – use them as a reference to calibrate compass for maximum accuracy.
OPTICAL RANGEFINDER
Measure distances to objects in real time with a rangefinder reticle similar to sniper sights.
SEXTANT, ANGULAR CALCULATOR AND INCLINOMETER
Find out heights of objects and distances to them – measure visually and calculate dimensions and distances. 
CAMERA
Take pictures overlaid with all available GPS, positional and directional data.
DEMO & HELP
Videos:
http://j.mp/spyglass_vids
Manuals:
http://j.mp/spyglass_help
If you need specific map sources for hiking, cycling, skiing and many more outdoor activities, feel free to enjoy Spyglass PLUS. 
At confirmation of the Spyglass PLUS purchase, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and it will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period. Automatic renewal can be turned off at any time in your Account Settings after purchase. After the cancellation of the renewal, Spyglass Plus will expire at the end of the current period.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at https://spyglassnav.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.unblip.com/tmp/privacy_and_terms/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.unblip.com/tmp/privacy_and_terms/terms.html

bluejetty:00019193:ios.name: LogiBrain Grids
bluejetty:00019193:ios.summary:
These logic puzzles are for the true logic problem fanatic! Can you solve them?
You won't have to take a paper booklet with your favorite logic puzzles with you anymore. From now on you can just play it everywhere on your phone or tablet.
bluejetty:00019193:ios.description:
These logic puzzles are for the true logic problem fanatic! Can you solve them?
You won't have to take a paper booklet with your favorite logic puzzles with you anymore. From now on you can just play it everywhere on your phone or tablet.
LogiBrain Grids is a grid-based logic puzzles game. Solve these logic puzzles to keep your brain sharp!
Decode written clues and use the grid to mark a relationship between two items and eliminate the other possibilities and solve the puzzle.
Optimized for phones and tablets instead of paper, this app has the ability to erase errors or show the solution when you get stuck. This makes it easier and quicker to focus on the logic puzzle.
These logic puzzles are for the true logic problem fanatic! Try 20 puzzles for free. If you like it, more packages are available for in-app purchase, each with 20 unique puzzles, for hours of puzzling fun!
The game features several puzzles of 3, 4 or 5 squares which all have a different difficulty level. This difficulty is shown in the picture behind the title of the puzzle.
If you like logic puzzles then LogiBrain Grids is definitely something for you!
Can you solve the puzzles?
Enjoy the game and have fun!
GAME FEATURES
- 20 free logic grid puzzles included to get you started.
- Different difficulty levels so that there is a puzzle for everyone.
- Long press option will check "•" for the box and check "X" to all boxes vertical and horizontal to it.
- For each puzzle a high score is tracked, so you can see how long it took you to solve the puzzle.
- Remove errors with the 'Erase errors' button.
- Made a mistake? You can always use the undo feature.
- Are you stuck? Use the 'Show solution' option.
- Resume your automatically saved games at any time.
- Detailed explanation for new users.
- Zoom and drag the puzzle to match your screen size for small screen devices.
- Designed for tablet and phones.
- Additional packages of 20 puzzles each are available for in-app purchase.
If you like LogiBrain Grids, please take the time to give us a nice review. This helps us to make the app even better, thanks in advance!
We offer the puzzles in the following languages:
English
Dutch
* Game data is stored on your device. Save data cannot be transferred between devices, nor can it be restored after deleting or reinstalling the app.

bluejetty:00083362:ios.description:
After a big storm, the town was badly damaged.
Karina was originally a designer of some renown, but recently hit a creative block. Successive productions have failed to live up to expectations.
Karina felt very depressed and wanted to go back to her hometown to relax herself.
Back home, you and Karina are shocked to see run-down towns and farms. Karina learns from her grandfather that the town has just been through a storm.
Fortunately, no one in the town was hurt, but houses and farms were badly damaged. Although the town residents are very reluctant, but also have to choose to leave the city.
Karina was very sad to see the destruction of her childhood playground, so she decided to save the farm. You have also decided that you want to help Karina restore and design the farm back to the way it was before, and even better!
Get items by matching and merging the same items to clean, repair, and design the farm!
As the farm is repaired, you will unlock new areas of the farm, including gardens, farmlands, and other mysterious new areas that you will gradually explore.
Return to the countryside with Karina, relax and enjoy the fun of merging!
