bluejetty:00070412:ios.name: HiWater: Powerful Water Logger
bluejetty:00070412:ios.summary: HiWater not only helps you record your daily water intake, but also analyzes the hydration structure based on the water pyramid model. The water pyramid divides daily beverages into six healthy levels, which can help you understand whether
bluejetty:00070412:ios.description:
HiWater not only helps you record your daily water intake, but also analyzes the hydration structure based on the water pyramid model. The water pyramid divides daily beverages into six healthy levels, which can help you understand whether your water intake is in line with health guidelines.
== Features ==
**Track Daily Water Intake**
HiWater helps you quickly log your daily water intake, and also helps you set a personalized daily hydration goal.
**Water Pyramid**
Just like the food pyramid, the water pyramid classifies beverages into different health levels. HiWater helps you analyze the structure of your water intake to avoid consuming too many beverages and promote good health. The water pyramid model comes from the Healthy Beverage Guidelines proposed by experts at the Harvard School of Public Health and related research.
**Smart Reminder**
HiWater will remind you to hydrate when your body goes into dehydration. With HiWater's powerful notification system, you can set different rules for weekdays and weekends. HiWater also supports iOS 15 time-sensitive notifications.
**Powerful System Integration**.
HiWater supports Shortcuts, Siri suggestions, and Home Screen widgets. With these features, power users can complete daily water tracking without even opening the app.
**Apple Watch App**
HiWater comes with a high-quality Apple Watch app. You can quickly check your body hydration on your watch and keep track of your water intake on your wrist. It also comes with a beautiful set of watch face complications.
**Data Sync**
- Supports iCloud sync. The data you logged is stored safely and securely.
- Supports iOS Health data sync, including water and nutrient data.
- Seamlessly works with HiCoffee. When you log coffee in HiCoffee, the water data will be automatically synced to HiWater. (HiCoffee is another app for tracking caffeine intake and needs to be purchased separately)
== Purchase Notes ==
HiWater's basic features are free and can be used all the time. But you can unlock premium features by joining a membership.
** About Membership Subscription **
HiWater's auto-renewal subscriptions can be found on the Settings > View Membership page (prices may vary by region). Payment will be deducted from your App Store account after your confirmation. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. Accounts will be charged for renewals up to 24 hours before the end of the current period. Once subscribed, you can manage it in the Manage Subscriptions page within the app or in the settings of your App Store account.
Privacy Policy: https://gongzhang.io/app/hiwater/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://gongzhang.io/app/hiwater/en/terms

The World of Tribe Boy: Jungle Adventure contains well-designed levels, various enemies, super bosses, simple gameplay, excellent graphics, and soothing music and sounds.
It was a beautiful day in the Lopes Tribe. Tribe Boy was looking for food to prepare for the tribal festival, then suddenly the sky darkens and lightning fills the sky. A mysterious monster appears and kidnaps all the villagers except Tribe Boy, who is absent from the tribe.

+ Collect all coins and bonus items to get more points and buy additional items in store

+ Hidden bonus levels with lots of classic and modern coins
+ Additional collectibles, coins, shields, and more
+ Underground and water worlds, swim, jump and run
+ Store with additional items and rewards: unlock worlds before finishing other worlds

bluejetty:00170480:ios.summary: For over 18 years, MatchTime has made managing racquet sport teams, leagues, and tournaments less work and more fun. With our easy-to-use platforms and responsive customer service, we save captains and league directors valuable time so thei
bluejetty:00170480:ios.description:
For over 18 years, MatchTime has made managing racquet sport teams, leagues, and tournaments less work and more fun. With our easy-to-use platforms and responsive customer service, we save captains and league directors valuable time so their players can do what they do best - get on the court, compete and have fun.
Grab your racquet - it's MatchTime. Trusted in over 3 Million matches by 150,000+ teams.
MatchTime's mobile app -- your team's schedule, match lineups, availability, team communications and match location are all now within quick and easy reach with our mobile app.
* Team Schedule -- dates and locations of all your matches with a summary of points after the match.
* Team Chat -- keep the team's players fully updated with real-time messages.
* Match Lineups -- view the full lineup for each match. Find out which line you are playing and what you need to bring to the match. Once scores are entered, you can see how each line did as well.
* Match Confirmation -- Captains get piece of mind knowing their players will be at the match... go ahead and confirm that you will be at the match directly in the app!
* Match Availability -- set your availability for each match with a single click. View the availability of your other players as well for that match.
* Match Directions -- know exactly where you are going for your upcoming match. ALTA specific directions and other player reviews are also included.
* Get driving directions through your navigation app with quick click of a button.
* Player Roster -- have all your players contact information with you. Call them, text them or even download their contact details to your phone's contacts.
* Push Notifications - get updates pushed to you from your captain -- new lineup, quick message, etc
CAPTAINS
* Create Email - send a quick email to all of your team or just one or two players.
* Create/Edit Match Lineups - create your match lineup through the app quickly and easily. You can select who is playing which match line and also enter what each player should bring. Need to change the lineup, you can do that as well.
* Create/Edit Match Scores -- Want to keep track of the match scores while your team is playing... great you can enter the scores line by line one at at time.

Become a contributor and be part of this unique Smart Weather
bluejetty:00076948:ios.description:
Discover the first made for iPhone Smart Weather Station and its App!
A Netatmo Weather Station is required. Find out more about the Netatmo Weather Station at www.netatmo.com.
Become a contributor and be part of this unique Smart Weather Station network: measure locally with your Netatmo Weather Station, monitor directly from your iPhone with the Netatmo app! 
DASHBOARD: 
-Access your station’s measurements (temperature, humidity, barometer, felt-like temperature, CO2, air quality, rainfall and wind speed and direction) directly from your iPhone. 
-Intuitive and easy navigation! Swipe between outdoor measurements and indoor measurements in one easy gesture. 
LONG TERM OBSERVATION AND TRACKING: 
-Automatically records your station’s measurements to your Netatmo account. 
-Displays weather and air quality history in beautiful and intuitive graphs. 
-Zoom in, zoom out and navigate in time with a single gesture: precise and scientific graphs have never been easier to use! 
EVENTS AND NOTIFICATIONS: 
-Notifications for peak and variation events (CO2 concentration, extreme temperatures, low and high pressures…). 
-Automatically logs events in your personal timeline. 
EMBEDDED FORECAST: 
-7 days of forecast, available at your exact Netatmo Weather Station location!

 - Solo Training Mode: Play against yourself with a timer to refine your moves and develop better strategies.
Are you ready to prove your chess skills? Download Chess Online now and become a master of the board!

bluejetty:00084012:ios.description:
Pilates is a form of exercises that mainly focus on strengthening the core. Besides core strength, other parts of the body that pilates helps strengthening are legs, upper thighs and buttocks. Full body pilates exercises has effects on different muscles groups, lower back, abdomen, hip and pelvic muscles.
Just like yoga, pilates has many benefits too. Pilates gives you energy, improve your balance and flexibility, stretch and strengthen muscles, helps you lose weight, get fit, pilates also helps you relax, even sleep better.
Poor posture can cause back pain, neck pain and other muscle problems. Pilates can help to strengthen those muscles and get rid of bad posture.
Pilates also helps to improve flexibility. With pilates you will get leaner and more flexible. Better flexibility can prevent any risk of injury.
Everyone can do pilates. This best pilates workout app has exercises that are suitable for both beginner and pro. You can find the best exercises for your level. You can customize your own workouts and plan your daily pilates routine.
While you stretch and strengthen your muscles, you will also burn calories. Pilates helps you lose weight. You can track burned calories and see your progress. With 30 days pilates workout program you will get skinner and more flexible.
No equipment needed, you can do pilates by using your bodyweight. Don't need to go to gym, do pilates online, you can do these easy and effective pilates exercises at home, at work, anywhere you want.
Pilates gives you more energy throughout the day. Pilates helps metabolise stress hormones to relax muscles. Focused breathing can increase circulation over the body and gives you energy. This pilates workout app has breathing exercises as well.
All exercises are designed by a professional trainer. With video instructions a trainer will guide you without going to the gym.
Take a few minutes a day to focus on yourself, your body, your brain. Do these easy, quick and effective pilates exercises to get stronger. NOW try Nexoft Mobile's "Pilates Exercises-Pilates at Home" app for FREE!

bluejetty:00016698:ios.name: LSW Collector
bluejetty:00016698:ios.summary: LSW Collector is the most detailed LEGO Star Wars minifigure collecting app around and is the perfect way to catalogue your collection! Use the search bar to quickly find your minifigures by unique ID, name, or set number. You can swipe bet
bluejetty:00016698:ios.description:
LSW Collector is the most detailed LEGO Star Wars minifigure collecting app around and is the perfect way to catalogue your collection! Use the search bar to quickly find your minifigures by unique ID, name, or set number. You can swipe between minifigure entries to easily update your collection! Each minifigure page provides all the relevant information you need to know. Saving the best for last, exclusive to the LSW Collector app is a section dedicated to more obscure variants! Entries for all minifigures made from 1999 to current are included and are added in real time which means you don't have to wait for an update to check them off. We promise to continue to update with the newest minifigures so that you can continue expanding your collection! 
LSW Collector is an unofficial mobile application for all collectors of LEGO Star Wars minifigures. Made by a collector for collectors!
Capabilities:
Each entry contains all of the important information about the minifigure including detailed images, unique ID, year of release, and in which sets it can be found. Swiping left and right allows you to see both the front and back of the minifigure. Clicking on the sets box shows exactly which sets a minifig comes from! LSW Collector allows you to 'check off' minifigures you already have and add the ones you don't to your wanted list. The green check mark allows you to easily see which minifigures you already have from the main view while the 'WANTED' symbol indicates which figures you are still chasing. Alternatively you can ignore figures that you don't want to have in your collection by tapping on the hide button at the bottom of the screen. You can revisit these figures any time by clicking the hide button on the main page. The Price Guide feature allows you to check the average selling price for each minifigure and can be used as an estimation for your own buying/selling purposes. You can also add multiple of the same minifigure to your collection and then track your total progress on the My Collection tab.
Legal Information:
LEGO and the minifigure are registered trademarks of the LEGO Group.
STAR WARS is a registered trademark of Lucasfilm, Ltd. The character names are trademarks of Lucasfilm, Ltd. many of which are federally registered. 
The creator of this mobile application is not affiliated or associated with the LEGO Group or Lucasfilm, Ltd. LSW Collector is not sponsored or endorsed by the LEGO Group or Lucasfilm, Ltd. 
LSW Collector is for collectors of LEGO Star Wars minifigures. The creator of this mobile application includes only personally generated photographs of all minifigures contained within this application. The creator has used only so much of the character names as is necessary to properly identify them. Therefore, this use falls under nominative fair use. This mobile application is not meant for selling or trading purposes but is solely for collecting purposes.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Create high-quality animations easily with advanced AI tools. Get started now!

• Learn how to increase your lung capacity to hold your breath longer. Enhance your mental control and resilience to test your limits through guided breathing exercises safely.

bluejetty:00096616:ios.description:
Welcome to our unique world of survival and shooting missions, starship trooper hero! Only here you fight against thousands of space bugs, explore a cosmic base with rooms full of epic boosters and help kits, update your shooter hero to master of galactic battles! Are you ready to take on this space challenge and survive at all costs?
In our addictive space hero - ultimate invasion shooter app you are under attack by hordes of monsters! So, let's fight bravely, let's shoot endlessly! Move fast, hit precisely using a wide range of powerful weapons, destroy the space bugs to prove your cosmic ranger is worthy of the monster hunting victory! 
This shoot to survive game is highly simple to learn and fun to master. Find a strategic position in the room to open the fire, choose the right way to collect all bonuses to upgrade various skills of your cosmo hero, and show who's the master of galactic battles!
There are many great features that you'll find in this space trooper shooter game. Among them:
Upgrade your star survivor soldier: increase his attack power, health level, regeneration speed and much more - become the strongest on the starship$
Explore innumerous locations: our cosmic shooter range app's exploration mechanics will let you discover various rooms full of epic boosters and help kits as well as unique challenges and survival game mode;
Countless powerful weapons: this survivor space game impress you with an amazing range of guns and tools to win - collect, upgrade and use them all;
Build and upgrade your base: the invincible alien shooter app has several spaceship builder features that allows you to create the strongest and the most impenetrable fortress in the Universe!
In summary, space hero: invasion shooter is full of survival space battles, idle action game mechanics and addictive challenges to complete. Download it now to enjoy the best cosmo shooter rush ever!

bluejetty:00094635:ios.summary:
Looking for a Bible study app with a daily Bible verse widget that makes Scripture simple, engaging, and easy to fit into your daily life?
Manna transforms traditional Bible study into a fast, gamified, habit-forming experience—perfect for
bluejetty:00094635:ios.description:
Looking for a Bible study app with a daily Bible verse widget that makes Scripture simple, engaging, and easy to fit into your daily life?
Manna transforms traditional Bible study into a fast, gamified, habit-forming experience—perfect for busy Christians who want meaningful spiritual growth without overwhelm.
What Is Manna?
Manna is a gamified Bible study app that helps you build a consistent Bible habit through interactive learning, daily scripture engagement, and community-driven devotion. Whether you're new to Bible study or looking to strengthen your walk with God, Manna makes spiritual formation enjoyable, motivating, and highly accessible.
 How Manna Works: Gamified Bible Study with Purpose
• Daily Bite-Sized Bible Study Missions
Start each day with short, interactive missions that guide you through essential Bible verses, stories, and teachings. Learn through quizzes, puzzles, and faith challenges that make Bible study feel like a fun game, not a chore.
• Devotion Path with Friends — Grow in Bible Study Together
Faith grows stronger in community.
 Invite friends to join your Bible study journey, complete weekly devotional goals as a team, share encouragement, and climb spiritual rankings together. Group accountability makes your Bible study habit stick.
• Daily Bible Verse Widgets — Scripture at a Glance
Place God’s Word right on your home screen.
 Instant access to daily Bible verses for encouragement, prayer, and reflection—without opening the app.
• Interactive Bible Dialogue Learning
Manna explains Scripture through conversational, friendly dialogue.
 Complex Bible passages become simple, relatable, and applicable—perfect for beginners or anyone who wants an easier approach to Bible study.
• Structured Bible Study Plans & Progressive Learning
Follow a clear, step-by-step Bible study path that builds your understanding over time.
 Track your progress like levels in a game as you move from Bible basics to deeper spiritual insights.
• Personalized Bible Study Experience
Your spiritual journey is unique.
 Manna adapts to your pace, knowledge level, and interests—creating a customized Bible study plan just for you.
Why Christians Choose Manna for Bible Study
•Designed for Busy Schedules
Our Bible study sessions are short, interactive, and habit-friendly. Even 5–10 minutes a day makes a difference.
•Easy, Engaging, and Beginner-Friendly
Manna turns Bible study into an adventure with missions, rewards, and progress tracking—ideal for teens, young adults, and new believers.
•Every course is free.
You can explore Bible study courses without a subscription. Optional upgrades are available for those who want additional features.
•Modern, Relatable Bible Teaching
We break down Scripture into clear, everyday language that helps you navigate real-life challenges and grow in faith.
•Your Personal Bible Study Mentor
Receive insights, reflections, and guidance rooted in Scripture.
Manna supports spiritual growth, emotional balance, and long-term faith formation.
Manna: A Bible Study App That Makes Faith Fun
Manna isn’t just another Christian app—it’s a daily companion that helps you build a joyful, consistent, and meaningful Bible study habit. With gamified learning, Bible verse reminders, interactive lessons, and community devotion, Manna brings the Bible to life in a fresh and motivating way.
If you want a simple Bible study method, a faith habit you’ll actually stick with, and a Christian app that fits your lifestyle, Manna is your answer.
Download Manna Today
Start your Bible study journey in just 5 minutes a day.
Experience Scripture in a new, powerful, and enjoyable way.
Terms of service: https://themanna.app/service.html
Privacy policy: https://themanna.app/privacy.html
Support: support@themanna.app

How
bluejetty:00122022:ios.description:
Warning!!
The evil monster Tyragon has been released by the evil corporation Galaxy Shooter. The world is in danger!! 
You're the Earth's last hope. Take control of the spacecraft in animal form and protect the Earth from alien swarms. 
How to play? 
Sky Champ: Galaxy Space Shooter - Monster Attack is an offline game of Bulletstorm genre (or Space Shooter, Galaxy Shooter, Arcade Shooting, Galaxy Attack) and RPG.
The gameplay is easy but hard to master: hold and drag the spaceship to shoot all the aliens and evil monsters. Your spaceship/ spacecraft/ starship is in form of cute monsters called Okimon. 
Features: 
- Upgrading system: collect rare items to evolve your spaceship. Catch new Okimon to evolve the ultimate spacecraft form with great power! 
- 100+ stages in Adventure Mode with the difficulty increasing gradually. Challenge your skills. Become the most skillful Space Shooter ever. 
- 90+ pets and monsters with various evolution form to catch and equip 
- Up to 5 Power Up (Power Buff) in-game help you survive through hard space shooter, galaxy shooter stages 
- More than 50 equipments for your pets and monsters 
- Battle Pass system with lots of rewards 
- Classic game but in modern design. Unlike other Galaxy Space Shooter, Arcade shooting or Galaxy Attack, Sky Champ has many nice airship, airplane, and starship design to choose 
- PvP, play against other players via League game mode, check your ranking on Worlds Billboard in League 
- Can play Offline, without internet, wifi or 4G. Receive more rewards when playing online 
If you're a fan of Bulletstorm offline game category (a.k.a Space Shooter, Galaxy Shooter, Arcade Shooting, Galaxy Attack), Sky Champ: Galaxy Space Shooter is made for you 
Find us on FB @skychampgame or join our community Sky Champ Group.

bluejetty:00122195:ios.summary: Introducing the groundbreaking "Times Now App," the official mobile application of India's largest media conglomerate, The Times Group. Immerse yourself in a diverse range of premium news brands like Times Now, ET Now, ET Now Swadesh, Zoom,
bluejetty:00122195:ios.description:
Introducing the groundbreaking "Times Now App," the official mobile application of India's largest media conglomerate, The Times Group. Immerse yourself in a diverse range of premium news brands like Times Now, ET Now, ET Now Swadesh, Zoom, Mirror Now, Gadget Times, Times Drive, and Times Foodie, all brought together under this cutting-edge app. Experience the pinnacle of news coverage with the highly acclaimed Times Now Navbharat and Times Now Marathi channels, ensuring you stay updated in your preferred language.
Embrace the philosophy of "Now or Nothing" with the Times Now App, your gateway to the world of live, latest, and breaking news from India and around the globe. Download the app and unlock an unparalleled news experience, granting you unlimited access to a vast array of articles, live blogs, fresh videos, and exhilarating live TV streams. Dive into a wide range of popular categories, including politics, business, entertainment, sports, viral content, technology, food, recipes, and many more, all available at your fingertips.
Discover the innovative "Live TV" feature embedded right within the Times Now App. Effortlessly watch and listen to the most recent news updates while simultaneously browsing through captivating articles and engaging live blogs. 
Times Now App's outstanding features:
• Home: Immerse yourself in the latest and most riveting news from numerous channels, impeccably presented in various news listing formats, including articles, videos, and live blogs. Stay updated on all that is happening with the live news updates.
• Live: Stay on the cutting edge with Live TV, Live Blogs, and Live streams from Youtube on breaking news by simply tapping on the "Live" tab.
• Shorts: Engage with short videos by pressing the "Shorts" option on the bottom centre. Enjoy crisp short videos across genres with just a single tap.
• Watch: The ultimate video experience across news apps is here. If you prefer watching news videos, we have a new revamped section. Continue your video journey with "Up Next" and "Autoplay" the next upcoming videos. Indulge in Web Stories, where we have curated news in the app packaged into a concise and visually rich experience.
• Discover: Looking for something else? Find the latest Trending videos, news tags, and a detailed menu of all other news categories in the "Discover" section.
The Times Now App goes above and beyond, offering an array of highly prominent and user-friendly features:
• Multilingual Content: Immerse yourself in English news seamlessly translated into popular languages such as Hindi and Marathi. With the "Change Language" option conveniently located under the Discover menu on the bottom right (four squares), switch between English, Hindi, or Marathi with ease to tailor your news experience.
• Discover more content easily by tags and topics in the Times Now news App. Find tags within and at the bottom of articles. Click to get news articles, videos, images, and live blogs.
• Article Listing in card layout: Navigate through the latest news seamlessly with a simple glance over the top headlines on the home page itself. Discover trending news articles, Live news updates, Short videos, and Web Stories, as well as Live TV and Videos.
• Share News: Unleash the power of captivating stories with the dedicated WhatsApp button, allowing you to share engaging videos, photos, and live TV with friends across various popular social media networks and platforms.
With the Times Now App, you hold the world of news in the palm of your hand. Keep in mind that access to live TV channels may be restricted in certain countries due to geo-centric channel streaming limitations. Download the app now and elevate your news experience to unparalleled heights. Stay informed, stay connected, and embrace the "Now or Nothing" philosophy!
*Please note that access to live TV channels may be restricted in certain countries due to geo-centric channel streaming limitations.

bluejetty:00159578:ios.description:
It’s a great day to build a financial plan!
The Troutwood App was designed and developed to help individuals set and achieve important financial goals. Your customizable Financial Plan output includes:
(1) Goal setting
(2) Proprietary likelihood score - can I achieve this goal?
(3) proprietary adequacy score - is my goal enough to meet my financial needs?
(4) Budget - based on real, location specific, cost of living and salary data.
(5) Personal financial plan
Set Financial Goals:
· How much money do you need? This year, next year, for retirement? These are important money questions, that your Troutwood financial plan will help answer.
Explore Colleges, Careers & Locations:
· Unsure what you want to do and/or where you want to do it? That’s ok! With Troutwood you can explore 13.5 million career and location combinations, using real location-based data.
· Build hypothetical plans for your dream job, dream location, or a specific financial objective. And when you feel comfortable, add it to your financial plan.
· Explore and compare colleges.
Let your saving dictate your spending and build a plan for your financial future, with Troutwood!
Dream big. Build a plan. Go do it!

bluejetty:00183302:ios.summary:

Personalized Home Screen: Get a quick view of your available rewards. Enable location se
bluejetty:00183302:ios.description:
Meet the New LettuceEats® app: Your pocket guide for all things Lettuce and personalized to you! Log into the app to see your personalized experience:
Personalized Home Screen: Get a quick view of your available rewards. Enable location services so we can tailor the experience to you. Not sure if you want to dine out or stay in? You can now discover dine-in, delivery and pick-up options right from the home screen. Discover new restaurants with the new filters and save your favorites to the top of the list for easy future access. 
Make a reservation: Select the party size, date and time to see what is available across all of the Lettuce restaurants. Make reservations at over 80 locations in Illinois, Las Vegas, Minneapolis, Washington DC, Austin, & Miami. Book your reservation and view your upcoming reservations and future reservations from the home screen. Tap Manage Reservation to make adjustments to your reservation and see the updates reflected in the app.
Order Pick-up or Delivery: See what to-go options are available closest to you with estimated delivery and pick-up times. Or enter an alternate address to see what is closest to that location. Get points, redeem rewards and use your gift cards. 
Discover Restaurants: Use the new filters to search for cuisines, locations and other dining options. View menus to see what you might be in the mood for. Cuisines include: American, Pizza, Chinese, Thai, Italian, Burgers, Seafood, French, Asian, Latin American, Steaks, Wine and Cocktails, BBQ, Ramen, Sushi, Spanish Tapas and Paella, Japanese, Nightclubs, Dessert and Crepes, Tacos, Margaritas and more. Find the restaurant of your choice, get directions, view menus, phone numbers and hours of operation.
Save Your Favorites: Tap the heart button on the top right of the restaurant photo to save your favorites for easy access. You can now view your favorites right at the top of the home screen.
New Wallet: Check out the new Rewards Wallet! Easy access to all of your rewards, gift cards and vouchers. Track your points progress to the next $10 reward and track your member status. View your transaction history. See how long you have until any vouchers expire.
Add a Gift Card or Holiday Bonus: Tap the “Add A Gift Card” button, enter your 16-digit number (and 8 digit pin if you have one), then tap save card. Your Gift Card will now be accessible to redeem in your Wallet with your other rewards and vouchers.
Check-in: Check in to Earn points & redeem Reward Dollars: Tap check-in and select the restaurant where you are dining. You will receive a 4 digit code that you can write on your receipt or a QR Code for scanning. You can also now check-in from your upcoming reservation on the home screen.
Purchase Gift Cards: Visit the shop tab to Purchase Classic and eGift Cards.
Not a Frequent Diner Club member? Enroll on the app to join the club for exclusive member benefits:
• Earn one point for every dollar spent on food and drinks.
• Every 150 points automatically converts to $10 reward dollars.
• Exclusive and custom member offers.
• Be the first to know about our new restaurants and happenings.
• Reach Silver and Gold status. The more you spend in the calendar year, the more points you earn per dollar spent. Silver Members earn 1.25 points per $1 spent and Gold Members earn 1.5 points per $1 spent.
We’d love to hear from you! If you need help or have suggestions on how we can improve our app, please write to us at mobile@lettuce.com. Thank you!

- Upload a picture from your gallery or choose one from UNSPLASH Gallery
- Choose frame & Passepartout
- Start AR mode and test your pictures on the wall
WALLARY is developed for photographers, interior designers, art lovers, painters and everybody else who loves to see great pictures on the wall.
PRO VERSION

Additional functions:
- Create individual layouts from multiple images or access our ready-made
templates back

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
The following options are available:
2,99 $ per 1 month
19,99 $ per 1 year
Please note: WALLARY can only be used on the following devices: iPhone 6s or newer, iPad (5th generation) or newer, iPad Pro (1st generation) or newer
Terms of use: https://www.wallary.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.wallary.app/en/data-protection
SUPPORT
For FAQs and tutorials visit our website at www.wallary.app

WALLARY makes it easy for you to find the best pictures for your wall. How it works? We use Apples latest AR technology to visualize your pictures in any size and with different frames on every wall. Our goal is to inspire everybody which picture or photo gallery fits best to a given spot.

HOW IT WORKS
- Upload a picture from your gallery or choose one from UNSPLASH Gallery
- Choose frame & Passepartout
- Start AR mode and test your pictures on the wall

WALLARY is developed for photographers, interior designers, art lovers, painters and everybody else who loves to see great pictures on the wall.

PRO VERSION
As a WALLARY Pro subscriber, additional features are available to you.
Additional functions:
- Create individual layouts from multiple images or access our ready-made
templates back
- Use the Pro Toolbar to customize the frames, passe-partouts, colors, and backgrounds of your artwork
- Save all designs in your digital gallery, so you can visualize your artwork any size, anywhere on any wall

This Subscription is optional and automatically renews upon completion. WALLARY Pro can be terminated at any time. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

The following options are available:
2,99 $ per 1 month
19,99 $ per 1 year

Please note: WALLARY can only be used on the following devices: iPhone 6s or newer, iPad (5th generation) or newer, iPad Pro (1st generation) or newer

Terms of use: https://www.wallary.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.wallary.app/en/data-protection

SUPPORT
For FAQs and tutorials visit our website at www.wallary.app

bluejetty:00086776:ios.name: Savant
bluejetty:00086776:ios.summary: It’s the app that all other smart home apps have been modeled after. Innovative and beautifully designed, the Savant Pro app is the easiest and most intuitive way to manage your smart home. Control your lighting, climate, entertainment and
bluejetty:00086776:ios.description:
It’s the app that all other smart home apps have been modeled after. Innovative and beautifully designed, the Savant Pro app is the easiest and most intuitive way to manage your smart home. Control your lighting, climate, entertainment and security with a single app on your iOS device. Savant is the only smart home platform that also allows you to monitor and manage how power is used throughout your home.
UNIQUE AND PERSONAL
Get ready for next-level personalization. Automate your home with Savant Scenes to capture the perfect music, climate, lighting and security for every occasion. Create a schedule around your Savant Scenes or activate them manually using your voice, iOS devices, in-wall touch panels, Savant Pro Remotes, and keypads. 
The Savant Pro app also lets you customize your views—your rooms and home become the app, 
and with Savant’s award-winning TrueImage feature, you can visualize your lighting in real-time with images that update live as you adjust the settings. 
LIGHTING FOR LIFE
Savant’s patented Daylight Mode adjusts color temperature to match the sun throughout the day, harmonizing with your natural circadian rhythm. And our impeccably designed keypads let you recall different lighting scenes that you’ve created in the app with just a single touch. 
INTELLIGENT CONTROL OVER ENERGY USE
The Savant Power System is a truly smart energy solution that gives you personalized control over energy consumption, whether you’re 100% on the grid or you have solar panels, a generator or a backup battery. The Savant Power System lets you monitor and prioritize different electrical loads across your home, manage consumption during a grid outage, and gain insights about your historical usage.
SECURITY AND SAFETY FROM ANYWHERE
With Savant, you can control locks and garage doors, access your security and door entry systems, and access your cameras from anywhere. The app sends you customized notifications for critical events, such as extreme temperatures or motion alerts. 
AUDIO AND VIDEO EVERYWHERE
Savant is an industry leader in audio and video switching technology. Get high fidelity digital audio pumped throughout the home with our newly re-designed music interface, which supports Spotify, Pandora, Tidal, Deezer, Sirius XM, TuneIn and more. Want to play video games while watching the big game? With the Savant Pro app, you can tile multiple video streams onto one screen, making it perfect for sports or news events. 
YOUR PERFECT CLIMATE
Control virtually any climate system with Savant. Set climate schedules and control the temperature and lights for pools and spas. Create Savant Scenes to capture the perfect climate, lights and music for any occasion, accessible at the touch of a button through your thermostat. 
Ready to design your Savant smart home? Visit savant.com to find an authorized dealer.

bluejetty:00090797:ios.summary:

Eligibil
bluejetty:00090797:ios.description:
By downloading the "FAFSA 2026 Student Aid" app, you will be able to access a series of features and functionalities that will help you in your procedures and queries related to the FAFSA program. Here are some of its highlights:
Eligibility Requirements: Learn about the criteria and requirements needed to qualify for the FAFSA program. The application will provide you with information about low family income, academic status and other factors that determine eligibility for student aid.
Guidance on completing the FAFSA form: If you are interested in applying for student aid through the FAFSA program, the application will guide you through each step of the process. It will provide you with detailed guidance on the required documents and how to complete the form correctly.
List of resources and tools: Access a complete list of resources and tools available to students who wish to apply for financial aid through the FAFSA program. Learn about advising options, tutorials and fafsa calculator to help you plan your studies.
 Important dates and deadlines: The application will remind you of deadlines for submitting the FAFSA form and other required documents. Keep track of key dates to make sure you don't miss any opportunities for student aid.
Tips for maximizing financial aid: Get helpful tips on how to optimize your chances of receiving the maximum amount of financial aid possible. The application will provide you with strategies for submitting a successful application and highlighting your financial need.
Resources for parents and guardians: If you are a parent or guardian helping a student apply for student aid, the app also has resources and guides specifically for you. Get information on how to support the student through the process and how to complete the necessary information on the FAFSA form.
Frequently Asked Questions: You will find a section dedicated to frequently asked questions, which will address the most common topics and questions that often arise regarding the FAFSA program. This section will provide you with clear and concise answers to resolve your concerns quickly.
News and Updates: Stay informed about the latest news and updates related to the FAFSA program.
Access from anywhere: The app allows you to access information and resources anytime, anywhere. You can use the app on your Iphone or Ipad, giving you the flexibility to review information, complete the application and make inquiries at any time that is convenient for you.
Contact information: Through the application, you will be able to access user service channels such as e-mails, telephone numbers and contact addresses of the FAFSA program. This way, you will be able to make specific inquiries and receive personalized guidance.
Download the FAFSA student aid application to access all the information and resources you need to complete your FAFSA paperwork, as well as FAFSA-related inquiries.
Please note that the app aims to facilitate the understanding of the FAFSA form and provide information about available financial aid options for students, including scholarships, government grants, federal loan programs, work-study programs, and other related choices. The information available in the app should not be considered a substitute for professional consultation or legal advice in the field of student financial assistance.
For more accurate and detailed information about FAFSA and student financial aid, we recommend referring to the following official sources:
- https://studentaid.gov/
IMPORTANT! We want to make it clear that this app is not intended to replace or supplant any government agency, official entity or company. The main objective is to provide clear and concise information to help you in the process of accessing the benefits of the Federal Student Aid Program (FAFSA).

bluejetty:00098050:android.summary: Welcome to Block Carnival - Wooden 99, a thrilling and creative battle game that fuses the strategic elements of Sudoku with the engaging block-matching excitement of classic puzzle games, infusing traditional mechanics with innovative twis
bluejetty:00098050:android.description:
Welcome to Block Carnival - Wooden 99, a thrilling and creative battle game that fuses the strategic elements of Sudoku with the engaging block-matching excitement of classic puzzle games, infusing traditional mechanics with innovative twists!
In this adventure, you will encounter powerful robots, featuring some of the most brilliant minds in history such as Einstein, Newton, Edison, and Michelangelo. Each robot comes with its own special skills and tactics, presenting a genuine challenge to your abilities. Gear up for an exciting and competitive journey as you strive for the champion title!
Whether you’re looking for a mental getaway or some intellectual engagement, this game serves as the ideal choice. Immerse yourself in the captivating sounds of blocks as you explore the addictive realm of Block Carnival!
Expert Tips: Identify patterns that can initiate chain reactions during each round. Linking multiple eliminations can lead to spectacular combos and cascading blocks, greatly enhancing your score!
Gameplay Instructions:
- Arrange blocks on a 9x9 grid, completing rows and squares to clear them from the board.
- Keep your focus sharp as you create strategies to maintain a clear board while adjusting to constantly changing block shapes.
- Challenge yourself to surpass high scores.
- Employ strategic thinking to set off explosive chain reactions and accumulate combo points. Sustain your streak for even greater rewards!
KEY FEATURES:
- Eye-catching visuals and immersive audio effects.
- Lightweight design that occupies minimal space on your device.
- Suitable for players of all ages and backgrounds.
- Compete against robots.
- Explore various game modes.
- No internet connection required—play anytime, anywhere!
Are you ready to jump into the universe of Block Carnival - Wooden 99? Embark on a journey filled with endless fun! Enhance your cognitive skills and test your IQ with every move! Relax, unwind, and get lost in the engaging gameplay that provides a unique and customized gaming experience! Whether at home or on the go, challenge yourself and dive into the ultimate puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00186726:ios.description:
Includes all of the latest 2026 DVSA revision material for the UK Car Theory Test. With more questions than any other product on the market! 
Whether you have one day or one month to revise, it’s the best way to prepare. Master all of the topics and you’ll be guaranteed to pass. 
=========================
8 REASONS TO GET IT
=========================
1. LATEST DVSA LICENSED QUESTIONS – Contains every question, answer, explanation and image from the 2026 DVSA revision bank.
2. MORE QUESTIONS AND CASE STUDIES THAN OTHERS – Includes some relevant questions and case studies from previous years, because they're still a great way to test your knowledge.
3. UP-TO-DATE HAZARD PERCEPTION – Only the latest DVSA recommended CGI clips (48). None of the low-resolution, outdated DVSA videos included by some developers.
4. NEW DVSA REVISION CASE STUDIES – With the new style of CGI video clip scenarios. 
5. MOCK TESTS – Simulate the real test. Questions are randomly selected so there are almost an unlimited number of tests available. 
6. PRACTISE BY TOPIC – Get immediate feedback when you are wrong. This is by far the most effective way to learn.
7. STUDY GUIDES – Do you have time to read the whole of The Highway Code? If not, our study guides are the answer. These focus only on what is actually covered in the theory tests.
8. EASY TO USE INTERFACE – The clean layout and ease of navigating the app, take the stress out of studying. 
============================
This app is optimised for iPhone and iPod Touch. It also works on iPad and some iMacs.
============================

bluejetty:00131871:ios.summary:
Swiss precision & high-end weather data
More than just a simple weather forecast - experience the world's highest publicly documented forecast accuracy with meteoblue. Whether for everyday life, professional sports, agriculture or aviation
bluejetty:00131871:ios.description:
Swiss precision & high-end weather data
More than just a simple weather forecast - experience the world's highest publicly documented forecast accuracy with meteoblue. Whether for everyday life, professional sports, agriculture or aviation - our app brings the expertise of Swiss meteorology directly to your smartphone.
meteoblue displays highly accurate weather data in a sophisticated design, intended to be intuitively navigable while providing all relevant information. Check forecasts for any location on Earth - whether in the city, on the summits of the Rocky Mountains or in the middle of the ocean.
New: The meteoblue app for Apple Watch brings you the forecast, current weather, warnings and rainSPOT right to your wrist.
WHY CHOOSE US:
1. Swiss precision: The meteoblue forecast is composed of a unique selection of physical weather models that each excel at forecasting for specific variables and areas. The proprietary meteoblue Learning MultiModel post-processing technique blends and refines their outputs down to a 10-metre resolution.
2. Worldwide coverage: Search a database of over 6 million locations. Find weather data by place name, postcode or directly via GPS coordinates.
3. Offline mode: Stay informed even when you have no reception. meteoblue automatically stores the data from your most recent queries for offline use.
EXCLUSIVE FEATURES & PROFESSIONAL TOOLS:
Live rain radar & satellite: Track precipitation in real time. Our radar map displays rain, snow, hail and thunderstorm lightning activity with the highest level of detail. The global satellite maps show cloud cover and weather.
where2go - The Sun Finder: Plan your perfect weekend getaway - find the sunniest spots in your area on an interactive map with where2go.
Multimodel meteogram: Trust is good, comparison is better. See the forecasts from the leading global weather models (NEMS, ECMWF, GFS) in a single meteogram. When the models agree, the forecast is reliable.
Accurate 7- & 14-day forecasts:
7-day overview: Hourly values for temperature, precipitation, wind and UV index.
14-day trend: Our assessment of weather developments for long-term planning is as accurate as possible.
Predictability: A scale shows you immediately how reliable the current forecast is.
Specialised meteograms:
5-day meteogram: Vertical cloud layers, wind speed and temperature curves.
All-in-one meteogram: All important parameters at a glance - ideal for outdoor enthusiasts.
TAILORED TO YOUR ACTIVITIES:
Outdoor & hiking: Detailed information on wind gusts, frost limits and probability of rain.
Skiing & winter sports: Current snowfall limits and detailed mountain weather forecasts for the Alps and worldwide.
Aviation: Use thermal forecasts, trajectories and air stability maps for your flight planning.
Agriculture: Optimise sowing and harvesting with specialised data on soil moisture and spray weather windows.
MAXIMUM FLEXIBILITY:
Multiple weather widgets: Get the latest forecast right on your home screen – from a compact icon to a detailed 5-day outlook.
Personalisation: Choose your preferred units for temperature (°C/°F), wind speed (km/h, mph, knots) and precipitation (mm/in).
Ad-free option: Enjoy meteoblue completely ad-free and with extended features through an annual in-app subscription.
Resizible: Customize your home screen with our widget types that feature a resizable one to fit your personal layout and information density.
Become part of the meteoblue community! More and more users worldwide trust our data on a daily basis. Whether you are a professional meteorologist, outdoor enthusiast or a recreational skipper, meteoblue is your reliable companion in all weather conditions.
Download the app today and experience weather forecasting on a whole new level!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00021964:ios.name: a-Shell mini
bluejetty:00021964:ios.summary: a-Shell mini is a complete local terminal emulator, allowing to run most Unix commands on you iOS device. You can transfer files using scp and curl, edit them with vim and ed, process them using grep, awk and sed. Work with git repositories
bluejetty:00021964:ios.description:
a-Shell mini is a complete local terminal emulator, allowing to run most Unix commands on you iOS device. You can transfer files using scp and curl, edit them with vim and ed, process them using grep, awk and sed. Work with git repositories using lg2. 
Most commands are compiled for iOS native Arm64 format, making them fast and well integrated with iOS underlying BSD Unix.
a-Shell mini includes Python, Lua, JavaScript and webAssembly for programming and scripting. It also includes native ffmpeg and convert for fast image and video conversion.
There are also multiple network utilities: nslookup, ping, whois, ifconfig... Type help for help, help -l to get the full list of commands. 
a-Shell mini can be controlled from Shortcuts: run commands in order, process files in a-Shell, get the results as text or files, transfer files to other apps...
a-Shell mini uses iPadOS 13+ “multiple windows” ability, so you can run multiple shells at the same time, with different commands, in different directories. You can edit a file in one window with vim and process it in the other with python. 
a-Shell mini is a minimalist terminal, designed to have a very small footprint (less than 250 MB). If you need more commands, please consider a-Shell, which has more Python packages, more JavaScript modules, Perl, make, a C and C++ compiler and TeX.

bluejetty:00024779:ios.description:
Think Big. Believe. Dream. Dare.
What do you really want your life to look like?
Dreamer helps you discover your dreams, understand what truly matters to you, and turn your vision into something you can see and feel every day.
Create your personal Vision Board, explore your desires through self-discovery, practice manifestation, and stay connected to your goals with inspiring affirmations, reminders, and widgets. Whether you already know exactly what you want or are still discovering your direction, Dreamer gives you a beautiful space to imagine your future and create a vision that feels truly yours.
Create a Vision Board for Your Dream Life
Your Vision Board is more than a collage of beautiful images. It is a visual reflection of the life you want to create.
Collect the images, dreams, ideas, and intentions that inspire you. Create a personalized vision board for love, career, travel, wellbeing, relationships, money, personal growth, or anything else you want to bring into your life. Return to your Vision Board every day to reconnect with your intentions, strengthen your manifestation practice, and remember where you want to go.
Discover What You Really Want
Sometimes the hardest part of creating a vision board is knowing what belongs on it.
Dreamer helps you look deeper. Explore your desires, strengths, motivations, life direction, and personal patterns with self-discovery experiences designed to inspire reflection and new ideas. Discover dreams you may not have considered before, understand yourself from a new perspective, and use those insights to create a more meaningful Vision Board.
Manifest Your Vision
Manifestation starts with clarity. When you can clearly imagine the future you want, it becomes easier to focus your attention, choices, and energy around it.
Use your Vision Board as a daily manifestation tool. Visualize your dream life, reconnect with your intentions, and surround yourself with images and ideas that remind you of what you are creating. Dreamer makes manifestation feel personal, visual, inspiring, and part of your everyday life.
Positive Affirmations for Your Dreams
Support your vision with powerful affirmations. Read positive affirmations that match your intentions, use affirmation reminders throughout the day, and keep inspiring messages close with widgets. Affirmations can help you return to the mindset and feelings behind your Vision Board — especially when everyday life makes it easy to lose focus on the bigger picture.
Why Dreamer?
Dreamer is for you if:
- You want to create a beautiful and meaningful Vision Board.
- You want to discover what you truly want instead of following someone else’s version of success.
- You are interested in manifestation and visualization.
- You want daily affirmations that support your intentions.
- You feel stuck and want fresh inspiration for your future.
- You want to see the bigger picture of your life.
- You want a personal space for your dreams, ideas, goals, and future self.
- You want to feel more connected to the life you are creating.
Your Vision. Your Dreams. Your Life.
Create your Vision Board.
Discover what you truly want.
Visualize your dream life.
Practice manifestation.
Stay inspired with daily affirmations.
Start creating the life you want with Dreamer.

• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Read more about our terms and conditions here - https://sites.google.com/view/dreamer-app/

bluejetty:00173120:ios.summary:
DREAM UP AN INSTRUMENT, THEN BUILD IT

bluejetty:00173120:ios.description:
DREAM UP AN INSTRUMENT, THEN BUILD IT
Mela is a modular music-making tool that grows with you, from your first patch to deep custom designs. Create polyphonic synthesisers, unique audio effects, and complex MIDI processors. Mela runs standalone on iOS and macOS, or as an AUv3 plug-in inside your favourite DAW, including Ableton Live, AUM, Cubasis, Drambo, and Logic Pro.
EVERYTHING IS A MODULE
In Mela, there are no virtual cables to untangle. Instead, a patch is a tree of nested modules, where modules process their submodules in series or parallel. The layout of your patch is its signal flow. Everything moves with a drag, and a patch can stay tiny or grow into a deeply nested design.
MEET THE MODULES
Each module is focused yet powerful, and built-in help lets you quickly learn how it works. Here is a quick tour.
• MIDI processors: arpeggiator, chord, Euclidean sequencer, groove, note echo, note modifiers, quantiser, scale, strummer, MIDI capture.
• Synth building blocks: virtual-analog oscillator, FM operator, phaseshaping, noise, glide, unison, VA filter, amp envelope.
• Modulators: envelope generator, envelope follower, LFO, mod sequencer, XY pad, macro control, random.
• Audio effects: reverb, delay, chorus, flanger, phaser, distortion, ring mod, dynamics, EQ, pitch and frequency shifters, stereo tools.
• Visualisers: level and correlation metering, oscilloscopes, MIDI logger, notepad.
The full module list is at the very end.
MODULATE ANY PARAMETER
Every module parameter in Mela can be targeted by modulator modules with sample-accurate, polyphonic modulation. The full parameter tree is also exposed to the DAW for automation.
YOUR FIRST PATCH
Load Mela as an Instrument, an Audio Effect, or a MIDI Processor, then take your pick: over 250 included patches to play, pull apart, and learn from, or a blank patch and total freedom.
PAY ONCE, OWN FOREVER
Mela ships with 116 modules and counting, organised into collections. Collection 0 is free and has everything you need to learn how Mela works. The rest are single purchases. A patch that uses modules you do not own still plays in full. Locked modules process signals as normal, and a purchase simply unlocks their controls.
SAY HELLO
Wondering if Mela can do something specific? Just ask. Questions often become short demo videos, and feature requests help guide what gets added next. Say hello, ask anything, and help shape where Mela goes next.
Learn more about Mela at nikolozi.com/mela.
COLLECTION 0
Amp Envelope, Arpeggiator, Audio In, Audio Out, Lane, LFO, Meter, MIDI In, MIDI Lane, MIDI Meter, MIDI Out, MIDI-to-Poly, Notepad, Overlap Remover, Poly-to-Mono, Relative Pitch, Stack, Stereo Delay, Transposer, VA Filter, VA Oscillator, Volume.
COLLECTION 1
Balance, Chord, Chorus, Compressor, Control Change, Distortion, DS Oscillator, Envelope Follower, Envelope Generator, Flanger, Glide, Level, MIDI Logger, MIDI Source, Noise, Note Echo, Note Length, Note Range, Note Stack, Phaser, Pitch Bend, Random, Scale, Strummer, Velocity.
COLLECTION 2
Clipper, Comb Filter, DC Blocker, Degrader, EQ Band, Fixed Pitch, FM Operator, Macro, MIDI Capture, MIDI Channel, Oscilloscope, Pitch Oscilloscope, Pitch Ratio, Rectifier, Vibrato, Voice Activity, VPS Oscillator.
COLLECTION 3
All Pass, Audio-to-Mod, Band Pass, Correlation, Digital Delay, Dual Pan, Euclid, Macro Button, Mid-Side, Multiply-Add, Noise Gate, Note Chance, Note Event, Pitch Follower, Reverb, Ring Mod, Simple LFO, Stereo Pan, Stereo Tool.
COLLECTION 4
Crossover, Delay, Effect, Feedback, Gain, Gain Computer, Groove, MIDI Delay, Note Hold, Note Pulse, Note-to-Pitch, One Pole, Phase Distortion, Pitch Ramp, Quantiser, Splitter, Vel-to-Amp.
COLLECTION 5
CC Modulator, Frequency Offset, Frequency Shifter, Limiter, Macro-8, Matrix, MIDI Echo, Mod Oscilloscope, Mod Steps, Pitch Reader, Pitch Shifter, Pitch-to-Amp, Slew, Time Scrub, Unison, XY.

bluejetty:00028693:ios.description:
Maximize your focus, vitality, and joy. FitMind is a meditation program backed by neuroscientists and practiced by monks. In a world of chaos, join the mental fitness revolution.
You'll learn to master meditation in 30 days by progressing through a series of guided trainings. The FitMind app will also explain the science and psychology behind the practice and provide daily challenges for integrating it into your everyday life. This is not "McMindfulness," nor is it just another app to clutter your phone. Here's a deep mental training program that can impact the way you perceive the world.
ABOUT FITMIND
FitMind is a professional mental fitness company teaching at Fortune 500 companies, addiction centers, schools, government offices, and other organizations. 
We believe that mental fitness is the next health revolution and are passionate about bringing mind training to a wider audience with a secular and scientific method.
UNIQUE FEATURES:
• 30-day advanced meditation training program that systematically trains your mind
• Mental Fitness scoring and charts so you can track your progress as your mind becomes increasingly fit
• Ability to ask questions about your practice in the app
• Scientific explanations of the techniques and how to apply them throughout the day
• "Daily Challenges" that make meditation a lifestyle, rather than just a habit
• New guided trainings and lessons added regularly
• Access to a meditation community, science research, recommended books, retreats, and more
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TERMS:
FitMind is a free mental training program. However, our services do cost money and we invite our community to help pay for the cost of running the training program. We offer two auto-renewing subscriptions at $19.99 per month and $9.99 per month. These are optional, and we appreciate your support and commitment to the FitMind community. 
Note - These prices are for United States customers and pricing in other countries may vary.
Your subscription to FitMind will automatically renew unless you disable auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can turn off auto-renew or manage your subscription from your iTunes Store account settings. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
This app integrates with the Apple Health app, adding "mindful minutes" in the Mindfulness section. 
You can read about our terms and privacy policy here - https://www.fitmind.org/fitmind-privacy-terms.
Website: www.fitmind.org
Social: @fitmind on Instagram

bluejetty:00153601:ios.name: Car Games for Kids: Vehicles
bluejetty:00153601:ios.summary:
Get ready for a big adventure with Frosty the Cat and his amazing work vehicles! Together, you'll put out fires, treat patients, catch thieves, build houses, and do tons of other exciting jobs!
Frosty is already waiting for you in his busy
bluejetty:00153601:ios.description:
Get ready for a big adventure with Frosty the Cat and his amazing work vehicles! Together, you'll put out fires, treat patients, catch thieves, build houses, and do tons of other exciting jobs!
Frosty is already waiting for you in his busy garage. Just look at all those vehicles! There's a concrete mixer, a police car, a street sweeper, and even an ATV! Want to see what they can do?
Every vehicle has a special task, and you get to help! Jump in and explore a world full of mighty cars and trucks, exciting challenges, teamwork, and discoveries with Frosty and his friends!
Kids can explore 10 different cars and trucks:
• Fire truck
• Ambulance
• Police car
• Crane
• Excavator
• Concrete mixer
• Street sweeper
• ATV
• Tractor
• Magnetic crane
Each vehicle offers unique activities that blend fun gameplay with learning. Children will enjoy helping others, exploring teamwork, and discovering how things work — all while building fine motor skills, logic, and problem-solving abilities.
The app is made specifically for children aged 2 to 6. It's easy to play independently, with safe content, kid-friendly art, cheerful music, and clear voice instructions.
SCREENTIME TIMER
Take control of your child's screen time with a built-in timer. Set a limit from 5 to 60 minutes and decide what your child should do next — whether it's reading a book, tidying up their room, or getting ready for bed.
When the time is up, the screen locks, and a friendly voice invites your child to take a break. This feature supports healthy routines, builds good screen habits, and gives parents peace of mind.

bluejetty:00093696:ios.description:
Introducing Pup Pro Connect: Puppy & Dog Training App, Your Ultimate Virtual Dog Training
Companion
Are you ready to embark on a journey of canine excellence? Look no further than this Dog Training
App your one-stop destination for revolutionary virtual dog training. With our innovative Puppy
Training app, connecting with professional Dog trainers and transforming your beloved pet into a
well-trained and obedient companion has never been easier.
Puppy & Dog Training App
Step into the world of modern dog training, where geographical boundaries fade away, and expertise
is just a video call away. Pup Pro Connect: Dog Training redefines the way you engage with your furry
friend, Puppy Training offering a seamless platform for "dog training" that caters to all stages of your
pup's life.
Revolutionize Your Approach to Dog Training
At Pup Pro Connect, we understand that "puppy training" isn't just a task; it's a transformative
experience that shapes the bond between you and your pet. Our Dog Training app is designed to
cater to the unique needs of your pup, fostering trust, understanding, and obedience. From
foundational commands to advanced tricks, our comprehensive "Dog Training App" covers it all.
Master the Art of Communication with Dog Clicker Training
Experience the magic of "dog clicker training in puppy training app," a cutting-edge technique that
enhances communication between you and your furry companion. With this Dog Training App you'll
unlock a world of possibilities in training and bonding.
Access a League of Expert Dog Trainers in Puppy Training App
Imagine having a team of skilled "Dog Trainers" at your fingertips, ready to guide you through every
step of your pup's training journey. In this Puppy & Dog Training App you will connects with
professionals who have a deep understanding of dog behavior and training techniques. Whether it's
addressing "aggressive dog training," perfecting "puppy crate training," or providing solutions for "dog
separation anxiety training," our trainers are here to support you.
Unveiling Virtual Dog Training
Say goodbye to geographical limitations as Pup Pro Connect introduces you to the world of "Virtual
Dog Training." Whether you're at home or on the go, our app enables you to join interactive training
sessions via video. Our expert trainers guide you through each session, ensuring that distance is no
longer an obstacle to achieving a well-behaved and happy pup.
Puppy Training App to Customized Learning for All Stages
From "puppy virtual classes" that lay the foundation of good behavior to "dog training at home"
sessions that enhance obedience, Dog & puppy Training App caters to all stages of your pup's
development. Our "Dog Training \App" offers a diverse range of courses, allowing you to tailor your
pup's learning experience according to their needs.
A Multitude of Techniques and Strategies
Dive into the world of "positive reinforcement dog training," "puppy whistle" commands, and "easy
tricks to teach your dog" that enhance mental agility. Dog Training App is a treasure trove of
techniques that make training engaging and enjoyable for both you and your furry friend.
Nurturing Growth and Bonding
With "Pup Pro Connect: Puppy Training, every training session becomes an opportunity for growth
and bonding. Puppy & Dog Training app thrives on the principles of positive reinforcement, where
encouragement and rewards create an environment that fosters your pup's progress and nurtures an
unbreakable bond.
Your Pup's Journey to Excellence Begins Here
Are you ready to witness your pup's journey to excellence? Download Pup Pro Connect - Dog Training
App and enter a world where virtual dog training empowers both you and your furry companion. Say
goodbye to limitations and hello to a well-trained, happy, and obedient pup. Your furry friend's
transformation begins with Pup Pro Connect.

Welcome to PlanetCraft — a survival and creative block-craft game.
Mine resources, craft blocks, and build your own mini 3D world.
Play solo or online with friends in an endless world of exploration and creation!
FEATURES:
● Open world multiplayer with SURVIVAL and CREATIVE modes. Build and chat
● Thousands of fun MINI 3D WORLDS created by real players online for lite EXPLORATION
● Totally FREE
● MULTI-CRAFTING AND BUILDING recipes for blocks, items, tools, and armor for all your needs

● Friendly animals and hostile MOBS
● ADOPT PETS: wolves, ocelots, use spawn eggs, ride horses

● 300+ themed SKINS
● 10+ predefined mini worlds to start CRAFTING AND BUILDING
● 3D HD cube graphics, 4+ texture packs, and cute sounds
● Password-protected parental control
● Play online via the internet or Wi-Fi, or offline

► SURVIVAL CRAFT & CREATIVE SINGLE PLAYER — enjoy the game offline at your own pace
► PRIVATE MAPS — customize your cube world with access control for map modifications
MINI GAMES: start as a prop or hunter in Hide & Seek.
HIGHLIGHTS:
* Open-world gameplay
* Amazing 3D buildings
* Lite exploration
* Crafting and building recipes
* Friendly atmosphere
* Multi-block craft, real-time chat
* Lots of animals
* Attacking hostile mobs
* Free, fun, and easy to play
* Different weapons and enchantments
Join Planet Craft and start building your amazing mini world today!

bluejetty:00096995:ios.summary:
EXHAUSTED, BUT YOUR MIND WON’T SWITCH OFF?
Already gives you something soothing to listen to when thoughts keep you awake. Choose gentle rain, white noise, meditation music, or a softly narrated sleep story. Press play and unwind—without co
bluejetty:00096995:ios.description:
EXHAUSTED, BUT YOUR MIND WON’T SWITCH OFF?
Already gives you something soothing to listen to when thoughts keep you awake. Choose gentle rain, white noise, meditation music, or a softly narrated sleep story. Press play and unwind—without complex instructions.
You are not alone. That’s why we created Already: a minimalist sound experience for bedtime, meditation, and focused moments.
WIDE AWAKE IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT?
Return to a familiar sound at a comfortable, low volume. Try ocean waves, a gentle mix, or a calm story. Make space to rest without putting pressure on yourself to fall asleep immediately.
NOT SURE WHAT TO PLAY AT BEDTIME?
Try white noise for a steady background, nature sounds for an outdoor atmosphere, or guided breathwork for something to follow. With My Mixed Sounds, combine white noise, nature, and soft melodies exactly how you like them.
HAVE ADHD AND FIND IT HARD TO FOCUS?
Explore white noise or nature sounds while reading, studying, or working. Start with one small task and a low volume. Different people prefer different environments—if a sound feels distracting, change it or turn it off.
DISTRACTED, OR STRUGGLING TO GET STARTED?
Choose one sound and one next step: open your book or write the first sentence. Use Already as a familiar cue to begin, with background audio for work and gentle sounds for breaks.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPLORE?
• Nature Sounds: Gentle rain, ocean waves, rustling leaves, and flowing streams bring the calm of the outdoors into your bedroom or workspace.
• Meditation Music: Soft, melodic soundscapes for mindfulness, breathing, and winding down.
• Binaural Beats: Slightly different frequencies in each ear create the perception of a rhythmic beat. Explore tracks for relaxation, meditation, or focus. Use stereo headphones for the binaural effect.
• Subliminal Sounds: Affirmations layered beneath soothing background sounds. Choose themes that reflect your personal intentions.
• My Mixed Sounds: Blend white noise, nature sounds, and soft melodies into a personal mix.
• Guided Breathwork: Follow breathing patterns for a mindful pause or a gentle bedtime routine.
• Personalized Playlists: Curated tracks for stress relief, self-love, and personal intentions, including financial abundance themes for reflection—not guaranteed outcomes.
• Sleep Stories: Softly told tales with calm, steady voices offer something comforting to follow at night.
WHY CHOOSE ALREADY?
• Simple & Direct: No complicated lessons. Choose your sound and press play.
• Sound-Based Relaxation: Explore nature sounds, white noise, and binaural beats in one place. Research into binaural beats is ongoing; sleep, focus, and brainwave synchronization are not guaranteed.
• Make It Your Own: Choose a track or create a mix for bedtime, meditation, reading, or work.
• Health Integration: Connect with Apple Health to record supported mindful minutes and view available sleep information.
WHAT DOES PREMIUM INCLUDE?
Unlock the complete sleep toolkit: unlimited access to all sleep sounds, meditations, breathing exercises, and sleep stories. Explore premium binaural beats, white noise, nature sounds, and calming tracks for winding down, mindful breaks, and focused moments.
Stay Calm. Keep Dreaming. You are Already there.
Already is a wellness app, not a tool for diagnosing or treating ADHD, insomnia, anxiety, or other medical conditions. Experiences vary.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://alreadysleep.com/legal/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://alreadysleep.com/legal/terms-of-use.html

Return to a familiar sound at a comfortable, low volume. Try ocean waves, a gentle mix, or a calm story. Make space to rest without putting pressure on yourself to fall asleep immediately.

NOT SURE WHAT TO PLAY AT BEDTIME?
Try white noise for a steady background, nature sounds for an outdoor atmosphere, or guided breathwork for something to follow. With My Mixed Sounds, combine white noise, nature, and soft melodies exactly how you like them.

HAVE ADHD AND FIND IT HARD TO FOCUS?
Explore white noise or nature sounds while reading, studying, or working. Start with one small task and a low volume. Different people prefer different environments—if a sound feels distracting, change it or turn it off.

DISTRACTED, OR STRUGGLING TO GET STARTED?
Choose one sound and one next step: open your book or write the first sentence. Use Already as a familiar cue to begin, with background audio for work and gentle sounds for breaks.

• Meditation Music: Soft, melodic soundscapes for mindfulness, breathing, and winding down.

• Personalized Playlists: Curated tracks for stress relief, self-love, and personal intentions, including financial abundance themes for reflection—not guaranteed outcomes.
• Sleep Stories: Softly told tales with calm, steady voices offer something comforting to follow at night.

WHY CHOOSE ALREADY?
• Simple & Direct: No complicated lessons. Choose your sound and press play.
• Sound-Based Relaxation: Explore nature sounds, white noise, and binaural beats in one place. Research into binaural beats is ongoing; sleep, focus, and brainwave synchronization are not guaranteed.
• Make It Your Own: Choose a track or create a mix for bedtime, meditation, reading, or work.
• Health Integration: Connect with Apple Health to record supported mindful minutes and view available sleep information.

WHAT DOES PREMIUM INCLUDE?
Unlock the complete sleep toolkit: unlimited access to all sleep sounds, meditations, breathing exercises, and sleep stories. Explore premium binaural beats, white noise, nature sounds, and calming tracks for winding down, mindful breaks, and focused moments.

Stay Calm. Keep Dreaming. You are Already there.

bluejetty:00166228:ios.summary:

Used by millions
bluejetty:00166228:ios.description:
myNoise offers 350+ immersive soundscapes, entirely customizable. Move the sliders to create the ambience that perfectly fits your needs. The app is designed as your daily companion: to focus, to sleep, or simply to relax.
Used by millions of users worldwide, myNoise is designed for long listening sessions, with an average listening time of over one hour per session. 
WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
There are thousands of reasons why you'd need to immerse yourself in an ambient sound you crafted yourself. Here are the most frequent ones: 
• Focus & productivity. A stable audio environment for studying, remote work or the office. Widely used by people with ADHD, AuDHD or autism.
• Sleep. Build the ambience that helps you fall asleep, and cover whatever might wake you.
• Noise masking. Cover traffic, neighbours, an open-plan office or a noisy household. A steady background sound makes disruptive noise far easier to ignore.
• Stress & anxiety. Shut out the outside world when you need it most. Also used as PTSD support.
• Tinnitus relief. Tune a background sound that blends with your own ringing. Every tinnitus is different, so every sound here can be adjusted to match yours.
• Meditation & breathing, with a meditation bell to pace your sessions.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
A lot of things! Try the app :) But here are the main reasons we're different: 
• You shape the sound. Every soundscape has its own sliders. "White Noise & Co" alone covers white, brown, green, grey and pink noise, so a single soundscape can replace an entire app, or a physical noise machine. "Mediterranean Garden" lets you set the ocean waves, the wind, the cicadas.
• Or build your own. Creation Mode lets you combine up to 10 sliders taken from any soundscape in the app: rain from one, a drone from another, birds from a third.
• Professionally engineered. Every soundscape is built by research engineer Dr. Ir. Stéphane Pigeon and mixed for hours of comfortable listening. It keeps evolving and never loops back on itself.
• 100% human sound. Field recordings and real instruments. No AI-generated audio, ever.
• One purchase, for life. Free to download, no ads, no subscription. Unlock everything once and keep it, including every soundscape we release later.
INSIDE THE APP
• 350+ soundscapes: rain, forest, ocean, fireplace, fan, city ambiences, musical soundscapes, tonal drones and colored noises (white, brown, gray, pink, blue, green,...)
• Creation Mode, to build your own soundscape from up to 10 sliders
• A meditation bell you can set to ring at your own interval
• Presets to start from, and room to save your own
• Animate Mode, which moves the sliders for you so a soundscape keeps evolving
• Offline listening
• No ads, no subscription
Every soundscape comes with the story of how it was recorded, right inside the app.
If you have any question, always feel free to reach out to iOS@mynoise.net. Or just try the app, it's free!

bluejetty:00176048:ios.description:

Features include:
 · Customer Account- create or sync with an existing account in Arkansas's Wildlife License System
 · Purchases- conveniently buy hunting and fishing licenses, permits, stamps, and magazines.
 · Display licenses and permits- view current and past licenses and permits on your phone
 · Game check- submit game checks offline and receive a confirmation code once service is restored
 · Maps- interactive maps with directions and information on Arkansas's public lands, boat ramps, lakes, shooting ranges, and license agents
 · Resources- contact information, directions, phone numbers, the latest hunting and fishing digests, and other resources for outdoor enthusiasts
 · Weather- display current weather conditions and sunrise/sunset tables before heading out
The app requires internet access via Wi-Fi or cellular connection for some features.
