bluejetty:00177677:ios.summary: Water is essential to our life, drinking enough and right quantity of water is vital for our health. Water Reminder by VGFIT will help you to calculate, how much water your body needs, will track your hydration and gently remind you to drin
bluejetty:00177677:ios.description:
Water is essential to our life, drinking enough and right quantity of water is vital for our health. Water Reminder by VGFIT will help you to calculate, how much water your body needs, will track your hydration and gently remind you to drink water to fulfill your goal.
* Improve your health with personal drink notification.
* Create custom drink volumes easily.
* Schedule notifications according to the time you wake up and sleep.
* Choose the interval between notifications.
* Track your historical consumption during the day, week and month.
* Track your daily nutrition values.
* It is Good for weight Loss and it is the base of every healthy diet.
* Supports Imperial ( fl. oz. ) and Metric ( ml. ) units.
* Drinking enough water, will improve your health.
Water Reminder uses HealthKit in order to record drinking data to Nutrition section in Health application. The app requests access to the following data types: Water, Caffeine, Protein, Dietary Energy, Fat, Carbs and Sugars. When you add a drink to the app - it automatically sends to Health app the following nutritional information of that drink: water, caffeine, protein, calories, fat, carbs and sugars content. The synchronization with Apple Health can be switched off in the application Settings.
As a Water Reminder app user, you can choose the subscription plan that best suits your needs. Our Premium 1-year subscription plan offers unlimited access to all drinks, notification sounds, app widget, watch and remove all advertising in exchange for a single payment. In addition, 1-month subscription is available for users. For your convenience, subscriptions are set to automatically renew within the 24-hour period prior to the subscription end date. You can cancel your subscription at any moment in your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the terms. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: https://vgfit.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://vgfit.com/privacy

bluejetty:00062097:ios.description:
Read the entire Constitution of India including all the articles, schedules, and amendments as notified by Government of India in a very easy to use user-interface. The Constitution of India app presents a simplified version of our Constitution to the aspiring civil servants in our country. Constitution of India is neatly categorized into user-friendly categories. The COMPLETE Constitution of India in clean and minimal UI. Divided into Parts, Chapters, Sub-Sections and containing the full unedited text of all the Articles. Also Contains 100 Amendments (till date), 12 Schedules and all Central Parliamentary Acts (Net).Current Path is always displayed on the top.
• Preamble,
• Parts,
• Articles,
• Schedules
• Amendments as notified by Govt. of India.
• Bookmark your favorite/important articles, amendments, and schedules in constitution of India in English
• Fast and responsive user interface
• Share feature to easily send your favorite articles, amendments, and schedules in constitution of India to your friends
• App fully functional without the internet
• The app is very helpful for students pursuing Law or Legal degree and preparing for Civil Services Examinations.
• Gives know-how to people to know the working of the Indian Political system which is based on the structure defined by the Indian Constitution.
• Divided into Parts, Sections, Sub-Sections, and Article Lists.
• Contains all the provisions till 100 Amendments and their complete contents available
• A good way to teach kid's about the Constitution of India - Helps Improve the Productivity of people who refer the Constitution regularly.
• Share Article Title, Content or both through SMS, Email or any text related application.
• Constitution of India is very useful in IAS Study Material, IAS 2016 And many more!

bluejetty:00144940:ios.name: Flight Simulator 2d
bluejetty:00144940:ios.summary: Hey there, are you ready for a wild ride through the skies? Then buckle up and get ready for Flight Simulator 2D - the ultimate 2D flight simulation game for anyone who loves the thrill of flying! This game is perfect for beginners and avia
bluejetty:00144940:ios.description:
Hey there, are you ready for a wild ride through the skies? Then buckle up and get ready for Flight Simulator 2D - the ultimate 2D flight simulation game for anyone who loves the thrill of flying! This game is perfect for beginners and aviation enthusiasts alike, with its realistic cockpit controls and exciting game modes.
But let's talk planes - Flight Simulator 2D has you covered with a diverse selection of aircraft to choose from. Whether you're feeling like a simple single-engine prop plane or want to fly a passenger jet or combat-style fighter, there's a plane that will suit your flying style. With eight planes to choose from, you can customize your flying experience and take on different challenges with ease. Whether you're in the mood for a relaxing scenic cruise or an adrenaline-pumping flight, Flight Simulator 2D has the perfect plane for you.
The 2D graphics and simple gameplay of Flight Simulator 2D make it an easy and accessible game for players of all skill levels. The controls are intuitive and the physics are realistic, providing a challenging yet engaging experience. And with its sleek art style and fun gameplay, Flight Simulator 2D is sure to impress both casual gamers and diehard aviation fans alike.
But the real excitement comes from the game's environments, which are randomly generated and full of life and detail. Whether you're flying over small towns or soaring above bustling cities, the game's environments are full of breathtaking landscapes. With day and night cycles, players can experience the beauty of a sunrise over the ocean or the glittering lights of a city at night. And with a variety of environments to explore, from lush forests and rolling hills to towering mountains and sandy beaches, there's always something new to discover.
Flight Simulator 2D also features three exciting game modes: free flight, transport, and landing challenge. In free flight mode, you're free to explore the maps at your own pace, trying out different planes and enjoying the scenery. In transport mode, you'll be tasked with delivering cargo to various locations, testing your piloting skills and precision. And in landing challenge mode, you'll have to land as smoothly as possible to reach a perfect 10 out of 10 score.
And let's not forget the bonus systems - daily tasks and daily gifts. Completing challenges and tasks earns you rewards that can be used to unlock new planes, improve your airline and pilot rating, and increase your overall distance flown. With Flight Simulator 2D, the sky's the limit!
So, what are you waiting for? Download Flight Simulator 2D now and take to the skies! With its stunning graphics, authentic controls, and immersive gameplay, this app is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Whether you're looking for a fun way to pass the time or a challenging new game to master, Flight Simulator 2D is the perfect game for you. Get ready to fly like a pro and explore the vast and beautiful world that awaits you!

bluejetty:00200083:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200083:ios.description:
Build a stronger financial future for your child. 
Trump Accounts help eligible American children begin building long-term financial growth from an early age. Eligible children born between 2025–2028 can qualify for an initial $1,000 U.S. Treasury contribution beginning July 4, 2026.
GET STARTED
- Complete IRS Form 4547 to elect to open a Trump Account for an eligible child under 18. 
- Once your election is processed, you’ll receive an invitation to activate and manage the account through the app. 
- Family, friends, and employers collectively may contribute up to $5,000 annually to provide long-term growth potential.
BUILT FOR LONG-TERM GROWTH
- Accounts are automatically invested in qualifying long-term investment funds designed to grow over time. 
- Track contributions, monitor account activity, and follow investment performance directly in the app.
SUPPORT FROM FAMILY AND COMMUNITY
- Families, friends, and employers may all contribute toward a child’s future. 
- Certain children may also qualify to receive additional contributions from nonprofit organizations or state and local governments.
AT ADULTHOOD
- A Trump Account is a traditional IRA with special rules before the beneficiary turns 18. 
- At age 18, the beneficiary will take control of the account and can choose to use or continue investing the funds, subject to the rules that generally apply to traditional IRAs.
All investing involves risk.
Trump Accounts are individual retirement accounts established under federal law and administered under the authority of the U.S. Department of the Treasury. Robinhood Securities, LLC, on behalf of the U.S. Treasury and through its designated financial agent, serves as trustee for Trump Accounts and holds and administers account assets in a fiduciary capacity for account beneficiaries.
All U.S. children under 18 with a valid Social Security Number are eligible to establish a Trump Account. Parents, legal guardians, or other trusted adults can open and manage accounts on behalf of their children.
*This chart assumes bi-weekly contributions of $50 over a 13-year timeline with a 7% hypothetical annual rate of return. 
**This chart assumes an initial $1,000 U.S. Treasury contribution, monthly contributions of $50 for the first 5 years, followed by annual contributions of $5,000 for the next 13 years, all growing at a hypothetical 7% annual return. 
The hypothetical compound growth examples are for illustrative purposes only. They are not a guarantee of future results and do not account for real-world factors like inflation, taxes, fees, or market changes.
When the child turns 18, the account becomes a Traditional IRA. Funds can be used for any purpose, but withdrawals are taxed as ordinary income. For specific goals like higher education or a first-home purchase, withdrawals may also be penalty-free under IRS rules.
Brokerage and clearing services are provided through Robinhood Financial LLC and Robinhood Securities, LLC, each a registered broker-dealer and member of SIPC, respectively. 
The Trump Accounts digital experience was developed in collaboration with the National Design Studio, an entity within the White House Office of the Executive Office of the President.

bluejetty:00060686:ios.description:
Nitnem is a collaboration of different banis that were designated to be read by Sikhs every day. The Nitnem bani's usually include the Panj bania (5 bani's below) and sometimes Rehiras Sahib and Kirtan Sohila.
The following Banis are normally read by practising Sikhs every day:
Japji Sahib
Jaap Sahib
Tav-Prasad Swaiye
Chaupai Sahib
Anand Sahib
Rehras Sahib
Sohila
The first 5 Banis are usually recited in the early morning while Rehiras is read in the evening around 6pm. Sohila is cited just before going to sleep at night.

* Ad-free experience
* Apple Family Sharing
Whether you're planning your first visit or you're a seasoned passholder, this app puts everything you need right at your fingertips.

► RACE OPTIONS
Select your strategy for each race. You can select the type of tire you want to mount at the start of each race and when performing the PitStop (Super soft, soft, medium,
bluejetty:00117695:ios.description:
Compete in the world championship along 20 circuits.
► RACE OPTIONS
Select your strategy for each race. You can select the type of tire you want to mount at the start of each race and when performing the PitStop (Super soft, soft, medium, hard, Intermediate and Extreme rain)
Each tire has particular characteristics in terms of grip, maximum speed and wear.
► CONFIGURE YOUR CAR
Full configuration of car settings. Engine power adjustments, transmission adjustments, aerodynamics, and suspension adjustments.
These adjustments affect the behavior of the vehicle. Both in acceleration at top speed and in tire wear.
Try all kinds of settings to find the most suitable for each race.
► CAR IMPROVEMENTS
Earn credits by racing in the championship or sprint races to make up to 50 upgrades on each of the cars and increase your race performance.
► CHANGES IN THE WEATHER
The weather will change during the race and we will have to adapt the strategy to the circumstances that occur during the race. From sunny weather to heavy rain.
► QUALIFYING RACE
We will be able to run the qualifying race before the championship races to establish our place on the starting grid.
We can also run without qualifying. In this case our position will be random.
►TRAINING RACE
We will have the option of training in each circuit of the championship. Where you can try different configurations in our car.
At the end we will have a table of results where we can compare the results of each lap and configuration.
► QUICK RACE MODE
Apart from the championship. In this mode we can race on the desired circuit and quickly get credits to use them to make improvements to the cars or acquire new cars.

Com o UOL, você está sempre em dia com as notícias em tempo real, fatos do dia e os bastidores da política.  
6 MOTIVOS PARA BAIXAR O APP UOL: 
1 - Notícias rápidas e diretas

2 - Navegação sem anúncios para assinantes 
Faça login e aproveite textos e vídeos sem interrupções. Assine o UOL e tenha uma experiência fluida.

Receba alertas instantâneos sobre os principais fatos do momento e fique sempre em dia com o noticiário.

Acompanhe as análises e reportagens de mais de 100 colunistas renomados, como Daniela Lima, Josias de Souza, Fábio Serapião, Thais Bilenky, Juca Kfouri, PVC (Paulo Vinicius Coelho), Casagrande, Milly Lacombe, Milton Neves, Maria Ribeiro, Chico Barney e muitos outros.

Desafie-se com a Palavra do Dia, descubra grupos de palavras em Conexões e divirta-se com testes inteligentes criados por IA. Todo dia tem algo novo para explorar!

Acesse matérias das melhores agências de notícias, como Estadão, Reuters, Bloomberg, AFP e muito mais. Além disso, conte com parceiros como Folha, Band, Gizmodo, Agência Lupa e outros para enriquecer sua leitura."

bluejetty:00177511:ios.name: Carrier® Service Technician
bluejetty:00177511:ios.summary:
Solving challenging HVAC/R problems is your job. Helping you get the right parts, supplies, and equipment—and manage sites in the field—is ours.
The Carrier Service Technician app brings residential and commercial technician tools together
bluejetty:00177511:ios.description:
Solving challenging HVAC/R problems is your job. Helping you get the right parts, supplies, and equipment—and manage sites in the field—is ours.
The Carrier Service Technician app brings residential and commercial technician tools together in one Carrier experience. Whether you’re standing in front of a residential unit or covering commercial sites and equipment, the app is built for how technicians actually work on the job.
Use the same Carrier sign-in you already have. Your role and permissions carry over, so you see the sites, equipment, and content you’re authorized to access—no new account, no new password.
RESIDENTIAL TECHNICIAN EXPERIENCE
Whether it’s warranty repairs for Carrier equipment or non-warranty repairs on any make or brand, the app helps you identify the right part at the job site. On-board GPS helps you find the closest location for parts when you need them.
COMMERCIAL TECHNICIAN EXPERIENCE
Field-ready tools for commercial sites and equipment—without opening a laptop. Get a quick read on the sites you cover, check equipment status on the spot, and dig into site and equipment details when you need specs and history. Work offline in basement mechanical rooms or on rooftops with no signal; your data caches and syncs when you’re back online. Meet Willis—ask about an alarm code for troubleshooting steps, or search official commercial OEM manuals and pull the section you need so you spend less time in PDFs and more time fixing the unit.
KEY FEATURES
Residential & field service
• AI Assistant (Beta) — Ask technical questions, get support, and troubleshoot using model number inputs
• View Customer System Online — Look up customer details with advanced search filters
• System Capacity Calculator — Calculate airflow capacity based on job-site conditions and specs
• Product Registration — Register equipment quickly from the field
• Intelligent Equipment Search — Find equipment by scanning a serial barcode or entering a serial or model number
• Parts Identification — Access accurate parts lists for selected equipment
• Technical Literature Access — View technical documents with advanced filtering
• Warranty & Service History Lookup — Retrieve warranty details and past service history by serial number
• Nearest Parts Center Locator — Use GPS to find the closest Carrier Parts Sales Center and get directions
• Totaline® Parts Cross-Reference — Find equivalent and compatible parts
• Job Management — Create and manage job records and associate parts for future reference
• Secure HVACPartners Access — Log in for restricted technical content and documents
• Product Catalog — Browse and search the full Carrier product catalog
• Technician Training Resources — Access online training modules
• Tech Tips Video Library — Watch short, expert-led troubleshooting videos
• Interactive Troubleshooting — Step-by-step guided diagnostics
• Bluetooth Diagnostics & Firmware Updates — Pair with compatible systems for real-time fault data, performance metrics, and remote firmware updates
• NFC Connectivity for Installer Tools — Configure installer settings, retrieve diagnostics, and support service board replacement on supported equipment
Commercial field tools
• Site View — Quick status across every site you cover
• Device Manager — Equipment status when you’re on site
• Site & Equipment Details — Specs and history in the field
• Offline Mode — Keep working without signal; sync when you’re back online
• Willis — Alarm troubleshooting and commercial OEM manual lookup
• Faster Field Workflows — Quicker loads and fewer taps for common tasks
One app. Same Carrier sign-in. Built for technicians in the field—residential and commercial.

bluejetty:00151182:ios.summary:
WiseMeal: Your Easy AI Calorie Counter & Meal Planner
Struggling to track your diet? WiseMeal is an all-in-one AI calorie tracker scanner and nutrition tracker designed for effortless weight loss and health management. Powered by advanced
bluejetty:00151182:ios.description:
WiseMeal: Your Easy AI Calorie Counter & Meal Planner
Struggling to track your diet? WiseMeal is an all-in-one AI calorie tracker scanner and nutrition tracker designed for effortless weight loss and health management. Powered by advanced AI, WiseMeal simplifies food logging, macro tracking, and meal planning into one experience.
Record & Track Instantly
Transform your phone into a nutrition assistant with our AI calorie tracker:
- Snap & Identify: Take a photo to instantly see calories and nutrition. Our AI can even detect hidden allergens and additives, making food choices safer.
- Scan Barcodes: Buying snacks? Just scan the barcode to log it instantly.
- Vast Food Database: A comprehensive food calorie tracker to monitor calories, macros (protein, carbs, fats), and micronutrients.
- Complete Health Hub: Track your water, steps, and weight all in one place.
Personalized Just for You
WiseMeal adapts to your unique body and fitness goals:
- Set Your Goals: Whether you want to lose weight, gain muscle, or just eat healthier, we’ve got a plan for you.
- Smart AI Recommendations: Receive tailored workout plans and dietary advice. Includes Allergen Alerts to keep your eating safe and goal-aligned.
- Real-Time Calorie Deficit Tracker: View your remaining calorie budget at any moment, helping you make smarter "what to eat next" decisions.
- AI Health Analysis & Scoring: Get a daily score and insights into your nutritional balance. See exactly what you eat with detailed breakdowns of sugar, fiber, fats (saturated, trans, cholesterol), vitamins, and minerals
- Data Visualization: Track your transformation with intuitive trend charts for weight, calories, and nutrient intake.
AI Recipes & Meal Plans
- AI Recipe Generation: Simply input the ingredients you have on hand, and our AI will create a healthy, macro-friendly recipe instantly.
- Recipe Import: Easily import your favorite recipes directly from platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok into your personal food diary.
- 14-Day Personalized Meal Plan: Get a curated, 2-week meal strategy customized to your specific dietary standards and fitness objectives.
Why Choose WiseMeal?
Whether you are maintaining a consistent calorie deficit, hitting protein goals for muscle growth, or building sustainable habits, WiseMeal makes healthy living easy for busy people.
NOTE: We do not offer medical advice. Any and all recommendations should be viewed as suggestions, please consult with a professional and do your own research before trying a new calorie and nutrient plan.

bluejetty:00033217:ios.name: Zoog: Magical Storytime
bluejetty:00033217:ios.summary: What if you could star in your child's or grandchild's favorite bedtime story from anywhere in the world? With Zoog, you can. Record yourself reading - playful visual effects applied automatically turn you into the animated hero your child
bluejetty:00033217:ios.description:
What if you could star in your child's or grandchild's favorite bedtime story from anywhere in the world? With Zoog, you can. Record yourself reading - playful visual effects applied automatically turn you into the animated hero your child will ask for again and again.
IT STARTS WITH A SPARK
For the youngest kids, Zoog turns something familiar - your face and your voice - into their very own personalized story. As you read, Zoog's AR transforms you into the characters and shifts the scene around you, so you become the wolf, the princess, the friendly monster, page after page. Your toddler looks up, eyes wide. That is Mom, right there in the story. That is Grandpa. That flash of recognition is where a love of reading is born.
IT GROWS INTO A RITUAL
As your child gets older, reading together turns into the part of the day you both look forward to. You step into the same story side by side, both of you in costume. This is not a child watching alone. It is the two of you, inside the story together, until they ask you to read it again.
IT BECOMES A HABIT
One day your child opens Zoog on their own. They pick a story from our ever-growing library, finish a chapter, and reach for the next one, with new stories and worlds always waiting. The child who once needed you to start the story is now the one saying just one more chapter. And they can share every story they finish with the grown-ups who love them, so a parent at work, a grandparent far away, or a military family across an ocean gets to watch their little reader grow. This is the whole point: a child who reads because they want to.
WHY FAMILIES LOVE ZOOG
Reading together early is one of the best things you can do for a child's development, and Zoog turns it into the part of the day everyone looks forward to. Rated 4.9 stars by more than 300,000 parents, grandparents, and educators, Zoog makes that closeness possible for any family, whether you are in the next room or across an ocean. Beyond books, the same magic brings songs, lullabies, and video greeting cards to life for birthdays, holidays, and everyday hellos.
WHAT YOU CAN DO IN ZOOG
- Personalized bedtime stories with AR filters, effects, and music
- Sing lullabies and favorite children's songs
- Send video greeting cards starring you - birthdays, holidays, just-because
- Record once, share to any device, save to your family memory archive
- Hundreds of books in our ever-growing library, with new titles every week
- Reactions from your child saved to your Activity feed
- Reading requests: your child picks the next book they want you to read
TOP TITLES FROM OUR LIBRARY (300+ stories and songs)
Classic stories: Cinderella, Snow White, The Three Little Pigs, Goldilocks, Peter Pan, Peter Rabbit, Pinocchio, The Little Mermaid, The Wizard of Oz, Red Riding Hood, Winnie the Pooh, The Jungle Book, Jack and the Beanstalk, Hansel and Gretel, Hercules, The Frog Prince, The Tortoise and the Hare, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
Songs and rhymes: Baby Shark, Twinkle Twinkle, Old MacDonald, The Wheels on the Bus, Itsy Bitsy, Humpty Dumpty, Mary Had a Little Lamb, This Old Man, Jingle Bells, Silent Night, Happy Birthday Song, Head Shoulders Knees and Toes, If You're Happy and You Know It, BINGO
Plus DreamWorks Animation: Gabby's Dollhouse. New books from top-rated authors added every week.
Be the star of their storytime, and turn the first spark into a lifelong love of reading.
Follow us:
Facebook: facebook.com/zoogHQ
Instagram: @zoogHQ
TikTok: @zoogHQ
Questions or feedback? feedback@getzoog.com
Terms of service: https://www.getzoog.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.getzoog.com/privacy-policy/

Join Open Plays – Browse and join scheduled open play sessions with players of all skill levels. 
Find a Coach – Connect with experienced pickleball coaches for private or group instruction. 
Join a Clinic – Register for skill-based clinics and special events to level up your game. 
Reserve a Court – Quickly book a court and view real-time availability based on your membership tier. 
Chat with Members – Chat with other members and get plugged in to the Tejas Community

Know more about Houston with the Houston Chronicle app. Stay informed with trusted journalism wherever you are. 
• Get Houston news alerts and notifications, customized by preferred topics 
• Catch high school football, college sports, and Astros, Texans, Rockets coverage 
• Stay on top of Texas news, politics, business, food and development stories
• Tune in to the politics podcast Texas Take and sports podcast Fifth Down for expert analysis 
• Page through the e-Edition, a digital replica of the newspaper
• Stay sharp with Puzzmo’s reimagined favorites and brand-new puzzles
• Listen to Chronicle stories with Everlit, a text-to-audio tool 
• Check out exclusive guides and compelling columns and commentary 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• Subscribe for unlimited digital access to the app, HoustonChronicle.com, e-Edition and newsletters. Get 1 month free, then $14.99 per month. Cancel anytime.
• Current digital and print subscribers have unlimited access to the app.
• Digital subscribers: Sign in to the app to access your benefit.
• Print subscribers: If you haven’t activated your digital access yet, look for “Activate Access” at the bottom of the app welcome screen.
PAYMENT: Payment will be charged to your account with the confirmation of your purchase and will automatically renew each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of your monthly period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00126969:ios.description:
The Sounds True app is home to your entire Sounds True experience, from the online courses and audio programs you've purchased to the Sounds True One membership, including original series, guided practices, and live events with hundreds of world-renowned experts in mindfulness, healing, and personal growth. 
YOUR SOUNDS TRUE LIBRARY
Access the online courses and audio programs you've purchased from Sounds True's 41 years of publishing — all in one place, available on-demand, on any device.
SOUNDS TRUE ONE MEMBERSHIP
Sounds True One is a global membership community committed to growth, healing, and connection, with unique learning opportunities from the world's most celebrated wisdom teachers and best-selling authors, including Caroline Myss, Pema Chödrön, Jack Kornfield, Thich Nhat Hanh, Adyashanti, Peter Levine, Gabor Maté, Richard C. Schwartz, and many more.
Membership includes:
● Wisdom from World-Renowned Experts — Learn from leading voices in well-being, mindfulness, and personal growth.
● Exclusive Live Q&As & Interviews — Engage directly with sought-after teachers through interactive conversations and events.
● A Global Community — Share reflections, ask questions, and connect with members worldwide through live meditations and practice groups.
● Immersive Virtual Retreats — Join live, transformative retreats to cultivate self-awareness and growth.
● Weekly Group Meditations — Enhance your practice with meditations led by beloved Sounds True teachers and authors.
● A Variety of Wellness Practices — Explore meditation, mindful movement, qi gong and other techniques to support your well-being.
● Monthly Guided Experiences — A new theme each month to support your spiritual growth and self-discovery.
● Exclusive Original Series — Dive into our award-winning programs like Mystics Today, In the Flow, and Being with You.
● Special Member Discounts* — Get 20% off Sounds True online courses, plus exclusive event and course invitations.
In just a few minutes a day, Sounds True can help you feel more connected to yourself and the world around you.
Download today and continue your journey inward.
-
▷ Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
▷ New? Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
Sounds True offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
For more information see our: 
Terms of Use: https://product.soundstrue.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://product.soundstrue.com/privacy-policy/
Customer Support: membership@soundstrue.com

bluejetty:00082782:ios.name: Phinsh Photo Collage Maker
bluejetty:00082782:ios.summary: Phinsh Collage & Montage Maker is your go-to photo montage maker and photo editor, designed to turn your memories into a creative photo collage. Using a versatile photo grid, you can create a unique photo montage with an unlimited number of
bluejetty:00082782:ios.description:
Phinsh Collage & Montage Maker is your go-to photo montage maker and photo editor, designed to turn your memories into a creative photo collage. Using a versatile photo grid, you can create a unique photo montage with an unlimited number of photos to form beautiful and artistic collages in just a few clicks!
With Phinsh, you can create and customize eye-catching photo collages for various purposes:
• Social Media: Create engaging posts and stories for Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and more.
• Print Projects: Print your collages as framed pictures, posters, photo walls, t-shirts, mugs, pillows, cards, and more!
• Home Decor: Design stunning photo wall art or framed picture collages for home decoration. You can even create a unique wallpaper with your own photos.
• Business Branding: Make custom business decorations, such as a photo collage in your logo shape.
• Special Occasions: Create a unique love photo frame for anniversaries (heart shape collage), a custom birthday photo frame, or even a graduation photo frame 2025 to celebrate key milestones.
• Gifts: Design a thoughtful family photo frame for Mother's Day, Father's Day, or create a personalized scrapbook-style gift for any occasion.
• Promotions & Causes: Make promotional material or photo collages using text or logos for your cause or campaign.
• Creative Art: Turn your photos into a stunning Photo Mosaic, a unique creative photo collage, or a mood board. Perfect for digital scrapbooking and expressing your artistic side.
Key Features:
-------------
- Easy to Use: Our intuitive interface and improved photo picker with a 'Select All' option make creating beautiful collages a breeze.
- Unlimited Photos: Use as many photos as you like—whether it's 20, 50, 100, or even +500 photos in one collage.
- 350+ Shape Templates: Choose from a variety of shapes and templates including circle, heart, text, number, and more to design your photo collage.
- Add Text on Photo & Stickers: A powerful tool to add text on photo with various fonts, styles, and formatting options. Add fun and expressive stickers to make your creation truly unique.
- Cloud Photo Support: Seamlessly add photos from iCloud, Google Drive, and more to your collage.
- Flexible Layouts: Adjust grid spacing, change the layout ratio, move, resize, and swap photos. Instantly rearrange all your pictures with a single tap using the Shuffle feature.
- Picture Editor Tools: Swap, crop, rotate, or delete specific photos to fine-tune your collage.
- Multiple Aspect Ratios: Choose from predefined or custom aspect ratios for your rectangular photo collages.
- Custom Grid Density: Adjust the density of your photo grid for a finer or coarser shape fitting.
- Video Animations: Create stunning video animations from your shape collages.
- Gradient & Solid Backgrounds: Choose from +85 gradient backgrounds or pick your own solid background color.
- Social Sharing: Instantly share your photo collages on Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, X, and more.
Unlock More Power:
--------------------
PRO: Use your own Custom Shapes as a Frame for ultimate personalization.
PRO: Export your Collage with a Transparent Background.
Extra Feature: High-Resolution Saving (up to 6000x6000px) for top-quality prints.
Create your dream photo montage, birthday frame photo, or photo mosaic art with Phinsh, the ultimate unlimited collage maker. Show off your creative skills now!
We’d love to hear your feedback—please rate our app and share your ideas!
For support, contact us at: support@phinsh.com.

bluejetty:00027318:ios.name: Cync (the new name of C by GE)
bluejetty:00027318:ios.summary:
Control Cync and C by GE products with one game-changing app, powered by Savant—featuring a user-friendly home screen and navigation and a more personalized experience. It’s time to Experience Life in Cync.
What’s new?
The all-new Cync
bluejetty:00027318:ios.description:
Control Cync and C by GE products with one game-changing app, powered by Savant—featuring a user-friendly home screen and navigation and a more personalized experience. It’s time to Experience Life in Cync.
What’s new?
The all-new Cync App, powered by Savant, was thoughtfully designed to give you the best smart home experience possible. The innovative features include: 
Enhanced personalization:
• Add photos of your devices and rooms for easy identification and a more personal experience. 
• Enjoy the dynamic home screen that changes to put your most used products at your fingertips
Dark theme option
• It’s back. Change the app interface to dark for easier viewing—especially late at night.
Our patented TrueImage technology
• Take a picture of your lights and experiment with colors and brightness from your smart phone—from a different room or away from home.
Advanced color control
• Add RGB values to match your light color with your paint or décor. 
• Use the double color wheel to pinpoint the perfect color for your space.
Group devices within Rooms
• Add products to a group within a room to give you more control of your devices without creating new rooms in the app. Example: In your “Kitchen” room, separate “Island Fixtures” from “Ceiling Fan” for individual or paired control.
Improved stability and speed
• Connect to your products faster than ever before and get a much more reliable connection compared to the C by GE app. 
What can you do with the new Cync App? 
• Set a light schedule so you never come home to a dark house
• Change the colors or your space without painting
• Create multiple profiles and share control with more than one person at a time
• Set the perfect sleeping scene with one touch by pairing smart bulbs, smart plugs, and more.
• Add our Indoor Smart Camera to your entryway to make sure your kids got home from school safely.
• Keep your current C by GE products and connect them seamlessly with Cync products.
• With our Outdoor Smart Plug, you can turn on your outdoor holiday display with one touch from the comfort of your home.
Voice compatibility
Connect easily to Amazon Alexa or Hey Google for convenient voice control—with no hub needed. 
New Cync products:
Want to build onto your smart home? Add these new products to your home and control everything through our new app. 
Outdoor Smart Plug
• Extend smart control to your great outdoors. Want to activate the perfect patio with one touch? Add this all-weather product to your outdoor string lights and water features.
Indoor Smart Camera 
• Keep an eye on your home from anywhere. With HD video and 2-way audio, you can keep an eye on your kids from a different room or watch your pets from work. 
For more information about the new Cync App or other products, visit GELighting.com/cync
GE is a trademark of General Electric Co. Used under trademark license.

Quran Audio Library App (MP3Quran) aims to provide Quran recitations by famous reciters in different narrations on the web, mobile, watch and TV devices.
This is the official application of mp3quran.net, offering Quran recitations by more than 230 famous reciters. The app is available on iPhone, iPad, and other devices.

bluejetty:00178644:ios.description:
You wake up alone in a remote forest cabin. Everyone you once knew has mutated into ravenous zombies, and a clandestine experiment is to blame. Humanity’s last hope rests on your shoulders: reach the underground laboratory, craft the antidote and save whoever is still alive.
Gear up, steel your nerves and push forward. Ferocious creatures, lethal traps and mind‑bending puzzles stand between you and the cure. The world is dying; only you can stop the epidemic.

Story‑Driven Campaign — experience a full narrative arc that spans from the first blood‑spattered cabin to the final showdown deep beneath the bunker.

Arsenal to the Teeth — wield and upgrade pistols, shotguns, rifles and experimental prototypes.
Resource & Puzzle Challenges — scavenge supplies, hack terminals and unlock secret passages to stay one step ahead of the horde.
Terrifying Foes — face relentless zombies, mutated abominations and cunning boss monsters.
Cinematic Presentation — in‑engine cut‑scenes and atmospheric audio pull you straight into the apocalypse.
We poured our hearts into blending the best of story adventures, action shooters and survival horror. Ready to confront your fears and decide the fate of mankind?

bluejetty:00073711:ios.description:
Finding a caregiver job is easier than ever with Care.com. Discover thousands of opportunities in child care, senior care, housekeeping, pet care, and tutoring—all in one easy-to-use app designed to work for you.
Whether being a caregiver is your career or you’re looking for part-time or occasional work, you can find lots of opportunities to earn on Care.com.
Start today to join the 17 million caregivers (and counting) who have turned to Care.com. 
FIND JOBS THAT WORK FOR YOU
• Find meaningful work on your terms 
• Explore lots of opportunities—from nannies and sitters to housekeeping, senior care, tutoring, pet care and more
• Work around your schedule—whether you’re looking for full-time, part-time, or the occasional gig
TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR JOB SEARCH 
• Set your own rate—so you know how much you can earn
• Search local job posts and apply directly through the app

• Our team uses the latest technology to continually monitor job posts, messages, profiles, reviews, and more

Caregivers can choose a Basic Membership or upgrade to a Premium Membership to get additional benefits—including being featured more prominently in search results, priority job alerts, waived screening fees, and more.
Paid subscriptions will auto-renew for the same duration and price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of your current term. You can cancel your subscription in your Apple Account Settings.

O que você ganha com o app Agendor - CRM pa
bluejetty:00060834:ios.description:
O Agendor é uma plataforma de CRM e gestão comercial, que funciona como um painel de controle e assistente pessoal para equipes de vendas, trazendo maior visibilidade e domínio sobre os negócios.
O que você ganha com o app Agendor - CRM para Vendas?
• Mais agilidade à frente das negociações
 Colaboração em tempo real para fazer mais em menos tempo.
• Menos trabalho para fechar vendas complexas
 Praticidade para reduzir o trabalho manual e agilizar o trabalho do dia-a-dia.
• Mais poder de negociação
 Todas as informações sobre as negociações acessíveis de qualquer lugar.
• Mais relações valiosas e duradouras
 Te ajudamos a lembrar de todas suas atividades e compromissos.
O app Agendor está ao seu serviço
• De forma inteligente, sugere o que deve ser feito para evoluir negociações (fluxos inteligentes de atividades).
• Disponibiliza informações de clientes e oportunidades até mesmo offline.
• Geolocaliza clientes no mapa para otimizar visitas comerciais.
• Envia lembretes de reuniões, ligações e outras atividades automaticamente.
• Organiza suas negociações em um Funil de Vendas visual, que te dá uma visão panorâmica do seu processo comercial.
• Guarda o histórico de interações e centraliza todo o cadastro de clientes e oportunidades de vendas.
• Faz backups automáticos e sincroniza todas as informações com a versão Web.
• Identifica o cliente que está ligando, mesmo que ele não esteja cadastrado em sua agenda telefônica.
• Facilita a busca de clientes e negócios por produtos/serviços de interesse.
O app Agendor - CRM para Vendas é gratuito?
Sim, o Agendor Gratuito é uma versão gratuita do nosso CRM online por tempo ilimitado, com até 2 usuários, 1.000 empresas, 1.000 pessoas (contatos) e 150 negócios.
NOTA: Para trabalhar com o app Agendor - CRM para Vendas, você precisa cadastrar uma conta gratuitamente.
Depoimento de cliente
"O Agendor tem nos ajudado a organizar a rotina comercial desde a prospecção até o fechamento da proposta. O recurso de agendamento é fundamental para que o vendedor não se perca em meio à prospecção nem pule as etapas do processo de vendas." - Gisele Paula, Diretora Comercial Obvio Brasil (ReclameAqui).

bluejetty:00171429:ios.description:
Embark on a bunny-filled journey in Usagi Shima, where you transform an abandoned island into a cozy haven for adorable bunnies!
Usagi Shima is a relaxing, bunny-collecting idle game. Decorate your island to your liking and attract adorable new bunnies with your enchanting items and buildings. Care for your bunnies in this cute game and grow friendships as you discover their favorite toys and times to visit.
With four daily shop refreshes, the choices of items to unlock feel endless! Turn your island into a whimsical bunny paradise by using carrots to collect toys, plants, and charming building decorations. Relax and enjoy the calm and cozy island atmosphere, synced to your time of day.
Entice fluffy tourists, dress them in delightful hats, and earn a special gift as you become the best of bunny buddies! Make your island cozy for rare and special bunnies who come to pay a visit under the right conditions. Check in throughout the day and see if you can collect them all!
Craft a bunny retreat like no other and design a homey escape for you and your bunnies to enjoy. Feed them, brush their fluffy fur, and engage in playful activity. Immerse yourself in a soothing atmosphere and enjoy precious moments in real-time with your bunny pals.
Design your island and get ready to unwind in a delightful bunny sanctuary. Download Usagi Shima and play for free now!
⁕ Usagi Shima Features ⁕
⁕ Bunny Wonderland Decoration ⁕
• Design your bunny island with toys, plants & interactive buildings
• Visit the shop and use carrots to collect 100+ items to decorate with
• Discover new items with four shop refreshes daily
• Customize your island with our free-form design landscape
⁕ Collect Cute Bunny Companions ⁕
• Discover and collect 30+ rabbits with unique looks and features
• Dress your bunnies in adorable hats and earn a special keepsake gift
• Grow your friendship as you learn each bunny’s favorite toys
• Scroll through the BunBook to discover their personalities
⁕ Soothing Mini Games ⁕
• Cuddle with care and show some love to your bunnies
• Pet, feed, brush, and play hide and seek with the bunnies to build friendships
• Go on a bun run to collect more carrots and entertain your rabbits
• Capture each precious moment in a photo album or save to create a wallpaper
⁕ Cozy Idle Game ⁕
• Play a calming bunny game with no time limits and no stress
• Enjoy the convenience of portrait & landscape orientation gameplay
• Experience the island’s peaceful ambience in real-time, matching your time of day
• Find charm in the hand-drawn & traditionally animated art style of Usagi Shima
Cozy up in this cute game and enjoy building your bunny sanctuary today in Usagi Shima!
DOWNLOAD NOW to play for free and offline!
---
Play Usagi Shima...
If you have a soft spot for bunnies, dream of having a bunny companion, or proudly identify as a bunny parent, Usagi Shima is the perfect tranquil game for you! Dive into a serene world adorned with adorable bunnies, offering a soothing and enjoyable experience.
If you have a passion for decorating, interior design, tycoon games, clicker games, and simulators, or prefer relaxing casual games and other pocket camp games.
If you seek relaxation, meditation, and ways to alleviate anxiety and depression while indulging in cute games with charming art, Usagi Shima is your ideal destination.
Take a whimsical trip to Usagi Shima, where the bunny paradise awaits to bring you joy!

bluejetty:00129031:ios.summary: Sound Recorder Plus is a clean and well-designed audio recording app that is easy-to-use and captures terrific sound. Recording a voice message, memo, lovely song, audio note or even birds singing will always be at your fingertips with our
bluejetty:00129031:ios.description:
Sound Recorder Plus is a clean and well-designed audio recording app that is easy-to-use and captures terrific sound. Recording a voice message, memo, lovely song, audio note or even birds singing will always be at your fingertips with our audio recorder.
Sound Recorder Plus has a solid set of useful features for recording, playback, and social media sharing:
RECORDING
Overwrite recordings on the fly
Just pause the current recording, rewind it, dragging the progress plumb line back, and overwrite the audio from the selected point.
Impressive audio quality with mono and stereo sound options
The Sound Recorder Plus supports the AAC and WAV voice recording formats.
Recording in the background
Continue recording even if the screen is off - when you press the Home button, the recording controls will move to the notification bar for fast access.
Automatic saving
If the recording is interrupted, it is automatically saved with the default name, so you don't lose the captured voice or music. Otherwise, you can always save the recording on your terms, or discard the recording if you want to give it another try.
Unlimited recording time
Capture audio files of any length - the only limit to how long you can record is your desire and the size of your phone’s memory.
PLAYBACK
A mini-player and a full-screen player
A mini-player available in the Recordings list allows listening to the recording right away, and the full-screen player offers an advanced playback feature set.
Adjustable playback speeds
Slow down to 0.25x speed, and speed up by twice the normal playback speed to 2.0x using the embedded audio player.
Social media sharing
Share your special moments, notes, talents, and ideas with others.
Convenient audio playback controls
Drag the progress plumb line to jump to a specific point in the recording.
You can use the Sound Recorder Plus for a wide range of activities that involve recording audio and listening to the captured voice or music:
For work
Record important meetings in real life and zoom

bluejetty:00023473:ios.name: G7 TAXI - Book a taxi
bluejetty:00023473:ios.summary:
G7 Taxi is the first taxi booking app in Paris and Ile-de-France.
Order your taxi in 1 click on your smartphone and access the 10,000 taxi drivers selected and trained to G7 service quality standards.
Booking a G7, for an immediate depart
bluejetty:00023473:ios.description:
G7 Taxi is the first taxi booking app in Paris and Ile-de-France.
Order your taxi in 1 click on your smartphone and access the 10,000 taxi drivers selected and trained to G7 service quality standards.
Booking a G7, for an immediate departure or a booking in advance, that suits your needs, has never been easier:
o Launch the app, you are geolocated, indicate the number of passengers to benefit from the most adapted service, tap on "Now" to book a G7 where you are, or "In advance" for a request up to 30 days in advance
o You can also manually enter your departure address using the input help or use your favorite address book. If you enter the destination address, you can estimate the duration and price of your trip.
o Select if you wish the desired service from a wide range of offers : 
* G7: Simplicity and efficiency 
* G7 Green : 1st eco-responsible fleet in Europe with 7,800 hybrid or electric vehicles
* G7 Van : to travel up to 7 people
* G7 VIP : luxury sedans (Mercedes E-Class or equivalent), drivers selected for their professionalism, discretion, many on-board services such as wifi, water bottle, and priority of your booking.
* G7 Van VIP : to travel up to 7 people with the comfort and the VIP services 
* G7 Access: taxis with access ramp for people with reduced mobility
* G7 Famille: booster seats and baby seats
* G7 Coffre+ : bulky luggage
- You can fine tune your booking with options tailored to your specific needs: 
* English speaking driver
* Animal on board
* Third party payers
o Choose your payment method directly from the app (on registered credit card) or on board with your driver
o You can also leave specific instructions to your driver 
o Follow the arrival of your taxi in real time on the map with the possibility of being put in direct contact with your driver
o Easily locate your taxi thanks to the display of useful information (vehicle registration, brand and colour)
o Once the trip is over, you can evaluate the trip.
The G7 Taxi application is also:
o G7 Connect ! Take a G7 on the street and pay with your app!
o For your trips to or from train stations or airports, book your G7 immediately or in advance.All Paris airports and train stations are covered:
o Orly and Roissy Charles de Gaulle on all terminals: your trips to or from airports at fixed prices with airport packages, from €36 Paris - Orly and from €56 Paris - Roissy CDG.
o Saint-Lazare station, Lyon station, Gare du Nord, Montparnasse station, Austerlitz station, Gare de l'Est, Paris-Bercy station, Roissy CDG TGV station, Marne La Vallée Chessy TGV station, Massy TGV station
G7, in brief:
o A taxi in less than 4 minutes in Paris thanks to a fleet of 10000 G7 taxis
o The possibility of contacting a call centre agent based in one of our Customer Relations Centres open 7 days a week and 24 hours a day in France
o Professional drivers selected and trained by us, with an average quality score of 4.9/5
o Continuous quality monitoring: more than 7,000 mystery shopping and 46,000 field checks per year
o Faster itineraries: access to reserved lanes, control of itineraries by our drivers
o Regulated fares: no unpredictable fare increases, fixed approach fares and airport packages

The DASH Diet is for preventing and lowering hypertension, as well as encouraging natural healthy weight loss.
DASH stands for Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension. The main goal of the diet is to prevent and lower high blood pressure, although there are some other beneficial "side-effects" such as weight loss. It is a heart health recommended diet and the best for high blood pressure along with healthy weight loss.
The DASH diet is rich in fruits, vegetables, fat-free or low-fat milk and milk products, whole grains, fish, poultry, beans, seeds, and nuts. It also contains less salt and sodium; sweets, added sugars, and sugar-containing beverages; fats; and red meats than the typical American diet. This heart healthy way of eating is also lower in saturated fat, trans fat, and cholesterol and rich in nutrients that are associated with lowering blood pressure—mainly potassium, magnesium, and calcium, protein, and fiber.
The DASH eating plan doesn't require any special foods or supplements like a lot of homeopathic diets. It simply calls for a certain number of daily servings from various food groups. The number of servings depends on the number of calories you’re allowed each day. Your calorie level depends on your age and, especially, how active you are. You will also limit your sodium levels to either 2300mg or 1500mg each day. The less salt you eat, the more you may be able to lower your blood pressure.
The information in this app is not intended to replace a one-on-one relationship with a qualified health care professional and is not intended as medical advice. MyDashDiet encourages you to make your own health care decisions based upon your research and in partnership with a qualified health care professional.

bluejetty:00178187:ios.summary: Auto Brawl Chess is an auto battler strategy RPG game, in the royal battle genre. Enjoy classic auto chess mechanics plus fast-paced 5-minute matches. On top of that, PvE and PvP mode, exciting Mini-Games, dungeons, and a whole PvE campaign
bluejetty:00178187:ios.description:
Auto Brawl Chess is an auto battler strategy RPG game, in the royal battle genre. Enjoy classic auto chess mechanics plus fast-paced 5-minute matches. On top of that, PvE and PvP mode, exciting Mini-Games, dungeons, and a whole PvE campaign called “Journey”. The unique and complete autochess game where strategy is a key, but luck also plays a role!
We explored the whole genre to bring to you all the best features and mechanics, all the auto battles and much more of the new stuff from us:
● Quick matchmaking and Fast 5-Minute Battles;
● A variety of competitive modes: Ranked PvP mode and event rankings;
● A lore-rich campaign “Journey” with an epic story involving many different worlds;
● Numerous mechanics and idle quest system;
● High-quality, polished visual style; 
● 100+ fantasy heroes with their own storyline and a specific Faction and a Class 
● Loads of hero combinations, allowing you to build the strongest synergy set.
You can level up your heroes and craft/enhance their equipment outside the battle.
Join Auto Brawl Chess and prove yourself by unique gameplay, boost your Heroes, get rewarded just for playing the game. Complete the quests, join the battles and you will receive EXTRA bonuses from the CHESS PASS. 
Good Luck, player, and try to win first place at ABC!
Note:
“Auto Brawl Chess: Battle Royale” is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you do not want to use this feature, please set up password protection for purchases in the settings of your App Store app.
A network connection is required.
Support:
Are you having problems? Please contact us via e-mail: autobrawlchess@panoramikgames.com or in-game by going to Settings > Support.
Visit our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/autobrawlchess
Join our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/autobrawlchess

bluejetty:00034114:ios.summary:
Welcome to Ninimo's Cat Supermarket! 
Step into the wonderful world of Ninimo, the cute cat, and manage a bustling grocery shop filled with delightful products, lovable animals, and customers. 
This meow-velous simulation tycoon game invite
bluejetty:00034114:ios.description:
Welcome to Ninimo's Cat Supermarket! 
Step into the wonderful world of Ninimo, the cute cat, and manage a bustling grocery shop filled with delightful products, lovable animals, and customers. 
This meow-velous simulation tycoon game invites you to run your own store, expand your market empire, and experience the joy of being a store manager.
In this game, you can:
RUN YOUR SUPERMARKET
Manage and grow your own cat mart, turning it into a thriving business. 
As a store manager, you will oversee every aspect of your market, from stocking shelves to managing finances. 
Transform your humble shop into a popular destination for all the local animals and customers.
PRODUCE & SELL
Create a variety of products, including Taiyaki, bread, and ketchup, using fresh ingredients such as wheat, flour, eggs, strawberries, and tomatoes. 
Experience the joy of making and selling a wide range of products, including Milk tea, pizza, jam, coffee, juice, and more.
The more diverse your product range, the more customers will come! 
ANIMAL CARE
Raise chickens and cows to ensure a steady supply of fresh eggs and milk for your supermarket. 
Taking good care of your animals is crucial for maintaining the quality of your products and keeping your customers satisfied.
HIRE EMPLOYEES
Employ cashiers, shelvers, farmers, and chefs to keep your store running smoothly and efficiently. 
Upgrade each employee's skills to their best fit and keep them motivated as they play a vital role in your supermarket's success.
UPGRADE & EXPAND
Improve your machines, animals, and employees to boost efficiency and productivity. 
Unlock new marts such as cafes, pizza joints, and milk tea shops to diversify your business and attract even more customers.
RELAXING GAMEPLAY
Enjoy the stress relief of running your own market tycoon with cute graphics and a cozy atmosphere. 
The game's relaxing gameplay ensures that you can unwind while managing your supermarket and achieving your business goals.
MAKE MONEY
Strategize and accumulate wealth to expand your market empire. 
Smart investments and efficient management will help you grow your business and turn your supermarket into the most popular spot in town.
This game is a delightful blend of fun and relaxation, purrfect for anyone looking to manage their own grocery store and make money while enjoying the company of cute cats. 
With easy controls and endless possibilities, Ninimo Cat Supermarket: Tycoon is sure to heal your heart and bring a smile to your face!
Nyan! Download now and start building your own cat mart today! 
Experience the joy of running a successful supermarket with Ninimo by your side.

bluejetty:00178857:ios.description:
Give life to your machine.
Bathe the road in oil, gasoline, and fire. Rise to glory, shiny and chrome.
In Road Warrior, your car is your weapon. Arm it with brutal post-apocalyptic guns and nitro-powered gear, then race, flip, and battle for survival on furious roads and deadly wastelands.
Experience explosive PvP battle races in real-time multiplayer. Blow up your rivals, dodge relentless enemy fire, and prove your skill on mad roads where every race is a fight for dominance.
Unlock and collect a powerful arsenal of combat vehicles. From fast turbo sedans to massive monster trucks, each vehicle features unique weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Master them all and be ready for anything the road throws at you.
Upgrade and customize your vehicles with deadly weapons, tuning parts, and visual skins. Unlock new guns and customization options as you climb the leaderboards and show the wasteland your nitro-powered glory.
Perform mad, risky flips during races to charge your engine and unleash massive nitro boosts. Push your speed to the limit and leave nothing behind but fire and wreckage.
Dominate the wastelands to a high-energy rock n roll soundtrack that fuels every explosion, drift, and last-second victory.
Road Warriors from all over the world are waiting. Master every weapon, conquer every track, and fight your way to the top of the global and local leaderboards.
Constantly evolving
Look forward to new cars, tuning options, customization skins, maps, special events, and game modes.
Road Warrior is completely free to play. Optional in-game purchases are available. You can disable in-app purchases at any time.
Get in your car. Load your weapons.
Race, shoot, flip, and become the ultimate Road Warrior.

bluejetty:00088912:ios.description:
A Professional Fonts Tool Designed for Font Enthusiasts!
This is a professional fonts library tool tailored specifically for font lovers. We provide a vast collection of letter fonts, ranging from classic to creative styles. Explore our exciting range featuring cool fonts that bring an edgy modern twist, free fonts available for every project, and cute fonts that add a delightful charm to your designs. Whether you need fonts for everyday use or personalized projects, you’ll easily find the perfect one to elevate your creative work.
FEATURES
- Professional and Convenient Fonts Library: A curated collection of fonts in various styles and languages to meet both everyday and professional needs.
- High-Quality Font Selection: From timeless classics to innovative designs, you’ll always find a font that suits your style.
- Multi-language Support: Access fonts optimized for different languages (e.g., English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese) to facilitate seamless multilingual use.
- Custom Font Preview: Test fonts with your own input before installation to ensure they meet your expectations.
- Quick Export and Management: Easily install fonts with one click and export them for use across other applications or devices.
- Clear Overview of Installed Fonts: View and manage all installed fonts directly within the app.
We value every user’s experience. If you encounter any issues or have valuable suggestions, please don’t hesitate to contact us through the feedback channel in the Fonts app. We will address your concerns as soon as possible.

bluejetty:00174957:ios.description:
Explore the world offline with Guru Maps Pro — detailed maps, turn-by-turn navigation, and GPS track recording that keep working when you have no signal.
Download maps once and use them anywhere (powered by OpenStreetMap). Plan routes, record adventures, save favorite places, and sync everything across devices.
OFFLINE MAPS
• Download maps for countries or regions and use them fully offline.
• Rich detail and millions of places. Monthly map updates.
NAVIGATION THAT WORKS OFFLINE
• Voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions with automatic rerouting.
• Lane guidance for clearer driving in complex junctions.
• Modes: car, bike, truck, walk, plus straight-line navigation (great for sailing or off-road).
ROUTE PLANNING
• Build multi-stop routes with custom waypoints.
• Choose fastest or shortest route and save your plans.
• Export routes to GPX/KML to share or back up.
TRUE 3D RELIEF & TERRAIN
• Preview hills and valleys in True 3D Relief.
• High-detail terrain: contour lines, hillshade, and topographic overlays.
• Elevation profiles and slope charts for smarter planning.
GPS TRACK RECORDING
• Record tracks with one tap (even in the background).
• Live stats: speed, distance, time, altitude.
• Analyze tracks with interactive graphs and export to GPX/KML.
FAST OFFLINE SEARCH
• Search by name, address, category, or coordinates — offline.
• Instant results as you type, with multi-language support.
POI & ORGANIZATION
• Save places with custom pins and icons.
• Organize everything into folders and share with friends.
OPENING HOURS
• See opening hours for places when available.
SYNC ACROSS DEVICES
• Sync and back up your markers, tracks, and collections with one Guru Maps account across iOS, macOS, and other platforms.
CARPLAY
• Use Guru Maps on Apple CarPlay with offline maps and voice directions.
NO ADS. PRIVACY FIRST.
• No advertising. Your location stays on your device.
Power features: one-finger zoom, compass & scale, coordinate grids (MGRS/UTM), GeoJSON overlays, MBTiles/sqlitedb import, and more.
Download Guru Maps Pro and explore with confidence — anywhere, anytime with:
• Unlimited offline map downloads
• Unlimited markers and GPS tracks
• Pro map sources, including Satellite and specialist layers (cycling, outdoors, marine, ski, etc.)
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy: https://gurumaps.app/terms_of_service
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Cozy Room: Where Every Object Tells a Story
More than a game, Cozy Room is a soulful experience that celebrates life's quiet magic. As you unpack boxes filled with personal treasures, each carefully placed item unveils chapters of a life—room by room, memory by memory.
How It Works:
Mindful Unpacking: Discover nostalgic belongings and curate them into meaningful spaces
Story Through Objects: Let vintage photos, childhood toys, and handwritten notes whisper their tales
No Rush, No Rules: Enjoy therapeutic organizing at your own pace with calming visuals and music
Why Players Adore It:
Digital Self-Care – Your daily dose of mindfulness through creative arranging
Silent Storytelling – Every placed object reveals intimate life fragments
Instant Comfort – Soft color palettes and ambient sounds create a safe haven
Emotional Resonance – From college dorm posters to wedding china, every item sparks recognition
"Like sorting through a loved one's attic, but with the warmth of a freshly made bed"
Unlike typical games, Cozy Room invites you to:
• Reconstruct lives through domestic archaeology
• Design spaces that feel like hugged you back
• Find joy in the poetry of ordinary things
The Ultimate Comfort Game
For when you crave something gentler than reality, yet more meaningful than fantasy.

bluejetty:00035774:ios.description:
The easiest-to-use scanner that supports scanning QR codes and barcodes, and supports searching for items by image. You can use Scannit for more information.
What can you get?
1. Product Information: Quickly obtain product name, specification, category, product, manufacturer and other information.
2. Price comparison: Compare the prices of mainstream e-commerce platforms such as ebay, Amazon, and Walmart to help you save worry, effort and money.
3. Historical price: Easily obtain the price of the corresponding product in various time periods and obtain the lowest price.
4. Product Search: Quickly jump to different websites to get the latest real prices.
5. Food safety: Scan the QR code to obtain the ingredient list, nutritional grade and ingredient analysis of the food.
6. Book Information: Easily identify the book’s author, publisher, bio, language, release date
7. Generate QR code: Make mainstream social media accounts.
8. Email: Scan emails to send with one click, which is simple and convenient.
9. Telephone: You can quickly get the contact information, saving time and effort.
Why choose Scannit?
Get product price
- Scan products, get real prices, compare product prices, choose the best price, save money and worry.
 Easy and convenient
- Flexible and simple operation, easy to align the QR code and discover more interesting information.
Supports more than 36 QR code and barcode formats
- With our built-in reader, you can easily scan any QR code and barcode.
Quick access to Wi-Fi
- Scan QR code to set credentials and connect to Wi-Fi in seconds.
Lights and Galleries
- Automatically zoom and scan with light in dark environments.
- You can scan QR code/Barcode from gallery.
Easy export
- One-click export of scanned content to CSV/TXT format
QR Code and Barcode Manager
- All scan history will be saved for quick review anytime. You can save the QR code/Barcode in your phone.
- You can save contacts in your phone.
- You can create and manage different types of information.
Safe
- Scannit only needs camera permission to protect your personal privacy.
Download and try it out. Scannit won’t let you down! It will become your most worry-free QR code housekeeper, bringing you a convenient and comfortable life!

bluejetty:00136165:ios.description:
Welcome to Stars Messenger Kids - private, safe, and free messaging/video chat for kids and all ages. Stars Messenger Kids lets you safely message, call, and group video chat with your family and friends without any phone number, strangers, or ads.
On most messaging platforms, once your phone number or username is publicly discovered, you are no longer in control of who can contact you. Stars is safe by design - instead of searching for people to add, users need their friend’s username as well as their unique private Friend Code. With the ability to reset your Friend Code, you are always in control of who can connect with you. All group chats are also protected with a unique group code. 
Parents can also optionally enable Parent View for their child. Parent View allows you the ability to see who your child is friends with, the groups they're in, their time spent on Stars, and more. You'll receive notifications in real time upon your child's activity. 
Stars Messenger Kids isn’t just safe, it’s super fun too: 
Customizable message styles with a range of fonts, colors, and sizes
Cool emojis!
Group video call
Send custom quick messages with just 1 tap - “On my way!”, “What’s for dinner?”
Share Photos, Videos, and Audio messages with friends and family
Create private group chats with family and friends
Supports all devices
We guarantee:
Stars Messenger Kids App is free to use
Works on smartphones and tablets
A 100% safe, private, phishing and spam-free environment
No ads.
A friend code that you can reset at anytime
No phone number is required to use Stars Messenger Kids
Lots of fun and memories!
DOWNLOAD STARS MESSENGER KIDS TODAY!
What are you waiting for? Download Stars Messenger Kids App for FREE and enjoy 100% safe chatting, video calling, and group video chats with your family and friends using our kids messenger app. Have fun!
Try it, you will love it :) Thanks!
GIVE US FEEDBACK:
If you like the Stars Messenger Kids app, please give us feedback. We always appreciate your suggestions, improvement ideas, and recommendations. Send us your feedback at help@GetStarsApp.com or you can visit our site at www.GetStarsApp.com so that we can improve our kids messenger app and give you more and better features in the future.
FAQ:
Q: What is a Friend Code?
A: On Stars, your Friend Code is your unique randomly generated code that you should only give out to the people that you want to be added by on Stars. You can reset this for a new randomly generated code at any time. To add a friend on Stars, you will need to ask them for their username and friend code, and to be added on Stars, they will need your username and friend code.
Q: I don’t want to talk to someone anymore on Stars. What should I do?
A: Step one is to delete the person you no longer want to talk to. After you delete the person from your contacts, you will be prompted to reset your Friend Code - this way, the person you have blocked will have no way to add you again. All done! This is unlike a phone number, email, or public username, which you cannot just easily change to avoid someone. 
Q: Can I decline add requests?
A: Yes! On Stars, you must first accept add requests first for that person to be able to message you. If you don’t know the person, or don’t want to talk to them, you can decline the request.

bluejetty:00179415:ios.summary: Gain muscles, endurance, maximal strength or get toned with Gym Workout through expertly designed sets, reps and weight! Our routines will adapt to your goals and available gym equipment to maximize your results and help you push your limit
bluejetty:00179415:ios.description:
Gain muscles, endurance, maximal strength or get toned with Gym Workout through expertly designed sets, reps and weight! Our routines will adapt to your goals and available gym equipment to maximize your results and help you push your limits. 
• As a beginner, have no idea about how to get started and lack confidence in gym workout?
• As an experienced bodybuilder, want to pursue some advanced challenges?
• Desire to gain muscles, endurance, maximal strength or get toned?
• Not satisfied with existing workout log apps and looking for a more comprehensive one?
• Hesitate about paying for expensive instructors?
Gym Workout can solve all the problems above! 
For beginners & gym rats - Gym Workout will calculate your 1RM and regard it as a vital indicator to adjust the weight of your routines. We will guide you with customized classic routines designed by experts to fit your different needs. 
No more pen & paper - Log the weight and reps of each set in succession or log all sets in one click. We'll save and track your data to show you the results of your training with intuitive statistics and charts. 
Rich exercise database & instructions - You can search whether by muscle groups, equipment or keywords. Our HD photos & videos and detailed descriptions of 500+ exercises can help you fix your exercise form and avoid injuries. 
No number limits - There are no number limits on your edits, including editing existing workout routines, creating your own routines and adding new exercises to our database.
Marvelous features: 
• Log your workout quickly and simply without pen & paper
• Challenge yourself with expertly designed routines
• Edit and regenerate the routines anytime you like
• Fix your exercise form with explicit visual & literal instructions 
• Track your progress with clear statistics and charts 
• Flexible overall and specified rest timer
• 500+ exercises to keep your workout fresh and fun
• Create your own workout routines without number limits 
• Add any exercise you like to our database
• Need no network to start your fitness journey
• Use for no cost
• Sync data to Apple Health
- Enjoy our expertly designed routines
Waste a lot of time and effort but see little progress? Our classic courses designed by experts can help you hit specific body parts more effectively! You can update your available equipment and 1RM to edit or regenerate them if not satisfied. 
- Be the master of your workout intensity
Don’t want to be restricted by a conventional grading system? No worries. We’ll calculate your 1RM according to the benchmark you choose. And you can update it or change the sets and reps anytime to keep your own pace. 
- Build your custom workout routines
Want to form your own workout routines? You can generate any variation out of our database without number limits and set the rest timer, weight, reps and sets as you like. What’s more, add any exercise you like if it’s not included in our database. 
- Track your progress by records in different forms
◆ Note - log your feeling and tips of each exercise
◆ Bar chart - demonstrate your highest 1 RM, max weight, and max volume of each exercise 
◆ Line chart - track your body weight changes 
◆ Calendar & history - record your workout frequency, duration, and intensity
Intuitive records of your workout progression will not only motivate you but also save you the trouble of interpreting a mass of data yourself.
Subscription Terms & Details
- Get access to all features for USD $29.99/year. 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Privacy Policy: https://gym.leaphealth.fitness/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://gym.leaphealth.fitness/terms.html

bluejetty:00067607:ios.description:
A powerful task management app that helps you build to-do lists and never forget a thing.
Packed with rich features including a simple design, unlimited tabs, free reordering, priorities, recurring tasks, emojis, notes, copying tasks to today or tomorrow, dark mode, and more.
■ Today & Tomorrow Task Management
Create and check off your daily tasks so nothing slips through the cracks.
■ Swipe Through the Days
Just swipe left or right to switch the date view between yesterday, today, and tomorrow.
■ Unlimited Tabs
Sort your tasks by category, such as work, personal, and hobbies.
■ Task Notes
Need to jot down something longer? No problem. The notes feature lets you record plenty of details.
■ Tab Notes
Leave notes freely on each tab. Capture every idea and important detail without missing a thing.
■ Priorities
Assign priorities to your tasks so you can spot the important ones at a glance.
■ Recurring Tasks
Create tasks that repeat daily, weekly, or monthly to save the hassle of recreating them.
■ Notifications
Get notified at the time you choose with the message you want. Even when you are about to forget, a push notification keeps you on track.
■ Biometric Authentication
Only you can access the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
■ CSV Export
Export all your data as CSV. Keep a permanent record of your growth and achievements.
■ Print Function
Print your task lists anytime. Enjoy the best of both the digital and analog worlds.
■ Date-Independent Task Management
A static task list you can use anytime. Perfectly manage the habits you want to build and your recurring tasks.
■ Tab Navigation
Switch between tabs instantly with a single tap. Never waste a second of your precious time.
■ Emojis
Add your favorite emojis to brighten up your tasks. Make managing your daily tasks fun.
■ No Login Required
Start using it right away with no login. Kick off your day on a great note right now.
■ Dark Mode
A gentle-on-the-eyes dark mode is built in. Stay comfortable using it day or night.
■ Automatic Backup / Restore
Your important data is fully protected automatically. Restore everything even when you switch devices or in the unlikely event of a malfunction.
■ Robust Security
Your privacy is our top priority. Your data is never sent anywhere externally and is fully protected on your device.
■ How to Use
1. Open the app
2. Set today's goals
3. Check them off when you are done!
Simple yet powerful. Start becoming your ideal self right now!
■ Our Promise
We promise this app will be the partner that changes your life.
Let's make every day your best day.
Privacy Policy: https://naokiotsu.com/privacy-policy
