bluejetty:00119714:ios.summary:
Uber Driver is the app trusted by over 10 million drivers and couriers worldwide. Whether you want to drive passengers or deliver food; you choose when, where, and how you work to earn extra income on the side.
DRIVE
Take passengers where
bluejetty:00119714:ios.description:
Uber Driver is the app trusted by over 10 million drivers and couriers worldwide. Whether you want to drive passengers or deliver food; you choose when, where, and how you work to earn extra income on the side.
DRIVE
Take passengers where they need to go using your car. Accept trip requests in your area, see your fare upfront before you accept, and earn per ride. Driving is one of the most popular ways to turn your car into a side hustle.
DELIVER
Deliver food from restaurants, shop for and deliver groceries, deliver packages, or take on catering orders. Use a car, bike, scooter, or go on foot in eligible cities. No car required to start delivering. Get started as a delivery driver.
FLEXIBILITY
No set shifts. No set schedules. No boss. Go online when it works for you and stop when you're done. Whether you drive, deliver, or switch between both, you stay in control. In most markets, there are no zone restrictions once you're online.
GUIDANCE
Know where demand is before you head out. The in-app heatmap shows busy areas near you. Earning Trends and Opportunities help both drivers and couriers decide the best time and place to go online and earn more.
SAFETY
Safety tools are built directly into the app. Features include Record My Ride audio recording, Women Rider Preference settings, live in-app support available 24/7, and full integration with Apple CarPlay so you stay focused on the road.
REWARDS
Uber Pro rewards drivers. Uber Eats Pro rewards couriers. Reach Gold, Platinum, or Diamond status to unlock priority access to higher-paying trips and deliveries, gas savings, Costco membership, and everyday perks that improve your time on the road.
MORE WAYS TO EARN EXTRA INCOME
- Keep 100% of your tips on every ride or delivery
- Tip Guarantee protects your delivery tips after drop-off—always 100% yours
- See upfront fares and trip details before you accept
- Cash out anytime with Instant Pay
- Find Quests, Boost+, and all earning opportunities in the Discover tab
- Skip the waitlist—in most markets, start earning as soon as onboarding is complete
- New ways to earn as a delivery driver: Shop & Deliver, package delivery, alcohol delivery, and catering orders—all in one app
WHAT'S ACTIVE IN THE US
- Rideshare trips (car)
- Food delivery, Shop & Deliver, package delivery, alcohol delivery, and catering (availability varies by city)
- Bike, e-bike, scooter, and on-foot delivery in eligible markets
- Heatmap, Earning Trends, and Opportunities in-app guidance
- Record My Ride, Women Rider Preference, CarPlay
- Uber Pro (drivers) and Uber Eats Pro (couriers) rewards programs
- Discover tab with Quests and Boost+ promotions
- Instant Pay, upfront fares, and Tip Guarantee
*This app typically uses 2 GB of data per month. Using navigation can decrease your phone’s battery life.
Uber content/messages may be human or machine translated per device settings—accuracy not guaranteed.
COMMON QUESTIONS
Can I drive passengers and make deliveries using the same app?
Yes. The Uber Driver app supports both rideshare and delivery. Switch between the two at any time based on what's available near you—one app for every way you want to earn.
Is driving or delivering with Uber a good side hustle?
Yes. There are no minimum hours or schedules. Go online for a few hours around your job, school, or other commitments—then stop when you're done.
Do I need a car to get started?
No. In eligible cities, you can deliver by bike, e-bike, scooter, or on foot. If you want to drive passengers, a qualifying vehicle is required.
What rewards do drivers and couriers get?
Uber Pro (for drivers) and Uber Eats Pro (for couriers) offer tiered rewards at Gold, Platinum, and Diamond levels, including priority access to higher-paying trips and deliveries, gas cash back, Costco membership, and perks that help you get more out of every trip.

Step into the relaxing yet adventurous world of Tile Travel, the ultimate global tile-matching journey!
 Your mission is simple: find and match three identical tiles to clear the board and unlock breathtaking destinations.

 FIND YOUR FLOW

- Each puzzle is cleverly crafted to test your logic and focus.

- New puzzles, destinations, and challenges arrive every week — there’s always more to explore!

- Match three identical tiles to clear them from the board.

- Easy to start, impossible to put down.
- Beautifully designed to soothe your mind and spark your curiosity.
- Every match brings you closer to unlocking the next breathtaking scene.

bluejetty:00066123:ios.description:
If you are looking for an action-packed Bass Fishing game, then Master Bass Angler is for you!
Master Bass Angler is an arcade Bass fishing game that was created BY Bass Fishermen, FOR Bass Fishermen. Once you get the hang of it, you'll be catching bass faster than you can say, “Fish On!”. No other fishing game offers exclusive bass fishing at this pace, we guarantee it!
You won't catch bluegill or perch here... this game is for Bass Fisherman only! Catch Largemouth, Smallmouth, Spotted, Redeye, Peacock, Shoal, and the always-elusive Striped Bass on 10 of the hottest fishing lakes of 2025!
Master Bass Angler isn't your standard fishing simulation, it is an action-arcade game with tons of excitement. You won't slowly tap the lure on the screen waiting for a fish to bite here! This is called power fishing, you'll catch bass after bass after bass...
Genre-Leading Features:
• Free Daily Bass Tournaments
• Multiplayer Head-to-Head Play
• Exciting Bonus Rounds
• Level Up and Choose Your Fishing Talents
• Intuitive “Swipe-to-Cast” Controls
• Fishing Lure & Electronics Upgrades
• NO Registration! Just a Nickname
• Free to Play (In-App purchase for removing Ads)
*** Internet Connection Required
EASY TO LEARN
Master Bass Angler features simple “Swipe-to-Cast” controls that are not only easy to learn, they make you feel like you are actually fishing! You will catch bass right away, and a lot of them!
FREE DAILY BASS TOURNAMENTS
Each day you head out fishing, you are automatically entered into the free Daily Bass Tournament! There is no fee and no registration, so getting in to win prizes is as simple as a flick of the finger. Bracketed play for the ultimate challenge.
HEAD-TO-HEAD PLAY
Compete with fisherman around the world in Head-to-Head mode! Players are matched up by skill level to ensure fun and fair competition for all. Load the boat with 10 pounders and show your opponent who the REAL fisherman is!
CHOOSE YOUR TALENTS
Level up and gain valuable fishing talents that will help you catch more fish. Will you become a Reel Expert? Do you want Lightning Reflexes? Or will you upgrade to Master Angler, the choice is yours!
LURE UPGRADES
Upgrade your lures to increase the chances of catching that monster Bass. You'll fish with crankbaits, spinnerbaits, spoons, and plastics!
GEAR UPGRADES
• Electronics: Use the latest technology to locate the biggest fish in the Lake!
• Fish Attractant: Lure more fish into your area with fish attractant so potent that the fish won't be able to resist!
BONUS ROUNDS
Play exciting Bonus Rounds as you level up!
BEST FISHING LAKES OF 2025!
• Kentucky Lake, Kentucky
You'll start out on Kentucky Lake, where you'll catch Spotted and Largemouth Bass!
• Lake Erie, New York
After Kentucky Lake, you'll boat over to Lake Erie where you will catch the elusive Smallmouth Bass!
• Lake Okeechobee, Florida
Progressing to Lake Okeechobee is no small feat, where you will have the opportunity to catch fish over 10 pounds, including Peacock Bass! But don't tip the boat because there are gators down there!
• Lake Guntersville, Alabama
Only the best anglers boat on Lake Guntersville. When you get there you'll be pleasantly surprised at the 13-16 pound Bass you'll catch. Shoal and Redeye Bass are prized here.
• Clear Lake, California
With some of the best fishing in the USA, Clear Lake holds black bass up to 20 pounds! But you better have your talents and fishing lures upgraded or it will be quite a challenge!
• Lake Fork Reservoir, Texas
Welcome to Texas, where bass grow all year long! It's time to get your bass on!
• Lake Martin, Alabama
Lake Martin is known to hold huge bass in all areas of the lake! BASS ON!
Lake Hartwell, Lake Champlain And More!
Other free fishing games can't compete with our boatload of features, what are you waiting for? Download one of the best bass fishing games in the store and become the Master Bass Angler today!

bluejetty:00089388:ios.name: Very Necessary Emojis
bluejetty:00089388:ios.summary: In the heat of the moment, as we frantically ransack the default emoji keyboard for a little yellow face, desperate to convey an emotion that we know is probably too subtle or specific to have warranted Apple’s official attention, we die a
bluejetty:00089388:ios.description:
In the heat of the moment, as we frantically ransack the default emoji keyboard for a little yellow face, desperate to convey an emotion that we know is probably too subtle or specific to have warranted Apple’s official attention, we die a little inside when we realize the perfect emoji for this situation…doesn’t exist. 
We so often settle for default emojis that capture a mere fraction of our full intended meaning, and it’s understandable—no one has really set out to solve this super important first-world dilemma—until now. 
Very Necessary Emojis is a project about unlocking a layer of who we can be, even if it's "just over text," because those of us who text a lot get it. We have needs! We have feelings we're trying to express here! We don't want to just throw out a crying-laughing face — we want to show you that your joke was 6.5/10 funny, and also kind of dumb at the same time (umm, for example, I mean). This iMessage sticker pack is for those who not only want more, but need more. And on that note, it's been just about five years since I released this emoji pack, and over 250 weeks of updates! Initially released with just 72 emojis, VNE now has almost 400, with a new emoji added every Friday.
To all of you OG fans, thank you so much for enjoying this thing I made! And to all you newcomers, I'm so happy to say there's so much more to come!

bluejetty:00098553:ios.description:
Welcome to My Baby Care - your go-to educational app designed for soon-to-be parents and those stepping into the world of parenthood! Whether you’re expecting your first baby or just want to brush up on your skills, My Baby Care offers a fun and informative way to prepare for the exciting journey ahead.
This app isn’t just for parents - it’s for anyone looking to learn the essential skills needed to care for a baby. From feeding and dressing to playing and sleep training, My Baby Care gives you the tools and knowledge to feel confident and ready when your little one arrives. It’s more than just a game - it’s a guide to real-life parenting!
► What can you do in My Baby Care?
• Feed Your Baby: Learn the basics of bottle-feeding and breastfeeding, and understand how to create feeding schedules that work for both you and your baby. 
• Dress Your Baby: Explore the world of baby clothing, picking out the right outfits for various occasions and weather conditions.
• Play & Bond: Engage in fun, developmental games that strengthen the bond between you and your baby while helping with growth and learning.
• Care for Hygiene: Learn how to change diapers, bathe your baby, and establish healthy hygiene habits.
• Establish Sleep Routines: Discover tips for managing your baby’s sleep patterns, including creating calming bedtime routines.
• Practical Parenting Tips: Face real-life parenting scenarios and challenges that provide valuable lessons for everyday life.
My Baby Care is more than just an educational tool - it’s your companion in getting ready for parenthood. With expert advice, easy-to-understand tips, and step-by-step guides, you’ll feel prepared for any situation that comes your way.
► Why choose My Baby Care?
• Educational & Fun: Learn essential parenting skills in a relaxed, engaging way.
• Real-World Advice: Get expert-backed guidance on feeding, sleep routines, hygiene, and more.
• Personalized Experience: Adjust the content to fit your learning pace and specific needs.
• Track Your Progress: Celebrate milestones as you unlock new features and tips, all while gaining confidence in your ability to care for your baby.
Are you ready to start your parenting journey? Download My Baby Care today and begin learning how to be the best parent you can be, all while having fun and feeling prepared!

My Talking Angela 2 is the ultimate virtual pet game that brings fun, fashion, and creativity to your everyday life. Step into the big city with the stylish Angela and embark on a journey filled with exciting activities and endless entertainment in the Talking Tom & Friends universe!

Key Features:

- Stylish Hair, Makeup, and Fashion Choices: Transform Angela with various hairstyles, makeup options, and fashionable outfits. Dress her up for fashion shows and personalize her look to make her shine like a star.

- Exciting Activities: Engage in a variety of fun activities, including dancing, baking, martial arts, trampoline jumping, jewelry making, and planting flowers on the balcony.

- Delicious Food and Snacks: Bake and cook delicious treats for Angela. From cakes to cookies, satisfy her sweet tooth with your culinary skills.

- Travel Adventures: Take Angela on jet-setting travel adventures to explore new destinations and cultures. And to shop until she drops!

- Mini-Games and Puzzles: Challenge your skills with fun mini-games and puzzles that test your reflexes and strategic thinking.

- Sticker Collections: Collect and complete sticker albums to unlock special rewards and new content. 

Express Your Creativity: Angela inspires you to be creative, bold, and expressive. Design her outfits, experiment with makeup, and decorate her home to reflect your unique style.

From Outfit7, creators of the hit games My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom 2 and My Talking Tom Friends.

This app contains:
- Promotion of Outfit7's products and advertising;
- Links that direct customers to Outfit7’s websites and other apps;
- Personalization of content to encourage users to play the app again;
- The option to make in-app purchases;
- Subscriptions, which are auto-renewable, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage and cancel a subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
- Some features may be subject to different pricing and availability.
- Items to purchase (available in different prices) using virtual currency, depending on the player’s progress;
- Alternative options to access all functionalities of the app without making any in-app purchases using real money.

Please note, we do not process all the data disclosed on the label for users under the age of digital consent. For more information, please check our Privacy Policy.


Terms of use: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/eula/en/
Customer support: support@outfit7.com
Privacy policy: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/privacy-policy-games/en

bluejetty:00091891:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00091891:ios.description:
Managing time with your NGTeco time clock is easier using the NGTeco Time App!
Connect the NGTeco Time App to a local Wi-Fi that is shared with the timeclock (no software required).
Securely connect the app to the clock by scanning the QR code from the Admin Menu.
Using the app, admin users can:
1. Setup clock punch rules and configure clock options.
2. Add/update the employee data and push the data to the time clock.
3. View attendance records retrieved from the time clock.
4. Pull time card from the clock and email the report to admin user account.
5. Add employee missing punches and push to the clock for time card calculation.
To ensure data security on the App, the following protection measures are provided:
1. Admin user can set the passcode from time clock admin menu, and the passcode is required to connect the App to the device.
2. NGTeco Time App does not store any data locally in the mobile phone, the new added or updated data is pushed directly to the time clock. 
Support and service:
NGTeco Time App offers free unlimited phone, email and ticket support  to all of our customers. Have a question? We're always happy to help
Website: www.ngteco.com
Phone: 770.800.2321
Email: ngtime@ngteco.com
NGTeco

bluejetty:00100425:ios.description:
Stuck in negative self talk? Stressed, unfocused, or anxious? Innertune Music Therapy creates songs engineered to shift how you feel, in minutes, not months.
Rated 4.8 stars. Music therapy you can press play on.
WHEN YOUR MIND WON'T QUIET DOWN
You can't meditate your way out of a 3 AM spiral. You can't think positive your way through burnout. Innertune works where willpower fails, by using music itself as the intervention. Every song is built from affirmations, frequencies, and rhythms designed to shift your nervous system from stressed to steady.
TELL INNERTUNE HOW YOU FEEL, IT MAKES A SONG FOR IT
Spiraling in self doubt? Generate a confidence anthem in your favorite genre.
Stuck on money mindset? Wealth affirmations set to music you'd actually listen to.
Running low on self love? A self love track built from your own words.
Can't focus? Put on a focus song with binaural beats running in the background.
Need to wind down? Calm music tuned to 432 Hz and healing frequencies.
GENERATE A WHOLE PLAYLIST WITH ONE PROMPT
Type what you want to feel. Get 20 personalized songs in your favorite genre, made for your mind. It's like Spotify, but every track is made for your own wellbeing.
WHAT MAKES INNERTUNE DIFFERENT
• Affirmation Music. Every track can carry positive affirmations that quietly rewire anxious thought loops, even when you're barely listening.
• 432 Hz Natural Tuning. Music tuned to align with nature's harmony, believed to promote deep relaxation and grounding.
• Solfeggio Frequencies. Healing tones from 174 Hz to 852 Hz, used for centuries to support emotional and mental balance.
• Binaural Beats. Add binaural beats to any song to guide your brain toward focus, calm, or clarity.
• Song Remix. Love the lyrics of a track but want a different vibe? Remix it in the genre and mood that fits you.
• AI Song Generation. Describe how you feel, what you want to believe, or a goal you're working toward. Innertune writes a song for it.
YOUR FULL MUSIC EXPERIENCE
Innertune Radio. Pick a song, get a station built around it.
Daily Mix. A fresh personalized mix every single day.
Your Library. Save, like, and return to every song you love.
Your Playlists. Create, share, and follow friends.
Community. A growing world of people using sound to change how they feel.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Tell Innertune what you're feeling or what you want more of.
2. Press play on a song, playlist, or station built for that.
3. Feel the shift, usually within minutes.
No meditation experience required. No 8 week program. Just music therapy, on demand.
START FREE
Listen free every day. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited AI song generation, full playlist creation, remove ads and complete access to the frequency library.
Start with one song. Change how you feel tonight.
Privacy Policy: https://innertune.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://innertune.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00064113:ios.summary:

Welcome to Solitaire Grand Harv
bluejetty:00064113:ios.description:
Kevin Bacon Comes to the Farm!
Kevin Bacon has arrived at the Grand Farm! Play Solitaire, complete challenges, and help Kevin Bacon build his farm. Grow crops, earn rewards, and bring his dream farm to life.
Welcome to Solitaire Grand Harvest, Farmer!
Relax and unwind with the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in Solitaire Grand Harvest, available on mobile and web. Escape to a peaceful farm where every relaxing card game helps your crops flourish, earns valuable rewards, and brings your dream farm to life.
Daily Surprises & Cozy Fun
Take a relaxing break every day with free gifts, collectible treasures, and special offers that make your Solitaire journey even more rewarding.
Why You'll Love Solitaire Grand Harvest
• Relaxing TriPeaks Solitaire – Clear satisfying card puzzles and enjoy thousands of calming levels while earning stars and rewards.
• Credits, Gems & Boosters – Collect helpful resources to power up your gameplay and progress with ease.
• Build Your Dream Farm – Customize and decorate a charming countryside filled with crops, cozy corners, and personal touches.
• Play Anytime, Anywhere – Enjoy your favorite Solitaire game online or offline, whenever you want to relax.
Escape to the Farm
Clear cards, solve rewarding puzzles, and discover new farming fields as you unwind through a peaceful adventure. Unlock bonus cards, credits, gems, and delightful surprises at every level to keep your journey fresh and rewarding.
Harvest crops, gather gems, and personalize your growing farm. Create a cozy countryside retreat and build the perfect home for Sam, your lovable farm pup.
Relaxing Features You'll Enjoy
• Daily Bonuses – Return every day for free gifts and relaxing rewards.
• Harvest Rewards – Collect crops throughout the day to earn extra credits.
• Spin the Wheel – Win boosters, gems, and other exciting surprises.
• Meet Sam – Your faithful farm companion is always ready with bonus credits and delightful discoveries.
Upgrade your reward crates to unlock even greater rewards. The more you play, the more relaxing content, surprises, and farm upgrades you'll discover.
MyFarm
Turn every Solitaire victory into something beautiful. Spend gems earned from completing levels to decorate your farm, unlock charming decorations, and create a cozy space that's uniquely yours—including a special place for Sam.
Join millions of players around the world in this relaxing TriPeaks Solitaire adventure. Whether you're a longtime Solitaire fan or discovering the game for the first time, Solitaire Grand Harvest combines calming gameplay, rewarding progression, charming farm customization, and endless moments of relaxation.
Download Solitaire Grand Harvest today and enjoy the perfect blend of relaxing Solitaire, farming, and creativity.
About the Game
Solitaire Grand Harvest is one of the great online games developed by Supertreat, a Playtika studio. It combines relaxing card gameplay with farm-building.
How do I play Solitaire Grand Harvest?
Clear cards from the TriPeaks by selecting a card that is one rank higher or lower than the card shown in the match pile. The suit doesn’t matter! Keep clearing cards to complete levels, earn rewards, and grow your farm.
Solitaire Grand Harvest is intended for players 18 and older. The game is free to download and play, with optional in-app purchases, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device settings. The game may also contain advertising. An internet connection may be required to access certain features and social functionality.
By downloading this game, you agree to receive future updates through your app store or social network. Choosing not to update may affect gameplay and available features.
The web version is also available at: https://solitairegrandharvest.com/
Terms of Service: https://www.playtika.com/terms-service/
Privacy Notice: https://www.playtika.com/privacy-notice/

bluejetty:00184187:ios.summary: Using the Colony Bank Mobile App, you can manage your money anytime, anywhere—right from your mobile device! Colony Bank Mobile App is a fast and secure way for Colony Bank customers to check balances, view account activity, pay bills, and
bluejetty:00184187:ios.description:
Using the Colony Bank Mobile App, you can manage your money anytime, anywhere—right from your mobile device! Colony Bank Mobile App is a fast and secure way for Colony Bank customers to check balances, view account activity, pay bills, and make transfers between accounts. Colony Bank Mobile App is available 24/7.
Mobile banking transmissions are protected by robust 128-bit SSL (Secure Socket Layer) to prevent unauthorized access.
Login to the Colony Bank Mobile App and you can undertake a full range of banking activities conveniently and securely, including the following:
VIEW ACCOUNT ACTIVITY
-View account available balances, recent transactions and pending deposits.
-Detailed transaction history, including date, location, amount, and more—just like using online banking.
MAKE TRANSFERS
-Transfer money between Colony Bank accounts.
PAY BILLS
-Schedule payments and pay bills—right from your mobile device.
-If you’re already a Bill Pay customer, the payees you have already set up using the online version of Bill Pay are automatically available for use in the Colony Bank Mobile App Bill Pay.
MAKE A DEPOSIT
-Deposit checks directly from your smartphone.
-View deposit history in the app.
LOCATE BANKING CENTERS
-Find Colony Bank banking centers using your current location or enter the zip code or address of the area you wish to search. You’ll be provided a list of branches with the address and distance from your current location.
Business customers can enjoy all of these features plus more. See below: 
REVIEW AND APPROVE:
• Approve transactions scheduled through [Business Online], including fund transfers, ACH transfers and wire transfers.
• Review and approve Positive Pay exceptions.
• Receive alerts when approvals are pending.
For more information about Colony Bank and access to efficient and secure online banking services visit www.colony.bank, email customersupport@colonybank.com, or call 800-873-6404. Colony Bank is an equal housing lender and member of FDIC.
Internet access permissions are necessary for the Colony Bank Mobile Banking app to connect with Colony Bank mobile banking. At this time, Colony Bank Mobile Banking app is designed for customer use only.
*Your mobile carrier’s message and data rates may apply.

Descarga Guia de estudo da Bíblia , la aplicação mais completa
Maravilhosos e educativos guías de estudo bíblico para seguir a Palavra de Deus.
Saiba todos os dias um pouco mais sobre a Bíblia e seguir o seu caminho e nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo

Certamente, esses guias de estudo lhe dão o interesse necessário para aumentar seu conhecimento
Guia de estudo da Biblia nos fornece uma ferramenta para conhecer mais e se aproximar de nosso Senhor.
Um estudo bíblico consiste em perguntas formuladas sobre determinado assunto e respostas da Bíblia. Noutras palavras, estudo bíblico quer dizer um estudo de tópicos da Bíblia por meio de perguntas e respostas.
A aplicação consiste em:
- Guia de estudo da Bíblia
- Estudos Bíblicos
- Dicionário Teológico
- Perguntas importantes
- Bíblia NVI em português offline 
Guia de estudo da Bíblia contem:
- Haverá algo em que Confiar?
- Deus Criou o Diabo?
- Resgate Celestial
- Uma Colossal Cidade no Espaço
- 17 Dicas para um Casamento Feliz
- Escrito em Pedra
- O Dia Perdido da História
- O Livramento Final
- Pureza e Poder !
- Estão os Mortos Realmente Mortos?
- Estão os Mortos Realmente Mortos?
- Está o Diabo Encarregado do Inferno?
- Mil Anos de Paz
- O segredo da oração respondida
- Quem é o Anticristo?
- Mensagens Angelicais do Espaço Sideral
- Deus Elaborou os Planos
- No Tempo Certo: Eventos Proféticos Revelados
- A Marca da Besta
- Os Estados Unidos na Profecia Bíblica
- A “Outra” Mulher
- A Noiva de Cristo
- Será que Deus Inspira Astrólogos e Videntes?
- O Amor que Transforma
- Pecado Imperdoável: O Ponto de Não Retorno !
Estudo bíblico composto, entre outros, os seguintes tópicos:
- Reflexões da parábola do bom samaritano
- Algumas verdades bíblicas
- A Preparação da Esposa do Cordeiro
- Diferença com Sabedoria
- Para Revelar a Sua Misericórdia
- Remindo o Tempo
- A alegria e o renovo quem vem pela manhã (Salmos 30:5)
- Aqueles que Julgam os Outros São Julgados
- Canção da Alma
- Fala, porque o Teu servo ouve
- Conhecendo e Amando o Cristo Invisível
- Igreja empresarial: seu começo ou seu fim?
- Como viver a vida de Cristo
- “Eles não Sabem o que Fazem”
- FORÇA PARA VENCER OS GIGANTES
- A justiça de Deus
- SABEDORIA
- Kairós e Khronos
- Amai-vos uns aos Outros como eu Vos Amei
- e mais ...
Dicionário teológico:
- Uma ferramenta para você aprender e compreender qualquer
definição da doutrina da teologia. É muito conveniente e fácil de usar. Você vai encontrar muita informação sobre teologia que vai fazer você ver o mundo cristão a partir de uma perspectiva global.
- “Deuses” no meio Cristão” Certamente, esses guias de estudo lhe dão o interesse necessário para aumentar seu conhecimento
Estudar a Bíblia e aprender os princípios da Palavra de Deus.

Se você tiver alguma dúvida ou preocupação ou quer contribuir com algo, por favor nos avise. Obrigado

Build your team of monsters, break new grounds and fight your way to become the greatest monster tamer of all times in Pico Pets Puzzle. Swipe and match gems with strategy to battle enemies and lead your team to victory!
Pico Pets Puzzle combines the genres of match-3 and RPG in a fun action-packed game that’s both innovative and inventive, but also easy to play.

bluejetty:00169143:android.name: Thief Simulator: Sneak & Steal
bluejetty:00169143:android.summary:
Sssh! Haven't you heard? A spin-off of Thief Simulator, a world-known PC hit is coming to mobile! Be quick, get sneaky and steal priceless treasures.
Deep-dive into out of the ordinary stealthy simulation experience from publisher of House
bluejetty:00169143:android.description:
Sssh! Haven't you heard? A spin-off of Thief Simulator, a world-known PC hit is coming to mobile! Be quick, get sneaky and steal priceless treasures.
Deep-dive into out of the ordinary stealthy simulation experience from publisher of House Flipper. 
Become a thief who is back in the game. Perfect your craft, acquire new equipment and skills. Use your cunning to outwit others and move around undetected. Overcome more and more sophisticated security, rob bigger and richer houses, trade the loot...and under no circumstances get caught!
ROB EVER RICHER HOUSES
A good thief knows his value. He also knows the value of what his neighbors are hiding in their drawers.
Make the journey from pickpocket to super villain! Spread fear, climb the career ladder and don't worry if you’re starting off by collecting only broken toasters. You can already see opulent villas on the horizon, for whenever you’re ready. And there, hidden away from prying eyes are the safes where your future lies, your pension or, if you do slip up, your next jail term. Remember: every lock, even the most sophisticated, is just an incentive to become a more skilled thief!
TAKE ORDERS
Mr Smith hates Mr Johnson very much and wishes him to fall over and smash up that stupid, 60-inch, full 4k, cost-as-much-as–a-middle-class-car TV of his. However, wishes don't have as much power as one would like ...and that’s where you come in.
Take on various assignments (no judging, but let’s admit it: your profession does not entitle you to judge). Be an angel of revenge (or just common jealousy): steal items on assignment and destroy designated objects. Take advantage of what drives people: love, hate, greed and lust. Don’t you forget about yourself in all this - after all, one or two extra golden watches won’t hurt. Just get out before the cops arrive.
TRADE LOOT
Mum told you to share. Nothing for free, of course.
Explore the depths of Thief-Net,- sell the loot you've acquired and buy ever more effective equipment with the cash you've earned. Look for the best bargains, take risks (after all, that's where the fun begins!), trade information and get new equipment for your hideout.
DEVELOP YOUR THIEVING CRAFT
Do you still remember what you wanted to be when you were a kid? Did you dream of becoming a programmer? A jeweller? Or maybe a car mechanic? Have you always wanted to work from home? Now you can make those dreams come true!
Gain experience and unlock skills that will give you access to brand new locations and jobs. Perfect yourself in the areas of hacking, dismantling jewelry, opening locks, safes, car theft and much more.
GET INFORMATION
Knowledge is power. No, we don't mean that game. We do not advertise our competitors with this slogan (wait, did we just do that…?!).
Observe householders to learn their habits. Find out when they stay in the flat, when they go out and for how long. When they sleep and when they watch TV. And whether they are in the habit of co-operating with you, for example, leaving the window open because it is so hot after all. Or...just buy information about the house in question online.
DEVELOP A PLAN
Yes, tricks, laptops and other toys are cool, but remember that the essentials are already within you. Use your wits: a good thief can even break in using a hair from your head (so what if you're bald, it doesn't have to be your hair) - make use of the clues you've picked up, learn the routine of the locals, prepare your equipment, plan your action from A to Z, and pray the police don't turn up. Can anything go wrong?
DON'T GET CAUGHT
It is said that opportunity makes the thief. No, it's intelligence. And the ability to steal. And... ok, opportunity too.
Move undetected (and when you need to, quickly too). Use elements in the environment to hide. Take out the locals, the police, burglar alarms and tracking dogs and enjoy your loot and well-deserved fame. After all, a thief like you isn't born every day, right?S

bluejetty:00077283:ios.name: train games - Chicago Train
bluejetty:00077283:ios.summary: Dive into the bustling world of trains in the heart of Illinois with Chicago Train Tycoon, the ultimate train simulator experience for mobile devices! Perfect for fans of train games, this engaging train simulator puts you in control of pow
bluejetty:00077283:ios.description:
Dive into the bustling world of trains in the heart of Illinois with Chicago Train Tycoon, the ultimate train simulator experience for mobile devices! Perfect for fans of train games, this engaging train simulator puts you in control of powerful steam locomotives and cutting-edge freight trains as you manage a thriving rail empire. Build your own rail network, expand cargo routes, and take on the role of a true tycoon in the world of rail transportation.
In Chicago Train Tycoon, the railways come to life as you operate historic steam engines and modern trains alike. Whether you’re guiding a classic steam train across the rail yards or optimizing routes for efficient cargo transport, every decision shapes your journey towards becoming a train tycoon. This game combines the strategic challenges of a tycoon simulation with the immersive feel of a true train game, making it an essential experience for train enthusiasts everywhere.
Features:
- Master the Art of Freight Transport: Manage and optimize your train routes, ensuring timely delivery of various cargo types across the city’s iconic train stations and beyond. With each successful delivery, you earn rewards to expand and upgrade your fleet.
- Iconic Trains and Steam Engines: Operate a collection of classic steam trains alongside modern diesel and electric locomotives. From historical steam mobile engines to powerful freight trains, experience the evolution of rail transport as you build your empire.
- Authentic Train Station Management: Experience life as a train station manager in 20th-century Chicago. With detailed train station environments and bustling rail yards, you’ll feel the pulse of the city’s thriving freight industry as you manage arrivals, departures, and scheduling.
- Dynamic Rail Network Expansion: Lay down rails, construct new train stations, and expand your network across the Chicago area. Every decision affects your growth as a tycoon and your ability to meet the increasing demands of cargo transportation.
- Strategic Gameplay Meets Realistic Simulation: Combining the best of train games and tycoon simulators, Chicago Train Tycoon challenges you to balance operational efficiency with growth strategies. Optimize train schedules, manage resources, and invest in the future of your rail empire.
- Stunning Steam Era Graphics: Immerse yourself in detailed, steam-powered environments that recreate the golden age of trains. Each locomotive is designed with precision, and every rail, track, and train station captures the spirit of historical Chicago.
- Achievements & Challenges: Complete tasks and overcome challenges as you progress. From transporting fragile cargo to mastering tricky rail routes, each challenge tests your skills as a train game enthusiast.
Chicago Train Tycoon combines the nostalgic charm of steam locomotives with the excitement of a modern train simulator, offering fans of train games and tycoon simulators the perfect mobile experience. Take control of powerful freight trains, develop your rail empire, and become the ultimate train tycoon in one of America’s most iconic cities. Whether you're a seasoned train enthusiast or new to the world of trains, this game provides hours of captivating gameplay as you explore the legacy and future of rail in the bustling heart of Chicago. Download Chicago Train Tycoon today and start your journey as a rail tycoon!
PLEASE NOTE! Chicago Train Railroad Tycoon is an online free strategy tycoon simulator game to download and play that requires a network connection to play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. if you don't want to use this feature please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Do you have any suggestions or problems in your TrainStation? Our caring community train managers would love to hear from you, visit https://discord.gg/MPHxcMsP

- Iconic Trains and Steam Engines: Operate a collection of classic steam trains alongside modern diesel and electric locomotives. From historical steam mobile engines to powerful freight trains, experience the evolution of rail transport as you build your empire.

- Authentic Train Station Management: Experience life as a train station manager in 20th-century Chicago. With detailed train station environments and bustling rail yards, you’ll feel the pulse of the city’s thriving freight industry as you manage arrivals, departures, and scheduling.

- Dynamic Rail Network Expansion: Lay down rails, construct new train stations, and expand your network across the Chicago area. Every decision affects your growth as a tycoon and your ability to meet the increasing demands of cargo transportation.

- Strategic Gameplay Meets Realistic Simulation: Combining the best of train games and tycoon simulators, Chicago Train Tycoon challenges you to balance operational efficiency with growth strategies. Optimize train schedules, manage resources, and invest in the future of your rail empire.

- Stunning Steam Era Graphics: Immerse yourself in detailed, steam-powered environments that recreate the golden age of trains. Each locomotive is designed with precision, and every rail, track, and train station captures the spirit of historical Chicago.

- Achievements & Challenges: Complete tasks and overcome challenges as you progress. From transporting fragile cargo to mastering tricky rail routes, each challenge tests your skills as a train game enthusiast.

Take control of powerful freight trains, develop your rail empire, and become the ultimate train tycoon in one of America’s most iconic cities. Whether you're a seasoned train enthusiast or new to the world of trains, this game provides hours of captivating gameplay as you explore the legacy and future of rail in the bustling heart of Chicago. Download Chicago Train Tycoon today and start your journey as a rail tycoon!

bluejetty:00173180:ios.summary:
Level up powerful heroes, build an army of mighty monsters and lead them to epic tactical turn-based battles set in a beautiful magic world inspired by PC strategy classics.
◆ NEW MOBILE STRATEGY GAME
Play a new mobile strategy game with p
bluejetty:00173180:ios.description:
Level up powerful heroes, build an army of mighty monsters and lead them to epic tactical turn-based battles set in a beautiful magic world inspired by PC strategy classics.
◆ NEW MOBILE STRATEGY GAME
Play a new mobile strategy game with powerful heroes and mighty monsters. Build your army of various units and monsters, level them up, gear them out with weapons, armor and magical artifacts, upgrade their abilities and rarity, learn to cast powerful spells and fight in tactical turn-based battles.
◆ USE YOUR BRAIN, NOT YOUR FINGERS
This is not another game where you do not need to use your brain and only tap your phone mindlessly forever. This is a mobile strategy game for those with strong analytical thinking and the mind of a true commander. In the Magic War Age if you want to overcome enemy forces in the battlefield, you better come up with a plan. You will need to make some tough decisions in these tactical turn-based battles:
• Which of my units have the best abilities to destroy this enemy monster?
• Which spell will have the most devastating impact on enemy forces and when is the best time to use it?
• What gear is best for this unit, or is there any other who would benefit from it more?
• Which units am I going to sacrifice to level up the others or win in an important battle?
• How will I invest my precious resources?
Make the right decisions and become the strongest leader in the world of Magic War Age, make the wrong ones and enemy monsters will feast on the dead bodies of your heroes as you run back to your castle.
◆ BEAUTIFUL MAGICAL WORLD
Discover the vast lands of the Magic War Age. Feast your eyes on the beautiful romantic sceneries of a magic world filled with sacred groves, sunny meadows, calm mountain streams, charming villages, but also dark woods, deep dungeons, scary monster lairs and unconquerable strongholds and castles. World where powers of light and darkness clash in eternal conflict. Meet legendary heroes, fight epic raid battles with terrifying enemies, and win the war for the magic kingdom.
◆ MYTHICAL HEROES & UNITS
 Recruit various heroes from might and magic. Collect, train and upgrade over 50 mighty creatures: Knights, Dragons, Beholder, Griffin, Medusa, Wizard and many more. 
◆ PVP HEROES ARENA
Duel rivals in epic PvP arena turn-based strategy battles, and play epic heroes and magic. Test your army’s strength and show off your strategic skills against other players. If you are experienced mobile strategy games player, this is the place where you skills will truly shine.
◆ THE DARK TOWER AND DUNGEON RAIDS
Fight your way through all floors of Dark Tower or sweep all might and magic dreadful creatures in the deep, dark dungeons. This is not for faint-hearted players, this is one of the toughest places in the game and only those who really know how to play mobile strategy games will overcome the horrors that wait for you in the darkest corners of dungeons and towers of Magic War Age. If you accept the challenge and if you are succesful, your reward will be worth it. Some of the best gear and artifacts in the game can be found in the darkest dungeons of Magic War Age.
◆ 90s STRATEGY CLASSIC MEETS 20s MOBILE STRATEGY HITS
Magic War Age combines the finest from RPG games and turn-based strategy games in a unique mix of both these genres. If you have played turn-based strategy classics in the 90s and 00s you will feel a very familiar vibe of these games when playing Magic War Age, but our game is a lot more than just a copy of these legendary classic games.
We have used the best mechanics and beautiful art style from the classic PC strategy games and combined it with the modern ideas from the best mobile strategy and RPG games. We have tested every aspect of the game thoroughly together with mobile strategy games players, fine-tuned everything to bring you the best experience in the field of mobile strategy games.

bluejetty:00087564:ios.description:
- Easy taxi booking 
- Fixed price on all trips
- Pay by card or PayPal directly in the app
- Get status updates for your trip
We are Sweden's largest taxi company with cars from Kiruna in the north to Ystad in the south, with strong local presence in order to provide you with the best possible service wherever you are in the country. Our focus is to make your taxi experience as easy as possible, whether it's for private trips or business traveling. 
Download the app today to find out how easy it is!
- Start the app and book directly from your current location with Travel Now
- You can schedule future trips by tapping Pre-book 
- Next up is adding your destination to get a fixed price
- Finally tap Book trip to confirm your booking and get a taxi
- You can easily select different payment options (in car, CreditCard or Paypal)
We notify you both when the taxi is on its way and when it has arrived. You can also follow your car directly on the map. The app provides you with the taxi's car number so you can smoothly and easily find your car! You find the taxi's car number on the back of the taxi sign.
As a registered business customer you also have the option to pay by invoice, travel account or credit card. Your receipts can be sent directly to your company and you save both money and unnecessary time on administration! Contact us today and become a business customer.
Have a burning question? Email us at marknad@sverigetaxi.se
Want more information? Check our website sverigetaxi.se
Sverigetaxi is a part of Cabonline group, founded in 1989 and is today a leading European technology and service supplier in the taxi world. Originated in one of the most complex and deregulated markets in the world we have grown organically and through acquisitions. Today, our presence extends beyond Sweden and spans across Norway, Denmark, Finland, Holland and Great Britain.
Sverigetaxi is available in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Blekinge, Helsingborg, Kalmar, Landskrona, Lund, Ale/Kungälv, Borås, Enköping, Halmstad, Karlstad, Kristinehamn, Lilla Edet, Lysekil, Piteå, Sotenäs, Strängnäs, Sundsvall, Tanum, Tranås, Uddevalla, Vänersborg, Västerås, Ystad, Åre, Älsvby, Örebro, Örnsköldsvik, Östersund, Alvesta, Dalarna and Kiruna.

Commence chaque journée dans la présence de Dieu avec Jérémy Sourdril !

bluejetty:00035239:ios.description:
Commence chaque journée dans la présence de Dieu avec Jérémy Sourdril !
« Prières inspirées », l'émission quotidienne de prière animée par le pasteur Jérémy Sourdril sur EMCI TV, est maintenant dans ta poche. Chaque jour, un nouveau podcast pour te fortifier dans la foi, prier avec puissance et louer Dieu de tout ton cœur.
CHAQUE JOUR, 4 TEMPS FORTS
- La Pensée : une parole qui inspire ta journée et ta vie.
- L'Encouragement : un temps d'enseignement pour être fortifié dans la foi.
- La Prière inspirée : entre dans une expérience profonde avec le Seigneur.
- Le Chant : termine en louant Dieu de tout ton cœur.
Va directement au moment que tu veux grâce aux chapitres.
TOUT NOUVEAU DANS CETTE VERSION
- Un design entièrement repensé, lumineux et apaisant, qui prend les couleurs de la prière du jour.
- La prière du jour et les derniers épisodes en grand dès l'ouverture.
- Les séries présentées en affiches, avec ta progression : vois ce que tu as déjà écouté et reprends là où tu t'étais arrêté.
TOUT CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE
- Écouter tous les podcasts, du plus récent au plus ancien.
- Suivre les séries d'enseignement, épisode après épisode.
- Écouter la playlist des chants de louange.
- Garder tes podcasts et chants préférés dans tes favoris, et écouter ta playlist de chants favoris.
- Télécharger les épisodes pour les écouter hors connexion, ou les écouter en streaming.
- Rechercher un podcast par mot-clé.
- Continuer l'écoute écran verrouillé, en arrière-plan ou depuis tes écouteurs.
- Ajuster la vitesse de lecture et avancer ou reculer de 30 secondes.
- Partager un podcast avec tes proches.
- Recevoir une notification à chaque nouveau contenu.
- Profiter de l'app sur téléphone comme sur tablette, en portrait et en paysage.
DES TÉMOIGNAGES QUI FORTIFIENT LA FOI
Guérison, délivrance, salut : écoute, regarde ou lis des témoignages de vies transformées par Dieu, et partage le tien en quelques secondes.
TOUTE L'ACTUALITÉ
Nouvelles séries, semaines de prière en direct, invités, conférences de Jérémy Sourdril : ne manque aucun rendez-vous.
À PROPOS DE JÉRÉMY SOURDRIL
Pasteur et animateur sur EMCI TV, Jérémy Sourdril est une voix reconnue de la prière dans le monde francophone. Passionné par la prière et l'enseignement de la Bible, il sert depuis 2004 au sein de l'œuvre « EnseigneMoi », devenue EMCI. Chaque jour, « Prières inspirées » rassemble des croyants de toute la francophonie autour de la prière.
Télécharge « Prières inspirées » et fais de la prière le meilleur moment de ta journée !

bluejetty:00184773:ios.description:
This brand new fully featured Solitaire is the best Solitaire game you'll ever play! From the amazing Live Backgrounds and Daily Challenges to the classic intuitive gameplay, we promise the most robust and satisfying Solitaire experience you will find in the App Store.
Relax with a game at home, during your busy commute to work, or on the plane. Unlimited winning deals ensures you’ll never run out of interesting games to exercise your brain. 
Track your progress and game stats to beat your best times and scores or see how you rank against other players in the Leaderboards.

• Beautifully crafted and curated themes
• Fun and dynamic win animations!

• Complete unique and puzzling challenges
• Unlock and master achievements to earn trophies for every month!

Tarot readings are a tool for reflection and personal growth. They help explore possible outcomes, revisit past decisions, and gain a new perspective. Tarot Divination includes everything needed to start your journey today.
AI Tarot Readings
Interpret your readings with AI Tarot. Explore connections between cards in simple spreads and read full card-by-card interpretations. Generate unique AI meanings in more than 20 categories and create spreads shaped by your question.
Learn Tarot Cards
Master the deck with our tarot for beginners guide. Explore all 78 tarot cards with detailed tarot card meanings, grouped by popular reading themes. Read each card’s unique symbolism and find the hidden meaning behind every card.
Freestyle layout
Read tarot your way: filter the deck by Arcana or Suit, customize reversed card settings, and place cards wherever they feel right, just like working with a physical deck.

Build unique tarot spreads
Design spreads that reflect your own questions. Don’t limit yourself to existing layouts - create and share your personal designs.
Yes or No tarot readings
Get quick answers with a single-card yes/no spread. Use it as a digital tarot deck or oracle to address everyday questions instantly.
Daily tarot
Draw a card of the day for guidance and reflection. Use it to prepare for challenges and focus your energy.
Tarot journal & Readings History
Save every tarot reading in your journal or review them all in your history. Revisit past readings to uncover new insights and track your progress.
Tarot notes
Extend standard card meanings with your personal experience. Connect with your intuition and write about how the card resonates with you or the unique meanings that you found.
Reading flow
Follow a clear reading process: fill out a spread and let Tarot Divination guide you through the answers.
Rider Waite deck
Explore the Rider Waite deck in detail. Learn what each symbol represents and the meanings hidden within the artwork.
Style your readings
Choose from 7 backgrounds and custom card covers to personalize your tarot sessions.
Tarot Quiz
Test your knowledge with a tarot quiz across different reading themes. Learn tarot card meanings in an interactive way.

bluejetty:00071029:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00071029:ios.description:
*** Featured by Apple in "New Apps We Love", Apple Watch App Store, and Apple Health&Fitness category. ***
Gymatic (a.k.a VimoFit) is the first and only app to automatically identify your exercises, count your repetitions, and log your workouts. What is more, it auto tracks many stats no human can track. Bring science to your workout! 
Our mind-blowing technology has been featured on AOL, Mashable, TechCrunch, Huffington Post, and more… 
- Gymatic not only auto log exercises and count reps, it also collect many advanced stats for each set, such as 
 * Heart rate (average and max) (only when using Apple Watch)
 * Rest and work time (work time only starts when you move, rest time starts as soon as movement ends. No need to mess with timer when you need to rest after a set, it is all automatic.)
 * Velocity 
 * Power
 * Tempo 
 * Rep speed
 * Form consistency 
 * Range consistency
 * Speed consistency
- Connect with Apple Health app to read heart rate and contribute to activity rings. 
- Get more accurate calories burned feedback then with typical fitness trackers because Gymatic knows EXACTLY which exercises you’re performing!
- It takes just 3 seconds to train any new exercise so there’s no limit to how many exercises Gymatic can track.
- Gymatic tracks your Crossfit, bodybuilding, weightlifting, strength training, HIIT workouts, TRX training, kettlebell training, calisthenics, machine exercises, and much much more!
- Stay motivated with remarkable progress tracking including 1 rep max estimates, calories burned and all advanced stats. 
- Support both FreeForm mode, where you can perform any exercises, and Guided mode, where Watch/Phone guides you through a pre-programmed workout. 
- Many workouts are included + unlimited workouts shared by the community. 
- Track your indoor cardio and accurately count calories for running, cycling, rowing, elliptical, and stair stepper. 
- Track your swim and count your strokes. 
Tips:
- Wear your watch just a little higher on your wrist than usual. (above the bone)
- Tighten the watch on your wrist. (just snug, not a death grip)
- Want to track Leg Press? Strap phone to your leg. Or keep hands on your leg to move along. 
Developer Note:
This is a new technology and you’re one of the first to try it out! We know it’s not perfect yet. Please help us improve the app for everyone by reporting bugs to support@vimo.co
Tutorial and FAQ are at https://support.vimo.co/portal/helpcenter/mobile-apps/gymatic-1. Visit this support site for questions and answers. 
In-App Subscription Details:
Gymatic Premium subscription is $4.99 per month / $29.99 per year and operates on a 30 / 365 day cycle. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of $4.99 / $29.99. You may manage your Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your user Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. listings.description:
*** Featured by Apple in "New Apps We Love", Apple Watch App Store, and Apple Health&Fitness category. ***

Gymatic (a.k.a VimoFit) is the first and only app to automatically identify your exercises, count your repetitions, and log your workouts. What is more, it auto tracks many stats no human can track. Bring science to your workout! 

Our mind-blowing technology has been featured on AOL, Mashable, TechCrunch, Huffington Post, and more… 

- Gymatic not only auto log exercises and count reps, it also collect many advanced stats for each set, such as 
  * Heart rate (average and max) (only when using Apple Watch)
  * Rest and work time (work time only starts when you move, rest time starts as soon as movement ends. No need to mess with timer when you need to rest after a set, it is all automatic.)
  * Velocity 
  * Power
  * Tempo 
  * Rep speed
  * Form consistency 
  * Range consistency
  * Speed consistency

- Connect with Apple Health app to read heart rate and contribute to activity rings. 

- Get more accurate calories burned feedback then with typical fitness trackers because Gymatic knows EXACTLY which exercises you’re performing!

- It takes just 3 seconds to train any new exercise so there’s no limit to how many exercises Gymatic can track.

- Gymatic tracks your Crossfit, bodybuilding, weightlifting, strength training, HIIT workouts, TRX training, kettlebell training, calisthenics, machine exercises, and much much more!

- Stay motivated with remarkable progress tracking including 1 rep max estimates, calories burned and all advanced stats. 

- Support both FreeForm mode, where you can perform any exercises, and Guided mode, where Watch/Phone guides you through a pre-programmed workout. 

- Many workouts are included + unlimited workouts shared by the community. 

- Track your indoor cardio and accurately count calories for running, cycling, rowing, elliptical, and stair stepper. 

- Track your swim and count your strokes. 

Tips:
- Wear your watch just a little higher on your wrist than usual. (above the bone)
- Tighten the watch on your wrist. (just snug, not a death grip)
- Want to track Leg Press? Strap phone to your leg. Or keep hands on your leg to move along. 

Developer Note:
This is a new technology and you’re one of the first to try it out! We know it’s not perfect yet. Please help us improve the app for everyone by reporting bugs to support@vimo.co

Tutorial and FAQ are at https://support.vimo.co/portal/helpcenter/mobile-apps/gymatic-1. Visit this support site for questions and answers.

Gymatic Premium subscription is $4.99 per month / $29.99 per year and operates on a 30 / 365 day cycle. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of $4.99 / $29.99. You may manage your Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your user Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchases a subscription to Gymatic Premium.

bluejetty:00034020:ios.description:
BASE is a financial app designed to simplify personal finance management. Effortlessly track your income and expenses, plan your budget, and leverage advanced analytics to achieve complete control over your finances.
◉ START SAVING SMARTLY
– Savings Goals: Set financial objectives and track your progress, with the option to attach motivational photos.
– Spending Limit: Implement monthly caps to prevent overspending.
– Expense and Income Tracking: Log each transaction easily to maintain control over your finances.
– Expense Calculator: Instantly calculate expenses to ensure you never surpass your budget.
◉ KEEP AN EYE ON YOUR CASH FLOW
– Notes: Attach text notes & pictures to each transaction for a clearer insight into your spending habits.
– Recurring Expenses and Income: Automate recurring transactions to keep up with fixed payments without hassle.
– Advanced Analytics: Use comprehensive charts to analyze your income, expenses, and total balance.
– Account Balance Updates: Stay informed on the current status of all your accounts in one centralized location.
◉ ENHANCE YOUR FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
– Icons for Categories: Use colorful icons for a more vivid and understandable budget visualization.
– Adding Accounts: Consolidate all your financial accounts for easier management.
– Shopping Lists and Future Expenses: Anticipate purchases and upcoming expenditures to always stay within your financial plan.
– All Currencies & Custom Start Date: Support for all currency types and the flexibility to change the start date of the month.
◉ PREMIUM FEATURES
– No Limits: Enjoy the freedom of unlimited accounts, goals, and shopping lists to broaden your financial management capabilities.
– Premium Icons: Customize your accounting with exclusive icons.
– Advanced Analytics: Access advanced analytical tools for a deeper understanding of your financial situation.
– iCloud Backup: Secure your data with automatic iCloud backup and effortlessly sync your finances across all your Apple devices.
– (NEW!) Dark Mode: Enhance your experience with a sleek, eye-friendly dark mode — perfect for low-light environments and modern aesthetics.
– (NEW!) Spaces: Organize your finances with separate Spaces for personal use, work, or savings goals — all in one clear, stress-free view.
– Premium Support: Get prioritized help when you need it most with access to dedicated premium support for fast and personalized assistance.
BASE is perfect for those who strive for financial well-being and want to have constant access to their financial state in a convenient and intuitively understandable format.

bluejetty:00154511:ios.description:
Your Complete Spiritual Companion 
Holy Quran is designed for Muslims seeking a seamless, all-in-one app for their spiritual needs. Whether you’re looking for prayer time muslim reminders, salah guide for beginners, or Dhikr tracking, this app brings everything together in a simple and easy-to-use interface. Stay connected with your faith anytime, anywhere. 
Key Features 
Automatic prayer time alarm for all five daily prayers. 
Accurate qibla direction finder for wherever you are. 
Full holy book Quran text for easy reading and recitation. 
High-quality Quran mp3 full offline access to 114 surahs. 
Digital tasbih counter to track your Dhikr effortlessly. 
Morning and evening azkar reminders to keep you spiritually connected. 
Learn and reflect on the 99 names of Allah with meanings and benefits. 
Never Miss a Prayer 
With Holy Quran, you’ll always stay on time for your prayers. The app automatically sends alerts for salah time like Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha, ensuring you never miss an important moment of worship. And with the accurate qibla direction feature, you’ll always know the correct direction to pray, no matter where you are. 
Read and Listen to the Quran 
The app offers both a full al Quran text for easy reading and a complete audio version of all 114 surahs. Whether you prefer to read or listen, you can engage with the holy book Quran in a way that suits your lifestyle. The Quran audio mp3 feature ensures you can access it even when offline. 
Find the Qibla Instantly 
No need to worry about finding the Qibla while traveling or in unfamiliar places. The app’s highly accurate qibla compass direction helps you locate the exact direction for prayer with just one tap, whether you're using it offline or online. 
Simplified Dhikr & Spiritual Growth 
Use the built-in tasbeeh counter to keep track of your Dhikr easily and accurately. Whether you’re at home, traveling, or on the go, this feature helps you stay connected to your faith through daily remembrance. Additionally, explore the 99 names of Allah with meaning to gain deeper insight into their significance and benefits, further enriching your spiritual journey. 
What Sets Us Apart? 
Holy Quran - Deeper Journey offers more than just the basics. We combine offline Quran audio, easy-to-use prayer alarms, and a highly accurate qibla finder in one simple app. It’s designed to be your comprehensive Islamic companion, offering everything you need for your spiritual growth without the hassle of switching between multiple apps. 
Download Holy Quran today and take the next step in your spiritual journey with confidence. All your spiritual tools—prayer time table, Quran reading, and Dhikr tracking—are now in one place, easy, accessible, and reliable. 
Your review is our appreciation. We will try our best to respond to all your contributions and improve the app base on your contributions. Download the Al Quran Sharif Prayer Time and rate 5 our app will be your Islamic companion.

bluejetty:00156562:ios.description:
Your watch box tells a story. WristTrack gives you the data behind it.
Built by an independent watch enthusiast and data nerd, WristTrack is the ultimate companion for tracking, analysing, and managing your collection. Whether you own two daily beaters or a rotating safe of twenty pieces, WristTrack turns your daily wrist checks into rich, actionable horological insights - without getting in your way.
DEEP WEAR ANALYTICS & FILTERING
Stop guessing which pieces earn their keep and which ones are gathering dust.
Granular Filtering: Slice and filter your wear history across any timeframe - last month, this year, since your last purchase... or between dates you choose!
Cost-Per-Wear & Value Tracking: Track purchase prices, market valuations, and real-time cost-per-wear metrics as your collection evolves.
Complication & Spec Breakdowns: See which brands, dial colours, categories and case sizes dominate your wrist time.
LOCAL-FIRST ARCHITECTURE. OPTIONAL CLOUD SYNC.
Your collection data belongs to you, full stop.
Offline-Safe by Design: WristTrack works fast and reliably anywhere - no account required and no internet connection needed to log a wrist check.
Optional Encrypted Cloud Sync (New in 2.0): Ready to sync across your iPhone and iPad? Opt in to end-to-end encrypted cloud sync whenever you choose, or keep everything strictly on-device.
Biometric App Lock: Keep your collection catalogue and valuations private behind Face ID or Touch ID.
BUILT FOR COLLECTORS, NOT SUBSCRIPTION FATIGUE
No Artificial Collection Limits: Log as many watches and wear entries as you want in the core app without hitting a paywall after three watches.
Universal Support: Designed to look sharp on iPhone and native iPad layouts in both Light and Dark modes.
Crafted with Care: Every feature and line of code is written and reviewed by a fellow collector - no bloated social feeds, and no selling your data.
UPGRADE TO WRISTTRACK PRO (CHOOSE-YOUR-PRICE)
Love the data? Support independent development with a flexible, choose-your-price Pro tier - no predatory subscriptions - and unlock expanded horological tools:
Live Moon Phase Complication & Tracker: Keep an eye on the lunar cycle right alongside your collection.
Saved Multi-Timezone GMTs: Track home and travel timezones effortlessly for your GMT and world-timer pieces.
Expanded Horological Data: Unlock deeper technical specs and advanced analytical views.
Download WristTrack today and start seeing your collection through a sharper lens.

bluejetty:00200046:ios.description:
FSD Hunter helps you find Tesla vehicles for sale in the U.S. and Canada with indicators of valuable software packages or features, including Full Self-Driving Capability — Included Package, Enhanced Autopilot (EAP), Acceleration Boost, and SC01.
These vehicles can be difficult to identify manually because the details are often buried in listing photos, software screen images, or vehicle build/configuration data. FSD Hunter does the hard work for you by scanning listings, reviewing available software screen images, and identifying vehicles using available build configuration data when supported.
VIN Build Checks also let you investigate a specific Tesla by VIN and review available build, hardware, software, and factory configuration details.
Instead of searching through thousands of listings yourself, FSD Hunter helps surface the small percentage of vehicles that may include these desirable features, saving you time and helping you focus on the cars that matter.
Now including Canadian vehicles with limited results. (less than 30 FSD, less than 20 EAP, less than 50 Acceleration Boost)
*HI, AK - Cars are found but on a limited basis as there are fewer vehicles to search.
FSD Hunter is an independent research tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Tesla, Inc. Tesla, FSD, and Enhanced Autopilot are trademarks of Tesla, Inc.

bluejetty:00140278:ios.description:
Official mobile game for OVERLORD, the hit isekai series streaming on Crunchyroll.
Conquer, Command, and Control the World of OVERLORD!
Step into the shoes of Ainz Ooal Gown, the Supreme Overlord of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, in this epic strategy RPG! Dive into an immersive fantasy world where magic and might clash, and only the strongest can claim victory. Based on the popular anime, “OVERLORD,” this game lets you experience the thrill of commanding your own army of powerful guardians, villains, and other beloved characters.
Features:
Epic Storyline: Follow a story where you can experience the content of the anime that expands the OVERLORD universe, filled with intrigue, betrayal, and dark humor.
Strategic Gameplay: Plan your moves carefully and use your units’ unique abilities to outsmart and overpower your enemies.
Collect Iconic Characters: Summon and upgrade all your favorite characters from the series, including Albedo, Shalltear Bloodfallen, and Demiurge.
Stunning Graphics: Experience breathtaking battles with high-quality 3D animations and detailed environments that bring the world of OVERLORD to life.
PvP Arena: Challenge other players in the PvP arena to prove your supremacy and climb the ranks.
Alliance System: Join forces with friends and other players to form powerful alliances, participate in alliance wars, and earn exclusive rewards.
Regular Updates: Enjoy regular content updates with new characters, missions, and events to keep the adventure fresh and exciting.
Will you rise to the challenge and become the ultimate ruler of Nazarick? Download Lord of Nazarick now and unleash your inner overlord!

bluejetty:00136283:ios.description:
Featured in App Store's "Hot This Week" for multiple weeks.
Welcome to Smart Tasks: a simple, yet powerful way to get things done!
See your whole week in a minimalistic and interactive design. Write down everything from your time-sensitive work to things you just don’t want to forget about. Keep yourself from worrying about what you have to do and start getting things done.
Simple. Fast. Intuitive. Built for you!
FEATURES
• Simple and highly interactive design
• Drag and drop to quickly add, reorder, delete, and import tasks
• Swipe on any task, category, or date to access quick actions to get things done quicker
• Choose between 42 aesthetically pleasing colors for categories
• Home screen quick actions
• Export/import tasks and categories
APPLE SPECIFIC FEATURES
• Widgets
• Siri AI
• Dark mode
• Notification quick actions
• Add, edit, delete, and view Apple Calendar events
• Import reminders from the Apple Reminders app
• Control Center and Action Button controls support
• Device Handoff when adding tasks and categories
• Full VoiceOver support
• Smart Notifications
• Dynamic font support
• App Shortcuts
PREMIUM FEATURES
• iCloud sync
• Reminders in tasks
• Daily, weekly, monthly, and after completion routines
• Notes in tasks
• Week layout
• Unlimited categories
• Change app’s icon color
• Special configuration options
• Custom swipe actions
• Duplicating tasks
• Prioritize today
• Link, email, and phone number detection in titles and notes
iPad SPECIFIC FEATURES
• Multiple window support for categories and tasks
• Keyboard Shortcuts
• Right-click for quick actions
• Drag and drop task files for quick importing
• Drag and drop multiple task files
SUBSCRIPTION
Smart Tasks has a subscription service for premium features. No sign-up needed. Upgrade anytime to Smart Tasks +.
Without Smart Tasks +, users will only have access to a limited amount of features.
Subscriptions from Smart Tasks + will be charged to your card connected to your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your account settings after purchase. Any unused time left in a given free trial will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
For more details please look at:
Privacy Policy: https://smarttasksapp.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://smarttasksapp.com/terms/
Thank you for using Smart Tasks! I'm constantly updating the app to make it better.

bluejetty:00069126:ios.name: iQIBLA Life
bluejetty:00069126:ios.summary:
IQIBLA Life: The Muslim's Daily Companion
The IQIBLA Life app is your daily companion, helping you perform your acts of worship with ease and reverence. The app not only integrates with our smart products such as the Zikr Ring and Qibla Wat
bluejetty:00069126:ios.description:
IQIBLA Life: The Muslim's Daily Companion
The IQIBLA Life app is your daily companion, helping you perform your acts of worship with ease and reverence. The app not only integrates with our smart products such as the Zikr Ring and Qibla Watch but also functions as a standalone app containing prayer times, Qibla directions, and many other features that enable you to draw closer to Allah Almighty in the best way.
Prayer Times
Allah Almighty has prescribed for Muslims specific acts of worship at specific times, including prayer, fasting, and Hajj. Allah Almighty says:
"Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times." (An-Nisa: 103)
Performing the five daily prayers at their appointed times is an essential part of a Muslim's daily life and soul.
Qibla Direction
The Qibla is the direction of the Holy Kaaba, which is located in the Grand Mosque in Mecca. Allah Almighty says:
"Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds." (Al-Imran: 96)
It is the holiest place in Islam, and every Muslim must face its direction in prayer wherever they are on Earth.
Zikr Ring
The Zikr Ring is a smart device used as an alternative to the Zikr prayer beads, allowing you to count your invocations and glorifications easily and comfortably. The ring works in sync with the app to automatically record your Zikr, making the remembrance of Allah a part of your daily life with ease and convenience.

bluejetty:00022101:ios.description:
Boost your English skills with the 3000 English Vocabulary app, your go-to tool for mastering essential vocabulary effortlessly. This app, developed by a team of passionate educators, offers an innovative way to learn English through a variety of interactive games and activities. Perfect for learners at all levels, from beginners to advanced, the app focuses on building vocabulary while honing your listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
Why thousands of students love this app:
• Comprehensive Vocabulary Lists: Organized by themes for easy navigation, each word is supported by illustrations, transcriptions, examples, and accurate pronunciation guides.
• Focus on Key Words: Highlight and prioritize the words you’re currently learning to stay organized and avoid forgetting crucial vocabulary.
• Daily Progress Tracking: Monitor your learning journey and receive daily reminders to ensure you stay on track with your goals.
• Daily Learning Goals: Challenge yourself to learn 20 new words every day, keeping your motivation high and your vocabulary expanding steadily.
• Fun, Engaging Games: Strengthen all four language skills with enjoyable vocabulary games that eliminate the boredom of traditional learning methods.
• Custom Quizzes: Test yourself using words you’ve already learned or are currently focusing on for efficient review.
• Flashcard Review System: Reinforce challenging words with flashcards, making difficult vocabulary easier to remember over time.
• Structured Revision Plan: Review memorized words after set intervals (3, 7, 14, and 30 days) to ensure long-term retention.
• Thematic Learning: Master vocabulary by common topics, making learning more intuitive and memorable.
• Offline Access: Study anytime, anywhere without needing internet access—perfect for on-the-go learning.
The app continues to evolve, with regular updates adding new vocabulary themes. If you have any specific needs, feel free to send us your suggestions, and we’ll tailor the app to include the themes you require.
