bluejetty:00064664:ios.summary: CardPointers will save you money and earn you more cash back, points, and miles every day by maximizing your card's category bonuses, offers, and welcome bonuses. More than 1 million users use CardPointers to help them automatically save ov
bluejetty:00064664:ios.description:
CardPointers will save you money and earn you more cash back, points, and miles every day by maximizing your card's category bonuses, offers, and welcome bonuses. More than 1 million users use CardPointers to help them automatically save over $750 every year!
The app automatically tracks every category bonus and recurring bank credits from over 5,000 credit cards and helps you auto-add and use your Amex, Chase, Bank of America, Citibank, Wells Fargo, and US Bank offers to save even more money every day.
Make sure you're using your best card every time to maximize your points: ask Siri, "CardPointers here", and you'll immediately know which of your cards to use at the store that you're in to maximize your points or cashback, all without even opening the app -- because no one wants to be the person holding up the line.
Wish you had a chatbot which knows everything about your cards and offers? Now you do! Say "Siri, ask CardPointers", and it will answer any question you have about your wallet.
Turn on AutoPilot from the app or a shortcut and it will automatically use your location to tell you your best card (or offer) as you go from store to store. Safely and securely, as no location information ever leaves your device.
If you use have cards with Amex, Chase, BoA, Citi, Wells Fargo, or US Bank, you'll have access to 100s of offers with in-app auto-syncing, which adds all of your offers for you across all of your cards while you sleep. Your credentials are always stored safely, on-device.
Thanks to the Safari Web Extension, you'll even know which card to use while shopping on the web thanks to integrated Shopping Pointers, with support for thousands of merchant sites.
There's even a great Apple Watch app which shows you your best card at nearby stores.
Whether you're new to credit cards and "travel hacking" or you already have 20+ credit cards to your name, this is the app to help you earn tens of thousands more points, miles, and cash back every year, and ensure that you always have the best cards available in your wallet. All without having to sacrifice your privacy thanks to the largest database of credit cards available.
CardPointers integrates all of the latest Apple features, including:
- Designed for Liquid Glass with full resizability
- Fully integrated with Siri AI and Visual Intelligence
- AutoPilot uses Live Activities to show you the best card to use for each store as you travel, and will automatically appear on your Apple Watch + CarPlay
- Widgets of every size, including XL
- New integrations into Spotlight for all of your cards and offers, plus new App Intents and Shortcuts
- New controls and configurable widgets for Apple Watch
- Interactive widgets and snippets let you redeem offers, navigate your pointers, and more, from your home screen & lock screen
- Passkeys by default to further protect your account
- Location Reminders using native region-based notifications stored solely on-device
- Safari Web Extension (Shopping Pointers and automatic Offers Activation)
- Full accessibility for VoiceOver and voice control support
- Extensive keyboard support
- Fully independent Watch app with rich complication family support + widgets
You don't even need to launch the app to be able to quickly get the information that you need, thanks to the integrated lock screen widgets, app shortcuts, donated intents which show up in the system search for any matching category, Spotlight search, and quick action menus from the home screen.
Over 5,000 cards from 900 different banks are fully supported across the world, and if any are missing you can add them yourself, in any country. Here are just some of the banks which are supported:
Chase
American Express (AmEx)
Citibank
Discover
Capital One
Goldman Sachs
Bank of America (BofA)
Barclaycard
Synchrony Bank
Wells Fargo
US Bank
Target Bank
USAA
--
Privacy Policy: https://cardpointers.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://cardpointers.com/terms/

bluejetty:00146275:ios.description:
GPS Data delivers all of the current location information available from your device, including GPS, compass, and barometer data.
GPS Data displays the following information, in an easy-to-use list format:
• Current time
• Time since last update
• Accuracy of readings
• Latitude & Longitude coordinates (decimal degrees and degrees/minutes/seconds)
• Elevation (meters and feet above sea level)
• Speed (meters and feet per second, kilometers and miles per hour, and knots)
• Device direction (degrees true and degrees magnetic)
• Direction of device movement (degrees true)
• Local air pressure (hectopascals and inches of mercury)
• Vertical speed (meters per second and feet per minute)
Additionally, on iOS, any altitude, speed, or direction value can be expanded into a larger, full screen display, useful for monitoring different values when you're on the move.

bluejetty:00073604:ios.summary:
Still seeing well out of your current glasses or contacts prescription, but now it's expired? Virtual Vision Test by Warby Parker lets you renew it from home in 10 minutes using just your phone! And it starts at just $15.
*Pricing*
- You’l
bluejetty:00073604:ios.description:
Still seeing well out of your current glasses or contacts prescription, but now it's expired? Virtual Vision Test by Warby Parker lets you renew it from home in 10 minutes using just your phone! And it starts at just $15.
*Pricing*
- You’ll only be charged if we can renew your prescription
- You’ll hear back from our doctors within 48 hours. If the doctor renews your prescription, you’ll pay just $15. For multiple prescriptions you'll pay $25.
- If they cannot renew your prescription and instead recommend you get an in-person, comprehensive eye exam, you will not be charged.
*Eligibility*
To use Virtual Vision Test, you must meet eligibility requirements set by state regulations and our doctors. Virtual Vision Test is great for anyone who:
- Is between 18 and 65 years old
- Does not live in one of the following states: AK, AZ, AR, CO, CT, DE, DC, GA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MI, MN, NV, NJ, NM, ND, RI, SC, SD, VA, WA, WV
- Has a single-vision distance Rx (not readers or progressives)
- Has no eye health concerns or symptoms
- Sees well with their current glasses or contacts
How it works!
It’s as simple as reading the eye chart at the doctor’s office—but on your phone. You just need your eyeballs, your glasses or contacts, and your phone.
1. We’ll guide you through a simple (but thorough) eligibility quiz to make sure the app is a good fit for you.
2. If you’re eligible, the app takes you through an equally simple vision test. You'll need to complete it in a quiet, well-lit spot where you have about 10 feet of space.
3. In about 48 hours, an eye doctor will assess your results. If they determine that you're still seeing well out of your current prescription, then the doctor may renew it and you'll pay the $15, or more, if you have multiple prescriptions.
FYI: Virtual Vision Test by Warby Parker is not a comprehensive eye exam and it isn’t meant to replace visits to your eye doctor. It’s important to get your eye health examined periodically, even if you aren’t experiencing any vision problems, so please follow the advice of your doctor. Good to keep those peepers in check.

bluejetty:00146883:ios.description:
Today’s older adults are more active & independent than ever. Unfortunately, falls & motor vehicle crashes continue to disrupt the best years of their lives. 
FallCall Solutions has radically changed safety tech through non-stigmatizing, affordable innovation.
Welcome to the world's most comprehensive safety app: FallCall Detect!
24/7 Emergency Monitoring
US call center with trained emergency medical dispatchers providing customer service & emergency help.
Smart Fall Detection
Not every fall needs medical help. Backed by research, FallCall's "Smart" fall detection for Apple Watch can differentiate fall severity. Detected high-impact, standing falls will notify FallCall’s 24/7 monitoring services & caregivers while sending emergency services if needed.* Detected low-impact, sitting falls will notify a user’s caregroup only.**
4G LTE Cellular Medical Alert
With fall detection & two-way voice built in, notify emergency dispatchers & caregivers when help is needed. Available at FallCall.com.
Pair with Kwikset® Halo locks
Reduce emergency entry delays & eliminate the fear of EMS "breaking down the door." FallCall will unlock your Kwikset lock with ambulance dispatch.
Apple® Crash Detection (iPhone 14 & later)
First app in the world to integrate Apple Crash Detection into a 24/7 monitoring center.**
Connected Pendant Compatible
Add a Trelawear jewelry pendant(Trelawear.com) or FallCall Pendant with fall detection(FallCall.com) to remotely activate app within 100+ feet.*
FallCall Wristband
Discreet safety on your wrist. Change bands to match your style.
Other Features:
•16+ hours of fall detection on latest Apple Watch(results may vary)
•Adjust fall sensitivity
•Siri® activated Help Calls
•Elders may pair 5 caregivers
•Caregivers may pair 2 Elders
•Integrates with Health App
•Elder location & heart rate relayed to Caregivers during Help Calls***
•Elder Apple Watch & cellular medical alert battery levels sent to caregivers
•Works over cellular/Wi-fi/Bluetooth® for equipped Apple Watch & iPhone devices
Subscription 24/7 Monitoring Service:
•Staffed by trained Emergency Medical Dispatchers
•When a Help Call is triggered, our dispatchers will call you and/or your caregroup
•Real-time text updates sent to caregroup members during an event
•PSAP(Public Service Answering Point) technology
•Monthly subscription half the cost of most medical alerts ($17.99/mo)
Connected Pendant/Wristband subscriptions: 
1) Caregroup ONLY Help Calls ($9.99/mo) 
2) Caregroup + 24/7 Monitor Help Calls ($19.99/mo)
Subscription details:
Your Subscription Service starts when it is activated through the FallCall Detect App. Service will remain in effect for a minimum of one (1) month from the date of activation after which it may be terminated by either you or FallCall Solutions for any reason. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, See "Terms of Service" for details: https://www.fallcall.com/Docs/FallCallDetect-Terms-and-Conditions
*Subscription required. 
**Fall detection will not detect all falls and will not always accurately differentiate between high vs. low impact falls. Crash detection does not detect all crashes 
***As with all location-based services, it may not always be possible to determine your location. Multi-level buildings, parking garages, & even dense urban areas can make it difficult for satellites & cell phone towers to locate your exact location. 
FallCall Detect is not a replacement for 9-1-1. If 9-1-1 is necessary, FallCall Solutions recommends calling 9-1-1 directly.
The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by FallCall Solutions is under license. Other trademarks and trade names are those of their respective owners.

bluejetty:00126575:ios.summary: Packr is a travel packing list app that helps you pack your suitcase for every trip — so you never forget a thing. Save time before you go: your packing list is built automatically from your destination (city, country or region), travel dat
bluejetty:00126575:ios.description:
Packr is a travel packing list app that helps you pack your suitcase for every trip — so you never forget a thing. Save time before you go: your packing list is built automatically from your destination (city, country or region), travel dates and activities.
◆ PACKING CHECKLIST ◆
Packr creates a smart packing checklist for your suitcase from dozens of pre-defined activities.
Based on length of stay, weather and planned activities, your packing list is ready in no time. It's the perfect tool for summer vacations, long weekends, road trips, business travel and even camping.
◆ LESS STRESS ◆
Every journey is different, and each traveler has their own habits. Packr learns from each of your trips to organize the packing checklist, adjusting items based on your previous trips.
You will never forget to pack THAT thing again!
◆ BETTER PREPARED ◆
Set a quantity for each item — some quantities adjust automatically to the length of your stay.
Create your own custom packing lists, and now use emojis as list icons to personalize them. Assign each item to a bag or suitcase, and filter your packing list by traveler.
Even your pets can have their own packing list.
◆ PLAN MULTI-DESTINATION TRIPS ◆
Import your trips directly from TripIt, including multi-destination itineraries, or convert any trip into a multi-destination journey.
◆ PRACTICAL FEATURES ◆
Sign in with your Apple account to securely save and sync your trips and packing lists across iPhone and iPad. Pack anywhere with improved offline mode — even without a connection. You can also share your checklist with travel companions or print it out.
Packr has already travelled several thousand times around planet Earth, packing over a million items in each traveller's suitcase.
Packr has been used for trips to cities like Paris, London, Barcelona, New York City, Montreal, Berlin, Majorca... And countries like France, United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, USA, Italy, Canada, Germany and 1000+ more locations.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00116536:ios.description:
Mini Games: Calm & Relax – your ultimate collection of fidget games, chill puzzles, and satisfying mini games all in one place!
If you love relaxing games, fidget trading, and simple brain teasers, you’ve found your new favorite app. Whether you want to calm down anxiety, focus your mind, or just enjoy viral trends, this mini games hub is always ready for you. 
Play 50+ unique mini games instantly without filling your phone with dozens of separate apps. Swap in seconds between calming fidget games, ASMR-style tap games, and social media-inspired viral hits like Do Re Mi, Emoji Faces, Pizza Cuts, and Chop’t.
Need a break after school or work? Choose your mood:
Calm Mode: Tap, drag, and pop objects in soothing fidget games with gentle sounds and haptics.
Relaxed Mode: Enjoy chill puzzles, simple logic games, and stress relief activities.
Energized Mode: Try fast-paced arcade mini games that test your reflexes and timing.
GAME HIGHLIGHTS
* 50+ Addictive Mini Games: Play a massive library of games in a single free collection without downloading separate apps.
* Antistress & Chill: Specially designed games to reduce anxiety, help you relax, and find your daily peace.
* Brain Training: Engage with logic puzzles, memory challenges, and strategy games to boost your mind.
* Visual Satisfaction: Enjoy minimalist design, cute graphics, and ASMR effects in every satisfying game.
* Fidget Games Collection: Access popular games like Pop It, squishy, and sensory items instantly on your phone.
FEATURES
- Simple & Smooth Gameplay: Easy to learn, hard to master! Enjoy smooth controls for quick play with simple tap and swipe mechanics.
- Brain-Boosting Challenges: Missions that require focus, logic, and strategy to sharpen your mind while you play.
- Multiplayer Fun: Challenge friends & family on global leaderboards to see who can achieve the best high scores.
- Minimalist Design: Enjoy high-quality visuals and elegant puzzle designs that look cute and feel satisfying.
- ASMR & Haptics: Immerse yourself in calming music and enjoy satisfying haptic feedback with every interaction.
- Unique Levels: Explore challenging stages that reward your skill and precision as you progress.
- Play Anytime: Instant access to fun! Perfect for short breaks, travel, or killing time whenever you need entertainment.
- 100% Free to Play: Access the entire collection of mini games freely in your portable gamebox.
- Auto-Save Progress: Your progress is saved automatically so you can pick up where you left off anytime.
- One-Hand Play: Optimized vertical design allows for comfortable, quick gaming sessions on the go.
- Privacy Focused: Safe and secure gameplay environment suitable for kids, teens, and adults.
- All-in-One Hub: A cozy gamebox designed to relieve stress with diverse games in one place.
WHY CHOOSE THIS APP?
For All Ages: Simple to learn, satisfying to master, and fun for everyone in the family.
Stress Relief: The perfect antistress and relaxing games bundle for anxiety relief.
Mind Boost: Trains memory, logic, and reaction speed while you play and have fun.
Viral Trends: Play the hit games and filters you see on social media trends!
Download Mini Games: Calm & Relax now and turn your phone into a chill corner full of fidget and satisfying games, and viral fun whenever you need a break!

bluejetty:00136437:ios.description:
We care about your heart health, this is an app developed to protect heart health!
*Winner of the App Store Editors' Choice*
Main features are as follows:
【Heart Rate Measurement via Phone】
Gently place your finger on the phone to obtain your heart rate data.
【Watch Stress Dial】
Track stress and body metrics in real time.
【HRV】
Helps obtain your HRV data and view stress levels.
【Stress】
Monitor your stress data to understand your emotional pressure.
【Blood Pressure Records】
Helps record your blood pressure measurements.
【Blood Oxygen Tracking】
Helps record your blood oxygen saturation levels.
【Heart Score】
Pay attention to your heart health status.
【Heart Age】
Understand your heart's age.
【Sleep Monitoring】
Monitor your sleep quality, track sleep patterns, and enjoy white noise for better sleep.
【Other Health Data】
Read Apple Health data and track relevant metrics.
【Smoking Cessation】
Dedicated feature to record your tar intake and support quitting smoking.
【Real-time Health Data Updates in Standby Mode】
View your health data in real time while charging in standby mode.
【Alarm Reminders】
Help develop healthy habits.
【Large Font】
Adapts to phone font enlargement for easy reading.
Subscription:
-After confirming the purchase, the amount will be deducted from your iTunes account
-Subscription will automatically renew, and closing 24 hours before the current deadline will cancel the automatic renewal
-Renewing or canceling the subscription during the free trial period will not reclaim the free trial benefits from the user. The user can continue to try until the trial period ends
-Privacy Policy: http://singatop.com/Agreement/Privacy.html
-User Agreement: http://singatop.com/Agreement/UserAgreement%20.html
If you have any questions or suggestions, you can provide feedback on "User Feedback", and we will adopt appropriate suggestions and reply to you.
Disclaimers：
-This app is not a medical product and cannot be used for professional medical purposes. It is only used as a source of general health information, such as for fitness purposes.
-This app does not support measuring blood pressure and blood oxygen, it only provides a recording of them.

bluejetty:00134087:ios.description:
Buy, Sell, Discover. Join Grailed, a trusted platform for personal style, and connect with a global community of over 10M+ style enthusiasts. Explore curated collections featuring millions of menswear and womenswear pieces from 10K+ designers. Whether you're looking to buy coveted pieces, sell pre-loved items from your closet, or discover the latest trends, you can do it with confidence on Grailed.
BUY, SELL & ROTATE YOUR WARDROBE
Experience trusted and protected transactions on a platform designed for the style-savvy. With low seller fees and direct exposure to a hub of buyers, it's time to rotate your wardrobe and profit from your style.
SHOP THE LATEST TRENDS
Shop with confidence with Grailed’s authentication practices and purchase protection for qualified transactions. Unlock great prices and negotiate with sellers for deals. Explore menswear and womenswear styles for any aesthetic across apparel, footwear, accessories and more.
• Vintage: Designer, Denim, Band Tees, Leather Jackets, Y2K-inspired styles
• Luxury: Gucci, Dior, Prada, Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Rolex
• Streetwear: Off-White, Supreme, Nike, Jordan, adidas, New Balance
• Avant-Garde: Raf Simons, Rick Owens, Maison Margiela, Comme des Garçons, Helmut Lang
READ REVIEWS FROM THE COMMUNITY
Seller Ratings, Reviews, Transaction History and Seller Badges provide transparency and added peace of mind. Grailed relies on direct feedback from community members to provide additional accountability.
ENJOY A PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE
The Grailed feed serves personalized recommendations tailored to your style. Follow designers and sellers, receive notifications for saved searches and price drops, and filter your feed to match your preferences. Explore curated collections and dive into our 'Trending' and 'For You' selects designed with your style in mind.
DISCOVER AND GET INSPIRED
Get style inspiration through editorial content like street style and designer deep dives. Whether you're evolving your personal style, exploring new trends, or looking for the perfect piece to complete your wardrobe, Grailed is your one-stop-shop.
GRAILED IN THE NEWS
Grailed has been featured across accredited publications, including Vogue, The New York Times Style, Harper’s Bazaar, GQ, Esquire, Bloomberg, Nylon, WWD, Dazed, Elle, WhoWhatWear, Highsnobiety, Complex, Hypebeast and more.

Color Ball Sort - Puzzle Games is a simple but addictive, fun, and challenging color match game. Your objective is to sort different color ball into bottles that ensure that each tube is filled with the same color. It's sorting games for adults that need to classify each color ball. The more challenging the puzzles you play, the more careful you need to be with each move color sort. What's more, Color Ball Sort - Puzzle Games immerses you in a simple yet highly engaging color game experience, anytime and anywhere you desire. It's the ideal method to effortlessly while away your time, keep your cognitive faculties in action, and enhance your problem-solving abilities through sorting games.

- Tap any bottle to pick up the top ball, then tap another bottle to move the ball into it.
- You can only stack the ball into a bottle with the same color ball on top and enough space.
- When balls of the same color are sorted into a single bottle, you win in our puzzle games.
- Each bottle could only hold a certain amount of ball. If it's full, no more can be poured. 
- Lots of levels to solve, and each one is diverse in color match.
- Use "Undo" to go back to previous steps.
- There is no timer, and you can enjoy the Ball Sort puzzles at your own pace.
- There are no penalties. Take it easy and unwind in sorting games!

bluejetty:00140927:ios.description:
How fast are your reflexes? RTap is a reaction time test and reflex trainer packed into 10 fun mini-games. Measure your reaction speed in milliseconds, train every day, watch your progress on graphs and compete with players around the world on the leaderboards.
TEST YOUR REACTION TIME
Tap the moment you see or hear the signal and get your reaction time in milliseconds. Start with classic tests for visual signals, sound and a race start, then take on harder challenges: pick the right color, avoid the traps, find the emoji and catch what falls. See how your results compare with other players.
TRAIN YOUR REFLEXES AND FOCUS
Games that call for quick decisions, focus and hand-eye coordination reward practice the most. Play a few rounds a day and watch your scores and consistency go up.
10 GAMES, 30 MODES
• Simple Reaction – classic reaction time tests: race start, vision and audio
• Color Chooser – tap the right color as fast as you can
• Text and Color – a tricky color-word challenge for your brain
• Don't Tap Red – react fast, but don't fall for the trap
• Sliders – tap at the correct time,
• Emoji Finder – spot the right emoji in a crowd
• Swiping Games – swipe in the right direction
